sentences.en: 'The *main* thing to remember,' she said softly, 'is that a word spoken in fear will bend the wrong way.'
She pressed a small warm stone into my hand — her own practice stone, worn smooth.
sentences.cn: 她把一块小小的温暖石头放进我的手里——她自己的练习石，磨得很光滑。

sentences.en: The door to the inner chamber swung open by itself, though no wind moved.
sentences.cn: 通往内室的门自动打开了，虽然没有风吹动。

employee:0.en: An older man sat in the corner of the testing hall, copying records into a thick book. Shen Wujiu leaned close and murmured, 'He is not a disciple — he is an *employee* of the Sect, hired to keep the trial records honest.' I watched the man's brush move without pause. When I looked again, his page was blank, and he was watching me.
employee:0.cnHint: 师兄悄悄告诉我，坐在角落记录的那人是门派雇来的____，专职保证考试公正。
employee:0.hook: When I looked again, his page was blank, and he was watching me.
employee:0.line: 'That man is an *employee* of the Sect — he records every result faithfully.'

sentences.en: An older man sat in the corner of the testing hall, copying records into a thick book.
sentences.cn: 一个年长的男人坐在测试殿堂的角落里，把记录抄写到一本厚重的书里。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned close and murmured, 'He is not a disciple — he is an *employee* of the Sect, hired to keep the trial records honest.'
I watched the man's brush move without pause.
sentences.cn: 我看着那个男人的笔毫不间断地移动。

sentences.en: When I looked again, his page was blank, and he was watching me.
sentences.cn: 当我再看时，他的页面是空白的，而他在看着我。

class:0.en: Master Qingwu gathered us in the small side room before the trial. 'This is not a ranked *class*,' she said. 'You are not competing against one another. You are each facing the word alone.' She paused, and the lanterns dimmed without anyone touching them. Outside, the clouds below the mountain rose higher than I had ever seen.
class:0.cnHint: 师尊说，这次集训不是分等级的____，我们每个人都要独自面对灵词考验。
class:0.hook: Outside, the clouds below the mountain rose higher than I had ever seen.
class:0.line: 'This is not a ranked *class* — each of you faces the word alone.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us in the small side room before the trial.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在试炼前把我们聚集在小侧室里。

sentences.en: 'This is not a ranked *class*,' she said.
'You are not competing against one another.
sentences.cn: "你们彼此之间没有竞争。

sentences.en: You are each facing the word alone.'
sentences.cn: 你们每一个都独自面对这个字。"

sentences.en: She paused, and the lanterns dimmed without anyone touching them.
sentences.cn: 她停顿了，灯笼在没人接触的情况下变暗了。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below the mountain rose higher than I had ever seen.
sentences.cn: 在外面，山下的云层升得比我以前见过的都要高。

behavior:0.en: After my trial, Shen Wujiu reviewed my result with a careful eye. 'Your score is fine,' he said, 'but Master Qingwu noticed your *behavior* near the amber tablet — the way you leaned toward it without meaning to.' I had not realized I moved at all. He closed the record book slowly and did not say what that leaning might mean.
behavior:0.cnHint: 师兄说，师尊留意到了我在琥珀词牌前无意识的____举动，并对此有所判断。
behavior:0.hook: He closed the record book slowly and did not say what that leaning might mean.
behavior:0.line: 'Your *behavior* near the amber tablet did not go unnoticed by Master Qingwu.'

sentences.en: After my trial, Shen Wujiu reviewed my result with a careful eye.
sentences.cn: 试炼后，沈无咎用仔细的眼光审视了我的结果。

sentences.en: 'Your score is fine,' he said, 'but Master Qingwu noticed your *behavior* near the amber tablet — the way you leaned toward it without meaning to.'
I had not realized I moved at all.
sentences.cn: 我没意识到自己有任何移动。

sentences.en: He closed the record book slowly and did not say what that leaning might mean.
sentences.cn: 他缓缓合上记录簿，没有说那种倾身可能意味着什么。

disease:0.en: On the back wall of the hall hung an old chart of words used for healing. MEND and CLEAR sat at the top, but below them was a word I did not know. Xiaoxing touched it gently. 'That one treats *disease* of the spirit, not the body,' she said. 'No one in our generation has been able to pronounce it.' The word seemed to pulse once, slowly, like a second heartbeat.
disease:0.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，古老图表上有一个词专门用于治疗精神上的____，但我们这一代还没有人能念出它。
disease:0.hook: The word seemed to pulse once, slowly, like a second heartbeat.
disease:0.line: 'This word treats *disease* of the spirit — far harder to heal than the body.'

sentences.en: On the back wall of the hall hung an old chart of words used for healing.
sentences.cn: 在殿堂的后墙上挂着一张古老的治疗用字的图表。

sentences.en: MEND and CLEAR sat at the top, but below them was a word I did not know.
sentences.cn: "补"和"清"坐在最上面，但在它们下面是一个我不认识的字。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing touched it gently.
sentences.cn: 小杏轻轻地触碰它。

sentences.en: 'That one treats *disease* of the spirit, not the body,' she said.
'No one in our generation has been able to pronounce it.'
sentences.cn: "我们这一代没人能够念出它。"

sentences.en: The word seemed to pulse once, slowly, like a second heartbeat.
sentences.cn: 那个字似乎缓缓地脉动了一次，就像第二个心跳。

worker:0.en: The trial hall smelled of old stone and quiet effort. Along the walls, senior disciples carved word-seals into jade tablets, each one a *worker* shaping the sect's living library of spiritual formulas. I watched their chisels move and understood: mastery here was not given — it was cut, stroke by slow stroke. Then the nearest tablet cracked without warning.
worker:0.cnHint: 在试剑台的石室里，师兄们如同____般雕刻玉简，我看着他们的工作，忽然一块玉简无故裂开了。
worker:0.hook: The crack spread upward, and something cold breathed out from inside.
worker:0.line: 'A true *worker* of the word does not stop when the stone resists,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The trial hall smelled of old stone and quiet effort.
sentences.cn: 试炼殿堂闻起来像古老的石头和幽静的努力。

sentences.en: Along the walls, senior disciples carved word-seals into jade tablets, each one a *worker* shaping the sect's living library of spiritual formulas.
I watched their chisels move and understood: mastery here was not given — it was cut, stroke by slow stroke.
sentences.cn: 我看着他们的凿子移动，明白了：这里的掌握不是被给予的——它是被一笔一笔缓缓刻出来的。

sentences.en: Then the nearest tablet cracked without warning.
sentences.cn: 然后最近的一块牌匾没有预警地裂开了。

control:0.en: Master Qingwu set a single candle before me and said nothing. The word for 'wind' hovered on my lips, full of eager power. I had to *control* its release — too fast and the flame would die, too slow and the word would burn me from within. I breathed, I steadied, the flame bent gently east. Then it bent back, all on its own.
control:0.cnHint: 在试剑台的烛火测试中，我努力____着口中灵词的力量，烛焰听话地偏转，却在片刻后自行复位。
control:0.hook: A flame that moves without wind is a warning no disciple ignores.
control:0.line: 'You must *control* the word before the word controls you,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a single candle before me and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我面前放了一支蜡烛，什么也没说。

sentences.en: The word for 'wind' hovered on my lips, full of eager power.
sentences.cn: "风"这个字在我唇边悬停，满是急切的力量。

sentences.en: I had to *control* its release — too fast and the flame would die, too slow and the word would burn me from within.
I breathed, I steadied, the flame bent gently east.
sentences.cn: 我深呼吸，稳定心神，烛火轻轻向东弯去。

sentences.en: Then it bent back, all on its own.
sentences.cn: 然后它自己弯了回来。

product:0.en: Xiaoxing showed me her finished word-seal, pressed into a thin sheet of cloud-silk. 'Every seal is a *product* of every hour you spent in silence,' she said. Hers glowed a clean silver. Mine, beside it, pulsed an uncertain grey. We were shaped by the same lessons, yet the results stood as far apart as two mountains in separate skies. Then her seal flickered.
product:0.cnHint: 小星向我展示她完成的封印，说每一枚封印都是修炼时光的____，而我的封印与她相比黯然失色，随后她的封印突然闪烁。
product:0.hook: Silver light that flickers uninvited is never a good sign.
product:0.line: 'A seal is the *product* of silence, not of speed,' Xiaoxing said, glancing at mine.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me her finished word-seal, pressed into a thin sheet of cloud-silk.
sentences.cn: 小杏拿出她完成的字印，压在薄薄的云丝上。

sentences.en: 'Every seal is a *product* of every hour you spent in silence,' she said.
Hers glowed a clean silver.
sentences.cn: 她的字印闪着清冽的银光。

sentences.en: Mine, beside it, pulsed an uncertain grey.
sentences.cn: 而我的，挨在它旁边，发出不确定的灰色脉动。

sentences.en: We were shaped by the same lessons, yet the results stood as far apart as two mountains in separate skies.
sentences.cn: 我们受过同样的课程，结果却如同天空中相隔的两座山。

sentences.en: Then her seal flickered.
sentences.cn: 然后她的字印闪烁了一下。

practice:0.en: The trial hall required each new disciple to stand before the mirror-stone and speak the word for 'still.' It was a daily *practice*, simple in form but ruthless in judgment — the stone reflected not your face but your inner noise. I spoke, and the stone showed a boy tangled in too many fears. Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway, his own reflection perfectly calm. Then mine shifted.
practice:0.cnHint: 在试剑台，每日对镜石开口说'静'字是一项固定的____，镜中照出的是内心而非容貌，随后我的倒影开始变化。
practice:0.hook: A reflection that moves without you moving is asking a question.
practice:0.line: '*Practice* is the only herb that has no wrong dose,' Shen Wujiu said, turning away.

sentences.en: The trial hall required each new disciple to stand before the mirror-stone and speak the word for 'still.'
sentences.cn: 试炼殿要求每个新弟子站在镜石前，说出"静"这个字。

sentences.en: It was a daily *practice*, simple in form but ruthless in judgment — the stone reflected not your face but your inner noise.
I spoke, and the stone showed a boy tangled in too many fears.
sentences.cn: 我开口了，镜石显出一个被太多恐惧缠绕的男孩。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway, his own reflection perfectly calm.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从门口看着，他自己的映像完全平静。

sentences.en: Then mine shifted.
sentences.cn: 然后我的映像变了。

environment:0.en: Before a disciple could speak any word-formula, Master Qingwu insisted we understand the *environment* around us — the temperature of the stone floor, the direction of the upper wind, the mood of the cloud-sea far below. 'A word spoken in the wrong surroundings becomes a different word entirely,' she said. I looked around the trial hall and realized I had noticed none of these things. Outside, the cloud-sea turned a shade darker.
environment:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊要求我们在念出灵词之前先感知周围的____，我环顾试剑台才发现自己什么都没有留意，此时云海颜色悄然加深。
environment:0.hook: The cloud-sea does not darken without cause.
environment:0.line: 'Read the *environment* first,' Master Qingwu said, 'or the formula will read you.'

sentences.en: Before a disciple could speak any word-formula, Master Qingwu insisted we understand the *environment* around us — the temperature of the stone floor, the direction of the upper wind, the mood of the cloud-sea far below.
'A word spoken in the wrong surroundings becomes a different word entirely,' she said.
sentences.cn: "在错误的环境里说出的字会变成完全不同的字，"她说。

sentences.en: I looked around the trial hall and realized I had noticed none of these things.
sentences.cn: 我环顾试炼殿，意识到这些东西我一样都没有注意到。

sentences.en: Outside, the cloud-sea turned a shade darker.
sentences.cn: 殿外，云海变成了更深的颜色。

system:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a long scroll across the stone table, revealing the sect's word-training *system*: five tiers of formulas, each tier locked until the one below it was fully rooted in the body. It was a clear order, a patient ladder. I felt glad — until I saw my name already marked at tier two, skipping tier one entirely. No one had told me. The scroll trembled in a wind that was not there.
system:0.cnHint: 沈无咎展开记录门派修炼____的卷轴，我惊讶地发现自己的名字越过第一阶被标在第二阶，而此时卷轴在无风中颤动。
system:0.hook: Being placed higher than expected can mean someone expects you to fall.
system:0.line: 'The *system* exists so that no word takes root in hollow ground,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a long scroll across the stone table, revealing the sect's word-training *system*: five tiers of formulas, each tier locked until the one below it was fully rooted in the body.
It was a clear order, a patient ladder.
sentences.cn: 这是一个清晰的顺序，一架耐心的梯子。

sentences.en: I felt glad — until I saw my name already marked at tier two, skipping tier one entirely.
sentences.cn: 我很高兴——直到我看到自己的名字已经标在第二阶，直接跳过了第一阶。

sentences.en: No one had told me.
sentences.cn: 没有人告诉过我。

sentences.en: The scroll trembled in a wind that was not there.
sentences.cn: 卷轴在不存在的风中颤抖。

natural:0.en: Xiaoxing told me that for most disciples, speaking a word-formula felt like lifting a heavy stone. For a few rare ones it was *natural*, as easy as breathing out on a cold morning. She watched me attempt the word for 'light' and tilted her head. 'You hold it like a stone,' she said, almost kindly. 'You should be breathing.' Above us, the ceiling lanterns dimmed all at once without being touched.
natural:0.cnHint: 小星告诉我，对少数弟子来说驾驭灵词如同呼吸一般____，而我却像搬石头，话音未落，头顶灯火同时黯淡。
natural:0.hook: Lanterns that dim together are listening to something you cannot hear.
natural:0.line: 'It should feel *natural*, like fog settling,' Xiaoxing said, watching the lanterns.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing told me that for most disciples, speaking a word-formula felt like lifting a heavy stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏告诉我，对大多数弟子来说，说出字诀就像举起一块重石。

sentences.en: For a few rare ones it was *natural*, as easy as breathing out on a cold morning.
She watched me attempt the word for 'light' and tilted her head.
sentences.cn: 她看我尝试说"光"这个字，歪了歪头。

sentences.en: 'You hold it like a stone,' she said, almost kindly.
sentences.cn: "你像拿着一块石头，"她说，几乎是温柔的。

sentences.en: 'You should be breathing.'
sentences.cn: "你应该呼气。"

sentences.en: Above us, the ceiling lanterns dimmed all at once without being touched.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，天花板上的灯笼突然全灭了，没有人去碰它们。

free:0.en: Master Qingwu placed her hand flat on the trial stone and the room went silent. 'A word held too tightly dies,' she said. 'You must let it be *free* inside you before it will do anything outside you.' I had been gripping every formula like something that might run away. I loosened my hold. The trial stone lit up — once, bright, then dark again. Somewhere deep in the mountain, a bell rang that no one had struck.
free:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊说，灵词必须在心中____流动才能发挥作用，试剑台的试炼石随即一亮又暗，山腹深处无人敲响的钟声悠然响起。
free:0.hook: An unrung bell is the mountain's way of saying it has heard you.
free:0.line: 'Let the word be *free*, or it will never leave your mouth as power,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed her hand flat on the trial stone and the room went silent.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把手平放在试炼石上，房间陷入了寂静。

sentences.en: 'A word held too tightly dies,' she said.
sentences.cn: "字如果握得太紧就会死，"她说。

sentences.en: 'You must let it be *free* inside you before it will do anything outside you.'
I had been gripping every formula like something that might run away.
sentences.cn: 我一直像握着什么可能逃脱的东西那样紧紧抓住每一个字诀。

sentences.en: I loosened my hold.
sentences.cn: 我松开了手。

sentences.en: The trial stone lit up — once, bright, then dark again.
sentences.cn: 试炼石亮了起来——一次，很亮，然后又暗了。

sentences.en: Somewhere deep in the mountain, a bell rang that no one had struck.
sentences.cn: 在山深处的某处，一口没有人敲过的钟响了。

compare:1.en: At the Trial Sword Platform, Master Qingwu lined up our spirit-word tablets side by side. 'Do not *compare* your blade with another's,' she said, 'or you will chase their path and lose your own.' I looked at my tablet. Its glow was faint — but it was mine alone.
compare:1.cnHint: 师尊在试剑台上提醒弟子，不要把自己的灵字和别人____，应走自己的道路。
compare:1.hook: A crack split my tablet down the middle at dusk.
compare:1.line: 'Do not *compare* your light to Shen Wujiu's — yours burns differently.'

sentences.en: At the Trial Sword Platform, Master Qingwu lined up our spirit-word tablets side by side.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台上，青梧师尊把我们的灵字板排成一排。

sentences.en: 'Do not *compare* your blade with another's,' she said, 'or you will chase their path and lose your own.'
I looked at my tablet.
sentences.cn: 我看了看我的板子。

sentences.en: Its glow was faint — but it was mine alone.
sentences.cn: 它的光很微弱——但它是我独有的。

past:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform is carved from stone older than the Cloud Sea Sect itself. Shen Wujiu knelt there and pressed one palm to the rock. 'The *past* is sealed inside,' he whispered. 'Every disciple who failed here left a word behind.' Beneath my feet, a faint pulse answered.
past:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台古石上感受到，许多前辈弟子的____都封存在这块石头之中。
past:1.hook: The pulse grew stronger the moment I stepped forward.
past:1.line: 'The *past* of this platform holds more words than any scroll in the sect.'

sentences.en: The Trial Sword Platform is carved from stone older than the Cloud Sea Sect itself.
sentences.cn: 试剑台是从比云海宗还古老的石头上雕刻出来的。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt there and pressed one palm to the rock.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎跪在那里，一只手掌按在石头上。

sentences.en: 'The *past* is sealed inside,' he whispered.
'Every disciple who failed here left a word behind.'
sentences.cn: "每一个在这里失败的弟子都留下了一个字，"他说。

sentences.en: Beneath my feet, a faint pulse answered.
sentences.cn: 我脚下传来微弱的脉动。

suffer:1.en: Rain came sideways across the Trial Sword Platform. Xiaoxing stood firm, her hair flat against her face. Those who could not hold their spirit-word in the storm were sent inside. I chose to *suffer* the cold wind rather than retreat, and by the time the rain stopped, my word burned white.
suffer:1.cnHint: 小星和我在试剑台上宁愿____风雨，也不愿退进室内，坚持到底。
suffer:1.hook: A second storm was already forming on the eastern ridge.
suffer:1.line: 'I will *suffer* the rain — my word is not strong enough to protect itself yet.'

sentences.en: Rain came sideways across the Trial Sword Platform.
sentences.cn: 雨斜斜地洒过试剑台。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood firm, her hair flat against her face.
sentences.cn: 小杏站得很稳，头发贴在脸上。

sentences.en: Those who could not hold their spirit-word in the storm were sent inside.
sentences.cn: 那些在暴雨中无法坚持灵字的人被送了进去。

sentences.en: I chose to *suffer* the cold wind rather than retreat, and by the time the rain stopped, my word burned white.

almost:1.en: My spirit-word lifted me three feet off the Trial Sword Platform — then *almost* dropped me into the clouds below. I grabbed a stone post with both hands, heart loud in my ears. Shen Wujiu did not laugh. He only said, 'Good. Fear means you felt the height.'
almost:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台上用灵字飞起三尺，却____坠入云海，幸好抓住了石柱。
almost:1.hook: Below the platform, something large moved beneath the clouds.
almost:1.line: 'You *almost* had it — one more breath of intent and the word will hold you.'

sentences.en: My spirit-word lifted me three feet off the Trial Sword Platform — then *almost* dropped me into the clouds below.
I grabbed a stone post with both hands, heart loud in my ears.
sentences.cn: 我两只手紧紧抓住一根石柱，心跳在耳边轰鸣。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu did not laugh.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎没有笑。

sentences.en: He only said, 'Good.
sentences.cn: 他只是说，"很好。

sentences.en: Fear means you felt the height.'
sentences.cn: 恐惧意味着你感受到了高度。"

especially:1.en: Every new disciple must speak their spirit-word aloud at the Trial Sword Platform. The stone tests sincerity, *especially* in those who recite without feeling. Xiaoxing's voice was soft, but the platform lit up gold. Mine was loud, and the stone gave only a pale flicker.
especially:1.cnHint: 试剑台的石台会考验弟子的诚心，____是那些有口无心地念诵灵字的人。
especially:1.hook: The pale flicker pulsed once — then went out entirely.
especially:1.line: 'The platform is harsh with everyone, *especially* those who shout instead of meaning it.'

sentences.en: Every new disciple must speak their spirit-word aloud at the Trial Sword Platform.
sentences.cn: 每个新弟子都必须在试剑台上大声说出他们的灵字。

sentences.en: The stone tests sincerity, *especially* in those who recite without feeling.
Xiaoxing's voice was soft, but the platform lit up gold.
sentences.cn: 小杏的声音很轻，但试剑台亮成了金色。

sentences.en: Mine was loud, and the stone gave only a pale flicker.
sentences.cn: 我的声音很大，但石头只给出了苍白的微光。

publish:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long banner at the edge of the Trial Sword Platform and smoothed it flat. 'Today I *publish* the names of those whose words have passed the first trial,' she said. The wind held still. Shen Wujiu's name was first. Mine was not yet there.
publish:1.cnHint: 师尊在试剑台边展开长幡，____通过初试的弟子名单，我的名字还没在上面。
publish:1.hook: At the bottom of the banner, a name appeared without ink.
publish:1.line: 'I will *publish* the results at noon — those absent will be considered withdrawn.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long banner at the edge of the Trial Sword Platform and smoothed it flat.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在试剑台边缘展开了一幅长长的绢幅，把它压平了。

sentences.en: 'Today I *publish* the names of those whose words have passed the first trial,' she said.
The wind held still.
sentences.cn: 风停止了流动。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu's name was first.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎的名字排在最前面。

sentences.en: Mine was not yet there.
sentences.cn: 我的名字还没有出现。

activity:1.en: By dawn the Trial Sword Platform was already full of noise and motion. 'This *activity* starts before the sun does,' Xiaoxing said, rubbing her eyes. Each station tested a different word: one for healing, one for speed, one for flight. I moved between them, unsure which was meant for me.
activity:1.cnHint: 试剑台上清晨就开始了热闹的____，每个考站测试不同的灵字能力。
activity:1.hook: One station stood empty, its testing stone turned dark as ink.
activity:1.line: 'This *activity* will decide which path each of us walks for the next three years.'

sentences.en: By dawn the Trial Sword Platform was already full of noise and motion.
sentences.cn: 天亮时，试剑台已经热闹得不像样了。

sentences.en: 'This *activity* starts before the sun does,' Xiaoxing said, rubbing her eyes.
Each station tested a different word: one for healing, one for speed, one for flight.
sentences.cn: 每个站点测试一个不同的字：一个用于治愈，一个用于速度，一个用于飞行。

sentences.en: I moved between them, unsure which was meant for me.
sentences.cn: 我在它们之间移动，不确定哪一个是为我准备的。

science:1.en: 'Word-craft is not only art,' Master Qingwu told us at the Trial Sword Platform, her robe still in the windless cold. 'It is a *science* — measure, test, refine. Feel alone will not carry you past the first cloud ridge.' I wrote the word down and stared at it for a long time.
science:1.cnHint: 师尊在试剑台教导我们，灵字修炼不只是艺术，更是一门____，需要测量和验证。
science:1.hook: From the cloud ridge, a single black feather drifted down to my feet.
science:1.line: 'Treat word-craft as a *science* — record every result and learn from every failure.'

sentences.en: 'Word-craft is not only art,' Master Qingwu told us at the Trial Sword Platform, her robe still in the windless cold.
sentences.cn: "字术不仅仅是艺术，"青梧师尊在试剑台上对我们说，她的长袍在无风的寒冷中依然飘动。

sentences.en: 'It is a *science* — measure, test, refine.
Feel alone will not carry you past the first cloud ridge.'
sentences.cn: 感觉单靠意愿无法让你越过第一道云岭。

sentences.en: I wrote the word down and stared at it for a long time.
sentences.cn: 我把这个字写了下来，盯着它看了很久。

contribute:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, each disciple was asked to carve one word-herb into the shared stone pillar. 'Even a single word can *contribute* to the sect's strength,' Master Qingwu said, pressing my hand gently to the cold stone. I carved 'still.' The pillar glowed faint gold and did not stop.
contribute:1.cnHint: 在试剑台，弟子们被要求将各自的词草____到宗门的石柱上。
contribute:1.hook: By midnight, the pillar's glow had spread to the clouds below.
contribute:1.line: 'Every disciple must *contribute* one true word before the season turns.'

sentences.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, each disciple was asked to carve one word-herb into the shared stone pillar.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台上，每个弟子都被要求在共用的石柱上刻一个字草。

sentences.en: 'Even a single word can *contribute* to the sect's strength,' Master Qingwu said, pressing my hand gently to the cold stone.
I carved 'still.'
sentences.cn: 我刻下了"静"。

sentences.en: The pillar glowed faint gold and did not stop.
sentences.cn: 石柱发出淡淡的金光，而且没有停止。

share:1.en: Shen Wujiu split his last word-herb into three equal pieces on the edge of the Trial Sword Platform and held one out to me. 'Take your *share*,' he said simply. Below us the cloud sea shifted like a slow breath. I took the piece; it tasted of pine and something older.
share:1.cnHint: 在试剑台边缘，师兄将最后一枚词草分开，把____递给了我。
share:1.hook: The clouds below parted, revealing a shadow that had no owner.
share:1.line: 'Take your *share* — we carry the same sky tonight.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu split his last word-herb into three equal pieces on the edge of the Trial Sword Platform and held one out to me.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在试剑台的边缘把他最后一株字草分成三等份，递给我其中一份。

sentences.en: 'Take your *share*,' he said simply.
Below us the cloud sea shifted like a slow breath.
sentences.cn: 我们下面的云海像缓慢的呼吸一样移动。

sentences.en: I took the piece; it tasted of pine and something older.
sentences.cn: 我接过那一块；它尝起来有松针和某种更古老的味道。

decade:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform had stood for a *decade* of decades, its stone worn smooth by ten thousand bare feet before mine. Master Qingwu traced one deep groove with her finger. 'Each mark,' she said, 'is a word someone almost said.' The wind agreed by going very quiet.
decade:1.cnHint: 试剑台已矗立了数个____，台石被无数弟子的脚步磨得光滑。
decade:1.hook: In the newest groove, fresh and bright, my name had already been carved.
decade:1.line: 'A *decade* is nothing — some words take a century to ripen.'

sentences.en: The Trial Sword Platform had stood for a *decade* of decades, its stone worn smooth by ten thousand bare feet before mine.
Master Qingwu traced one deep groove with her finger.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用手指追踪了一道深深的沟槽。

sentences.en: 'Each mark,' she said, 'is a word someone almost said.'
sentences.cn: "每一个标记，"她说，"都是某个人几乎要说出的字。"

sentences.en: The wind agreed by going very quiet.
sentences.cn: 风表示同意，变得非常安静。

kind:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, the word-herbs fell into two groups: those that burned and those that healed. 'What *kind* do you reach for first?' Master Qingwu asked, watching my hand hover. I chose the pale green one, the one that smelled of rain. She nodded and said nothing more.
kind:1.cnHint: 在试剑台，师尊问我倾向于哪种____的词草——焚烧的还是治愈的。
kind:1.hook: The herb I chose dissolved and left a character on my palm I could not read.
kind:1.line: 'The *kind* of word you love most will shape every path you walk.'

sentences.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, the word-herbs fell into two groups: those that burned and those that healed.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台上，字草分成了两组：那些燃烧的和那些治愈的。

sentences.en: 'What *kind* do you reach for first?'
Master Qingwu asked, watching my hand hover.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊问道，看着我的手在空中停留。

sentences.en: I chose the pale green one, the one that smelled of rain.
sentences.cn: 我选了那个淡绿色的，那个闻起来像雨的。

sentences.en: She nodded and said nothing more.
sentences.cn: 她点了点头，什么也没再说。

across:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air and sent it *across* the full width of the Trial Sword Platform. It passed every disciple in turn, pausing at each face like a question. When it reached me it stopped, turned slowly, and waited. No one had seen it stop before.
across:1.cnHint: 师尊将一个字符送____整个试剑台，它在每位弟子面前短暂停留。
across:1.hook: The character was still turning when the platform bell rang on its own.
across:1.line: 'Send your word *across* the platform — let the stone decide if it is true.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air and sent it *across* the full width of the Trial Sword Platform.
It passed every disciple in turn, pausing at each face like a question.
sentences.cn: 它依次经过每个弟子，在每张脸前停留，像一个问题。

sentences.en: When it reached me it stopped, turned slowly, and waited.
sentences.cn: 当它到达我时，它停了下来，慢慢转身，然后等待。

sentences.en: No one had seen it stop before.
sentences.cn: 没人见过它停留。

factor:1.en: Shen Wujiu marked the results on a flat stone after the trial: speed, clarity, intent. 'Courage is the hidden *factor*,' he told Xiaoxing and me, tapping the last column he had left blank on purpose. Far below, something large moved once through the cloud sea and was still again.
factor:1.cnHint: 师兄将试炼结果逐项记录，指出勇气是被众人忽视的____。
factor:1.hook: The blank column began to fill with characters none of us had written.
factor:1.line: 'Courage is the one *factor* the stone measures without being asked.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu marked the results on a flat stone after the trial: speed, clarity, intent.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在试验后在一块平石上标记了结果：速度、清晰度、意图。

sentences.en: 'Courage is the hidden *factor*,' he told Xiaoxing and me, tapping the last column he had left blank on purpose.
Far below, something large moved once through the cloud sea and was still again.
sentences.cn: 下面很远的地方，有什么大的东西在云海中动了一下，然后又安静了。

condition:1.en: Xiaoxing checked the Trial Sword Platform before dawn, running her fingers along each crack. 'The *condition* of the stone tells you the mood of the mountain,' she whispered to me. One crack near the center was warm to the touch. By the time we told Master Qingwu, the crack had sealed itself.
condition:1.cnHint: 小星在黎明前检查试剑台，说石台的____能反映山脉的情绪。
condition:1.hook: Where the crack had been, a single unfamiliar word now pressed up from below.
condition:1.line: 'The *condition* of the platform changes when the clouds hold their breath.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing checked the Trial Sword Platform before dawn, running her fingers along each crack.
sentences.cn: 小杏在黎明前检查了试剑台，用手指沿着每条裂缝滑动。

sentences.en: 'The *condition* of the stone tells you the mood of the mountain,' she whispered to me.
One crack near the center was warm to the touch.
sentences.cn: 中心附近的一条裂缝摸起来是温热的。

sentences.en: By the time we told Master Qingwu, the crack had sealed itself.
sentences.cn: 等我们告诉青梧师尊时，裂缝已经自己愈合了。

effort:1.en: My first word-herb shattered the moment I released it above the Trial Sword Platform. Shen Wujiu watched without pity. 'The *effort* shows,' he said, and that was all. I tried again. The second herb held its shape for three full breaths before it drifted down into the cloud sea and was gone.
effort:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台上第一次释放词草时它碎了，师兄说他看见了我的____。
effort:1.hook: From deep in the cloud sea, my shattered herb glowed back up at me like an answer.
effort:1.line: 'The *effort* you put in — the mountain puts back. It forgets nothing.'

sentences.en: My first word-herb shattered the moment I released it above the Trial Sword Platform.
sentences.cn: 我的第一株字草在我将它释放到试剑台上方时碎裂了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched without pity.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎毫无怜悯地看着。

sentences.en: 'The *effort* shows,' he said, and that was all.
I tried again.
sentences.cn: 我又试了一次。

sentences.en: The second herb held its shape for three full breaths before it drifted down into the cloud sea and was gone.
sentences.cn: 第二株草坚持了三个完整的呼吸，然后漂落进云海，消失了。

receive:1.en: At the base of Trial Sword Platform, a messenger crane landed on my shoulder and dropped a folded leaf into my palm. I had come to *receive* my first formal task from the sect — a herb-collecting mission on the outer peaks. The crane lifted away before I could even bow.
receive:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台下____了宗门交给我的第一份任务。
receive:1.hook: The leaf bore a second message, written in fading ink.
receive:1.line: 'You will *receive* your answer only after the trial begins.'

sentences.en: At the base of Trial Sword Platform, a messenger crane landed on my shoulder and dropped a folded leaf into my palm.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台的底部，一只信使鹤在我的肩膀上着陆，在我的掌心里扔下了一片折叠的叶子。

sentences.en: I had come to *receive* my first formal task from the sect — a herb-collecting mission on the outer peaks.
The crane lifted away before I could even bow.
sentences.cn: 信使鹤飞走了，我连鞠躬的机会都没有。

encourage:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood beside me at the foot of the platform stairs, watching younger disciples hesitate at the first stone step. He placed a steady hand on my shoulder. 'The mountain will not move for fear,' he said, meaning to *encourage* me before I climbed alone into the cold morning mist.
encourage:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台前____我踏上石阶，不要因恐惧而退缩。
encourage:1.hook: Above the mist, something vast and silent was already watching.
encourage:1.line: 'I say this to *encourage* you — the platform remembers courage.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood beside me at the foot of the platform stairs, watching younger disciples hesitate at the first stone step.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身旁，看着年轻的弟子们在平台石阶前犹豫不决。

sentences.en: He placed a steady hand on my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 他在我肩上放了一只稳定的手。

sentences.en: 'The mountain will not move for fear,' he said, meaning to *encourage* me before I climbed alone into the cold morning mist.

travel:1.en: The road to Trial Sword Platform wound between two cliffs where wind moved like a living thing. Our *travel* that morning was slow; each step pressed spirit energy down into the stone path, as the sect rules required. Xiaoxing counted her breaths aloud to keep pace with the rhythm of the mountain.
travel:1.cnHint: 我们去往试剑台的____十分缓慢，每一步都要将灵力注入石路。
travel:1.hook: At the last bend, the path simply ended in open sky.
travel:1.line: 'Every *travel* to this place is a test before the test.'

sentences.en: The road to Trial Sword Platform wound between two cliffs where wind moved like a living thing.
sentences.cn: 通往剑试台的山路在两道悬崖间蜿蜒，风像活的东西一样流动。

sentences.en: Our *travel* that morning was slow; each step pressed spirit energy down into the stone path, as the sect rules required.
Xiaoxing counted her breaths aloud to keep pace with the rhythm of the mountain.
sentences.cn: 小杏大声数着呼吸，跟上山的节奏。

strong:1.en: Master Qingwu walked the outer edge of Trial Sword Platform without looking down. The boards were old, yet her steps did not waver. 'The wood is *strong*,' she said, 'because ten thousand disciples have crossed it and none have doubted it.' I gripped the railing and tried to believe the same.
strong:1.cnHint: 师尊说，试剑台的木板因无数弟子的信念而变得____。
strong:1.hook: Then one board beneath my foot gave a low, warning crack.
strong:1.line: 'Only a *strong* heart keeps these old planks from breaking.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked the outer edge of Trial Sword Platform without looking down.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊走在剑试台的外边缘，眼睛没有往下看。

sentences.en: The boards were old, yet her steps did not waver.
sentences.cn: 木板很旧，但她的步子没有摇晃。

sentences.en: 'The wood is *strong*,' she said, 'because ten thousand disciples have crossed it and none have doubted it.'
I gripped the railing and tried to believe the same.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧握着栏杆，试图相信同样的事。

chance:1.en: Shen Wujiu told me that the sect opens Trial Sword Platform only once each season. A single *chance* — that was all any disciple would receive to prove their word-craft before Master Qingwu and the assembly of elders. The wind above the platform carried the distant sound of a bell no one had rung.
chance:1.cnHint: 试剑台每季只开放一次，这是弟子展示功法的唯一____。
chance:1.hook: A second bell answered from somewhere far below the clouds.
chance:1.line: 'Do not waste the one *chance* the platform gives you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me that the sect opens Trial Sword Platform only once each season.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎告诉我，宗派每季只开放一次剑试台。

sentences.en: A single *chance* — that was all any disciple would receive to prove their word-craft before Master Qingwu and the assembly of elders.
The wind above the platform carried the distant sound of a bell no one had rung.
sentences.cn: 平台上方的风携带着无人敲响的钟声。

solve:1.en: A stone tablet stood at the entrance to Trial Sword Platform, carved with a formula no disciple had read aloud correctly in three years. Xiaoxing pressed her fingertips to the cold surface and closed her eyes. I watched her lips move, certain she was the first among us who might truly *solve* it.
solve:1.cnHint: 小星闭上眼睛，试图____试剑台入口石碑上三年无人破解的法文。
solve:1.hook: When she opened her eyes, the carved letters were gone.
solve:1.line: 'To *solve* the tablet is to open a door you cannot close.'

sentences.en: A stone tablet stood at the entrance to Trial Sword Platform, carved with a formula no disciple had read aloud correctly in three years.
sentences.cn: 一块石碑立在剑试台的入口，上面刻着三年来无弟子正确诵读过的公式。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed her fingertips to the cold surface and closed her eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏把指尖贴在冰冷的表面上，闭上眼睛。

sentences.en: I watched her lips move, certain she was the first among us who might truly *solve* it.

quite:1.en: I had expected Trial Sword Platform to be loud with wind and contest. Instead the air was *quite* still — so still that I could hear the soft creak of the floating mountain shifting beneath us. Master Qingwu said nothing. She simply looked at the horizon, as if waiting for something only she could see.
quite:1.cnHint: 试剑台上出乎意料地____寂静，连浮山的轻微移动都听得见。
quite:1.hook: That stillness broke with a sound like tearing silk.
quite:1.line: 'It is *quite* calm now — that is when you must be most alert.'

sentences.en: I had expected Trial Sword Platform to be loud with wind and contest.
sentences.cn: 我原本以为剑试台会充满风声和比赛的喧闹。

sentences.en: Instead the air was *quite* still — so still that I could hear the soft creak of the floating mountain shifting beneath us.
Master Qingwu said nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊什么也没说。

sentences.en: She simply looked at the horizon, as if waiting for something only she could see.
sentences.cn: 她只是看着地平线，仿佛在等待只有她能看到的东西。

technology:1.en: An elder from the Archive Hall unrolled a long scroll beside the platform's central pillar. It mapped every known word-formula the sect had gathered over two hundred years — their highest *technology* of spirit and language, distilled into ink that shimmered faintly even under cloud-filtered light. I had never seen so many words in one place.
technology:1.cnHint: 典藏堂的长老展示了宗门两百年积累的灵文____精华卷轴。
technology:1.hook: One formula at the scroll's edge had been crossed out in red.
technology:1.line: 'This *technology* of words is the only weapon that truly lasts.'

sentences.en: An elder from the Archive Hall unrolled a long scroll beside the platform's central pillar.
sentences.cn: 档案厅的一位长老在平台中心柱旁展开了一卷长长的卷轴。

sentences.en: It mapped every known word-formula the sect had gathered over two hundred years — their highest *technology* of spirit and language, distilled into ink that shimmered faintly even under cloud-filtered light.
I had never seen so many words in one place.
sentences.cn: 我从未见过一个地方聚集了这么多的字。

education:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, Master Qingwu gathered every new disciple beneath the open sky. 'Your *education* begins not with a blade,' she said, 'but with the living herbs beneath your feet.' She pressed one leaf into my palm. Its warmth moved upward like a slow green fire.
education:1.cnHint: 在试剑台上，师尊告诉弟子们，真正的____从脚下的灵草开始。
education:1.hook: The leaf's warmth reached my wrist and would not stop.
education:1.line: 'Your *education* begins not with a blade, but with the earth.'

sentences.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, Master Qingwu gathered every new disciple beneath the open sky.
sentences.cn: 在剑试台上，青梧师尊把每一个新弟子聚集在开放的天空下。

sentences.en: 'Your *education* begins not with a blade,' she said, 'but with the living herbs beneath your feet.'
She pressed one leaf into my palm.
sentences.cn: 她把一片叶子按进我的掌心。

sentences.en: Its warmth moved upward like a slow green fire.
sentences.cn: 它的温暖像缓缓的绿火向上移动。

scientist:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood apart from the other disciples, studying the platform's stone carvings with quiet eyes. The older disciples called him a *scientist* of spiritual formulae, one who measured every herb's effect before he trusted it. I watched him press two fingers to a carved line and count beneath his breath.
scientist:1.cnHint: 师兄像研究灵纹的____一样，冷静地丈量着试剑台上的每一道刻痕。
scientist:1.hook: When he finished counting, his fingers left a faint glow behind.
scientist:1.line: 'A *scientist* of the formulae trusts the measure, not the legend.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood apart from the other disciples, studying the platform's stone carvings with quiet eyes.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在其他弟子之外，用平静的眼睛研究着平台的石雕。

sentences.en: The older disciples called him a *scientist* of spiritual formulae, one who measured every herb's effect before he trusted it.
I watched him press two fingers to a carved line and count beneath his breath.
sentences.cn: 我看他用两根手指按在一条雕刻的线上，在呼吸下数数。

physical:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform rose above the cloud sea on a single column of bare rock. Master Qingwu warned us that the *physical* weight of doubt could pull a disciple off the edge faster than any wind. I felt my knees soften and gripped the stone railing with both hands.
physical:1.cnHint: 师尊警告说，内心的疑惑会化作____的重量，将弟子拖离试剑台。
physical:1.hook: A small cloud drifted through the railing, and I felt it press against my palm.
physical:1.line: 'The *physical* weight of doubt is heavier than iron.'

sentences.en: The Trial Sword Platform rose above the cloud sea on a single column of bare rock.
sentences.cn: 剑试台在一根光秃秃的岩石柱上高耸于云海之上。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu warned us that the *physical* weight of doubt could pull a disciple off the edge faster than any wind.
I felt my knees soften and gripped the stone railing with both hands.
sentences.cn: 我感到膝盖软了下去，用两只手紧紧握住了石栏杆。

quality:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me a pale blue herb and said its *quality* could be judged by the pattern of light it made against the morning sky. She lifted it slowly, and three rings of soft gold appeared, perfectly spaced. I raised mine. Only one ring appeared, and it trembled.
quality:1.cnHint: 师妹教我对着晨光检验灵草的____，我的灵草只现出一道摇晃的光环。
quality:1.hook: The trembling ring faded before I could count its colour.
quality:1.line: 'The *quality* of a herb speaks in light, not in words.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a pale blue herb and said its *quality* could be judged by the pattern of light it made against the morning sky.
She lifted it slowly, and three rings of soft gold appeared, perfectly spaced.
sentences.cn: 她慢慢抬起它，三道完美间隔的柔和金光出现了。

sentences.en: I raised mine.
sentences.cn: 我举起我的。

sentences.en: Only one ring appeared, and it trembled.
sentences.cn: 只有一道光出现，而且它在颤抖。

habit:1.en: Every dawn on the Trial Sword Platform, Shen Wujiu swept the stone floor before anyone else arrived. Master Qingwu once told me this quiet *habit* had kept his spiritual energy clear for three full seasons. I began to rise earlier, broom in hand, hoping the same calm would find me.
habit:1.cnHint: 师兄每天清晨打扫试剑台的____，据说令他三季以来灵气清明。
habit:1.hook: On the third morning, my broom struck something beneath a loose stone.
habit:1.line: 'This small *habit* has guarded my spirit longer than any sword.'

sentences.en: Every dawn on the Trial Sword Platform, Shen Wujiu swept the stone floor before anyone else arrived.
sentences.cn: 每个黎明，沈无咎都在其他人到达之前扫过剑试台的石头地板。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu once told me this quiet *habit* had kept his spiritual energy clear for three full seasons.
I began to rise earlier, broom in hand, hoping the same calm would find me.
sentences.cn: 我开始早起，手中拿着扫帚，希望同样的平静也能找到我。

sound:1.en: A deep *sound* rose from the platform's centre stone as dawn touched it — steady, like a bell held underwater. Xiaoxing said the stone only sang when the cloud sea below was rising. We all turned and looked over the edge. The white clouds were climbing, fast and silent.
sound:1.cnHint: 试剑台中央的石台发出低沉的____，师妹说这意味着云海正在上涌。
sound:1.hook: The clouds reached the platform's edge and kept climbing.
sound:1.line: 'That *sound* means the cloud sea remembers it is alive.'

sentences.en: A deep *sound* rose from the platform's centre stone as dawn touched it — steady, like a bell held underwater.
Xiaoxing said the stone only sang when the cloud sea below was rising.
sentences.cn: 小杏说这块石头只有在下面云海上升的时候才会唱歌。

sentences.en: We all turned and looked over the edge.
sentences.cn: 我们都转身往边上看。

sentences.en: The white clouds were climbing, fast and silent.
sentences.cn: 白云在快速无声地往上爬。

average:1.en: Master Qingwu looked at my first practice strike and said nothing for a long moment. Then she told me my form was *average* — steady enough to pass, too careful to grow. She set a single stone leaf spinning in the air and asked me to cut it without slowing my breath.
average:1.cnHint: 师尊说我的剑姿只是____水平，并用一片旋转的石叶来考验我是否能突破自己。
average:1.hook: The leaf spun faster the moment my sword moved toward it.
average:1.line: '*Average* is the place you pass through, not the place you rest.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu looked at my first practice strike and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看了我的第一次出招，沉默了很久。

sentences.en: Then she told me my form was *average* — steady enough to pass, too careful to grow.
She set a single stone leaf spinning in the air and asked me to cut it without slowing my breath.
sentences.cn: 她让一片石叶在空中旋转，要我在不乱呼吸的情况下把它斩断。

body:1.en: Before the trial began, Shen Wujiu told me to feel the platform as an extension of my own *body* — every crack in the stone a joint, every carved line a vein. I pressed my bare foot to the centre stone and felt something slow and deep move upward through my leg.
body:1.cnHint: 师兄要我把试剑台当作自己____的延伸，感受石台中流动的灵脉。
body:1.hook: What moved through my leg did not feel like stone.
body:1.line: 'Let the platform become your *body*, and the stone will guide you.'

sentences.en: Before the trial began, Shen Wujiu told me to feel the platform as an extension of my own *body* — every crack in the stone a joint, every carved line a vein.
I pressed my bare foot to the centre stone and felt something slow and deep move upward through my leg.
sentences.cn: 我把赤足踩在中心石上，感觉有什么缓慢而深沉的东西从我的腿里向上移动。

personal:1.en: The Trial Sword Platform stood open to the sky, swept by mountain winds. Each disciple carved one word into the stone before stepping forward. 'This is not a group test,' Shen Wujiu said quietly beside me. 'Your bond with a word is *personal* — no one else can feel it for you.' I pressed my palm to the cold stone and breathed.
personal:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，每个人与词语之间的____联系，旁人无法代替感受。
personal:1.hook: The stone grew warm beneath my hand, and then began to glow.
personal:1.line: 'Your bond with a word is *personal* — no one else can feel it for you.'

sentences.en: The Trial Sword Platform stood open to the sky, swept by mountain winds.
sentences.cn: 试剑平台敞开在天空下，被山风扫过。

sentences.en: Each disciple carved one word into the stone before stepping forward.
sentences.cn: 每个弟子在上前之前都要在石头上刻一个字。

sentences.en: 'This is not a group test,' Shen Wujiu said quietly beside me.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在我身边轻声说："这不是集体考试。"

sentences.en: 'Your bond with a word is *personal* — no one else can feel it for you.'
I pressed my palm to the cold stone and breathed.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在冰冷的石头上，深呼吸。

rather:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the platform, her robes still in the heavy wind. She did not call my name loudly. She spoke it *rather* softly, the way one speaks a word one respects. I walked forward anyway, heart loud in my chest, the clouds far below swallowing all sound of the world beneath.
rather:1.cnHint: 师尊____轻声念出我的名字，语气中带着一种令人敬畏的分量。
rather:1.hook: Below the platform, the sea of clouds parted — just once, just briefly.
rather:1.line: 'I call your name *rather* softly because a name deserves that respect.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the edge of the platform, her robes still in the heavy wind.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在平台的边缘，她的袍子在猛烈的风中飘动。

sentences.en: She did not call my name loudly.
sentences.cn: 她没有大声喊我的名字。

sentences.en: She spoke it *rather* softly, the way one speaks a word one respects.
I walked forward anyway, heart loud in my chest, the clouds far below swallowing all sound of the world beneath.
sentences.cn: 我还是走了上去，心脏在胸腔里砰砰直跳，下面的云吞没了世界下方的所有声音。

instead:1.en: I had chosen the word 'rise' to carve into the trial stone. But when my hand touched the surface, my fingers moved on their own and wrote 'hold' *instead*. Shen Wujiu said nothing. Xiaoxing drew a quiet breath. The wind across the platform dropped to a hush, as if the mountain itself was listening.
instead:1.cnHint: 我本想刻下一个词，手却自行刻下了另一个词____。
instead:1.hook: The word 'hold' shone silver, then sank into the stone without a trace.
instead:1.line: 'Your hand wrote 'hold' *instead* — trust what it knew.'

sentences.en: I had chosen the word 'rise' to carve into the trial stone.
sentences.cn: 我选择在试剑石上刻的字是"升"。

sentences.en: But when my hand touched the surface, my fingers moved on their own and wrote 'hold' *instead*.
Shen Wujiu said nothing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎什么都没说。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing drew a quiet breath.
sentences.cn: 小杏吸了口气。

sentences.en: The wind across the platform dropped to a hush, as if the mountain itself was listening.
sentences.cn: 平台上的风突然静止了，仿佛整座山都在倾听。

performance:1.en: The senior disciples lined the edges of the Trial Sword Platform to watch. Xiaoxing whispered that this was not about impressing anyone. Yet every disciple's *performance* here became part of the Sect's living record — a page no one could erase. I steadied my breath, lifted my brush, and let the first word rise from my chest like smoke.
performance:1.cnHint: 在试剑台上，每位弟子的____都会被记入门派的永久档案。
performance:1.hook: When my word left the brush, it hung in the air and refused to fall.
performance:1.line: 'Your *performance* here writes one page that will never be erased.'

sentences.en: The senior disciples lined the edges of the Trial Sword Platform to watch.
sentences.cn: 高阶弟子们排成一圈站在试剑平台的边缘来观看。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing whispered that this was not about impressing anyone.
sentences.cn: 小杏低声说这不是为了给人留下印象。

sentences.en: Yet every disciple's *performance* here became part of the Sect's living record — a page no one could erase.
I steadied my breath, lifted my brush, and let the first word rise from my chest like smoke.
sentences.cn: 我稳住呼吸，拿起笔，让第一个字像烟雾一样从我的胸腔升起。

percent:1.en: Master Qingwu told us that most disciples use only thirty *percent* of a word's true meaning when they first speak it aloud on the platform. I thought of all the weight still sleeping inside the words I had studied. The wind rose, and somewhere below the clouds a bell rang once — slow, low, final.
percent:1.cnHint: 师尊说，弟子初次开口时，往往只能用出词语真义的____之三十。
percent:1.hook: I decided, quietly, that thirty percent would not be enough for me.
percent:1.line: 'Most disciples use thirty *percent* of a word's power on their first try.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told us that most disciples use only thirty *percent* of a word's true meaning when they first speak it aloud on the platform.
I thought of all the weight still sleeping inside the words I had studied.
sentences.cn: 我想起所有那些还沉睡在我研究过的字里的重量。

sentences.en: The wind rose, and somewhere below the clouds a bell rang once — slow, low, final.
sentences.cn: 风吹起来了，云下某处一口钟缓缓、低沉地敲响了一次——最后一次。

achieve:1.en: Xiaoxing had failed the platform trial twice before. Today she stood at the stone circle with her eyes closed for a long moment, then spoke her word clearly into the open sky. To *achieve* that calm — after two failures, with every eye watching — seemed to me the hardest thing I had ever seen anyone do. The clouds below brightened as if in answer.
achieve:1.cnHint: 师妹在两次失败后终于____了那种平静，令我深感震撼。
achieve:1.hook: Her word rose, steadied, and carved itself into the air above the platform.
achieve:1.line: 'To *achieve* calm after two failures — that is the real trial.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had failed the platform trial twice before.
sentences.cn: 小杏之前已经两次失败了平台试炼。

sentences.en: Today she stood at the stone circle with her eyes closed for a long moment, then spoke her word clearly into the open sky.
sentences.cn: 今天她站在石圈里，闭上眼睛沉默了一会儿，然后清晰地把她的字喊进了开阔的天空。

sentences.en: To *achieve* that calm — after two failures, with every eye watching — seemed to me the hardest thing I had ever seen anyone do.
The clouds below brightened as if in answer.
sentences.cn: 下面的云似乎亮了起来，像是在回应。

challenge:1.en: Shen Wujiu approached the centre stone last among the senior disciples. He turned to face us, the younger ones, before he began. 'A word is not a weapon you pick up,' he said. 'It is a *challenge* you accept, every single time you speak it.' Then he pressed both hands flat to the stone, and the whole platform hummed.
challenge:1.cnHint: 师兄说，每一次开口说出一个词，都是在接受一次____。
challenge:1.hook: The hum spread from the stone into our feet, and none of us moved.
challenge:1.line: 'A word is a *challenge* you accept every single time you speak it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu approached the centre stone last among the senior disciples.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎是高阶弟子中最后一个走到中心石的。

sentences.en: He turned to face us, the younger ones, before he began.
sentences.cn: 他在开始之前转身面向我们，年轻的那些人。

sentences.en: 'A word is not a weapon you pick up,' he said.
sentences.cn: "字不是你拿起来的武器，"他说。

sentences.en: 'It is a *challenge* you accept, every single time you speak it.'
Then he pressed both hands flat to the stone, and the whole platform hummed.
sentences.cn: 然后他把双手平放在石头上，整个平台都嗡鸣起来。

power:1.en: When my turn came, I stepped onto the cold centre stone. I had one word ready. I spoke it plainly, without force. The *power* did not come from how loudly I said it — it rose from the silence I had kept before I spoke, the way a held breath gives weight to the first note of a song. Clouds curled upward beneath the platform's edge.
power:1.cnHint: 我意识到词语的____并非来自音量，而是来自开口前的那份沉默。
power:1.hook: A single white feather drifted up from the clouds and came to rest at my feet.
power:1.line: 'The *power* of a word lives in the silence before you speak it.'

sentences.en: When my turn came, I stepped onto the cold centre stone.
sentences.cn: 轮到我的时候，我踩上了冰冷的中心石。

sentences.en: I had one word ready.
sentences.cn: 我已经准备好了一个字。

sentences.en: I spoke it plainly, without force.
sentences.cn: 我平静地说出来，没有用力。

sentences.en: The *power* did not come from how loudly I said it — it rose from the silence I had kept before I spoke, the way a held breath gives weight to the first note of a song.
Clouds curled upward beneath the platform's edge.
sentences.cn: 云从平台的边缘向上卷起。

nearly:1.en: The trial platform floated high above the sea of clouds, its stone surface worn smooth by a hundred years of disciples. I stepped forward to speak the first word-formula, but my breath *nearly* failed me — the wind at this height cut through every layer of cloth. Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, calm as still water, watching.
nearly:1.cnHint: 弟子踏上试剑台，高处寒风让他____无法开口念出第一个字诀。
nearly:1.hook: Below the platform, one cloud had turned the colour of ink.
nearly:1.line: 'You *nearly* dropped the formula — hold the breath first, then the word.'

sentences.en: The trial platform floated high above the sea of clouds, its stone surface worn smooth by a hundred years of disciples.
sentences.cn: 试剑平台浮在云海的高空，石面被百年来的弟子磨得光滑。

sentences.en: I stepped forward to speak the first word-formula, but my breath *nearly* failed me — the wind at this height cut through every layer of cloth.
Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, calm as still water, watching.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在边缘，如水一般平静，在看着。

wrong:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single word-formula in the air above the trial platform. She asked me to copy it. My hand moved with confidence, but the light that answered was pale and thin. She said nothing — only pointed to one stroke I had shaped *wrong*. A small error, yet the whole formula had lost its power.
wrong:1.cnHint: 师尊指出弟子在试剑台上写下的字诀有一笔____，导致法力尽失。
wrong:1.hook: The pale light drifted downward and vanished into the clouds.
wrong:1.line: 'That one stroke is *wrong* — and one wrong stroke can cost you everything up here.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a single word-formula in the air above the trial platform.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在试炼台上空画了一个字诀。

sentences.en: She asked me to copy it.
sentences.cn: 她让我临摹它。

sentences.en: My hand moved with confidence, but the light that answered was pale and thin.
sentences.cn: 我的手很有把握，可应答的光却苍白而细弱。

sentences.en: She said nothing — only pointed to one stroke I had shaped *wrong*.
A small error, yet the whole formula had lost its power.
sentences.cn: 一个小错，整个字诀就失了力量。

variety:1.en: The trial platform held a wide *variety* of carved stones, each etched with a different word-formula — some for healing, some for lifting wind, some for drawing fire. Xiaoxing moved between them like a butterfly, touching each one lightly. I stood still, not knowing where to begin.
variety:1.cnHint: 试剑台上刻有____各异的字诀石碑，师妹轻松穿行其间，弟子却不知从何入手。
variety:1.hook: One stone at the far end glowed faintly, though no disciple had touched it.
variety:1.line: 'The *variety* here is a test — master one kind deeply before you reach for another.'

sentences.en: The trial platform held a wide *variety* of carved stones, each etched with a different word-formula — some for healing, some for lifting wind, some for drawing fire.
Xiaoxing moved between them like a butterfly, touching each one lightly.
sentences.cn: 小杏在石头之间穿梭，像一只蝴蝶，轻轻触碰每一块。

sentences.en: I stood still, not knowing where to begin.
sentences.cn: 我站着不动，不知道从何下手。

clear:1.en: I had been struggling with the wind-formula for an hour when Shen Wujiu crouched beside me on the trial platform and spoke each syllable slowly. Suddenly the meaning was *clear* — the word was not a command to the wind, but a request. I tried once more, and the air answered.
clear:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台上缓缓示范，弟子终于____地理解了风之字诀的真意。
clear:1.hook: At that moment the clouds below parted, revealing a shadow shaped like a hand.
clear:1.line: 'Now it is *clear* to you — the wind has never obeyed force, only courtesy.'

sentences.en: I had been struggling with the wind-formula for an hour when Shen Wujiu crouched beside me on the trial platform and spoke each syllable slowly.
sentences.cn: 我为了风字诀挣扎了一个小时，沈无咎蹲在试炼台上我身边，一个音节一个音节地慢慢说。

sentences.en: Suddenly the meaning was *clear* — the word was not a command to the wind, but a request.
I tried once more, and the air answered.
sentences.cn: 我又试了一次，空气应答了。

gain:1.en: At the end of the trial, Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple in silence. When she reached me, she said that today's *gain* was small but honest — I had learned to feel the shape of a formula before speaking it aloud. I bowed, trying to hide the pride warming my chest.
gain:1.cnHint: 试炼结束，师尊评价弟子今日虽____不多，却学会了感受字诀的形状。
gain:1.hook: She turned away, and for one breath her shadow stretched twice her height.
gain:1.line: 'A small *gain* on the platform today is worth more than a great claim at the desk.'

sentences.en: At the end of the trial, Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple in silence.
sentences.cn: 试炼结束时，青梧师尊无言地逐一审视每个弟子。

sentences.en: When she reached me, she said that today's *gain* was small but honest — I had learned to feel the shape of a formula before speaking it aloud.
I bowed, trying to hide the pride warming my chest.
sentences.cn: 我低眉顺眼地鞠了一躬，想掩住胸口升起的骄傲。

maybe:1.en: The stone beneath my feet hummed when I spoke the formula — a sound I had never caused before. Xiaoxing looked over with wide eyes. I did not know whether I had done something right or something dangerous. *Maybe* both, I thought, and held very still while the hum slowly faded.
maybe:1.cnHint: 弟子念出字诀后台石发出震鸣，他心想____是对的，____也是危险的。
maybe:1.hook: The hum did not fully fade — it dropped into the rock and kept moving.

sentences.en: The stone beneath my feet hummed when I spoke the formula — a sound I had never caused before.
sentences.cn: 我脚下的石头在我说出字诀时嗡鸣了——一个我从未制造过的声音。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing looked over with wide eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏睁圆了眼睛看过来。

sentences.en: I did not know whether I had done something right or something dangerous.
sentences.cn: 我不知道自己是做对了什么还是做错了什么。

sentences.en: *Maybe* both, I thought, and held very still while the hum slowly faded.

huge:1.en: When Shen Wujiu demonstrated the full storm-formula on the trial platform, the sound that followed was *huge* — a deep roll that shook the mountain and sent a ring of clouds spinning outward below us. He stepped back, breathing evenly, as though he had done nothing remarkable at all.
huge:1.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台上演示风暴字诀，发出____的轰鸣，震动了整座浮山。
huge:1.hook: The spinning ring of clouds slowed, then began to rise.
huge:1.line: 'The sound is *huge*, yes — but listen past it for the small silence inside.'

sentences.en: When Shen Wujiu demonstrated the full storm-formula on the trial platform, the sound that followed was *huge* — a deep roll that shook the mountain and sent a ring of clouds spinning outward below us.
He stepped back, breathing evenly, as though he had done nothing remarkable at all.
sentences.cn: 他退后一步，呼吸平稳，仿佛他什么了不起的事都没做过。

diet:1.en: Before the trial, Xiaoxing reminded me that a disciple's *diet* on testing days should be light — heavy food weighs the breath and blurs the tongue. I had eaten well that morning and already felt the difference: each formula came out half a beat too slow. She had been right.
diet:1.cnHint: 试炼前师妹提醒弟子，测试日的____要清淡，否则吐字会迟缓。
diet:1.hook: A thin mist rose from the platform stones, smelling of cold pine.
diet:1.line: 'Watch your *diet* before a trial — a heavy meal is the first word spoken wrong.'

sentences.en: Before the trial, Xiaoxing reminded me that a disciple's *diet* on testing days should be light — heavy food weighs the breath and blurs the tongue.
I had eaten well that morning and already felt the difference: each formula came out half a beat too slow.
sentences.cn: 我那天早上吃得很饱，已经感觉到了差别：每个字诀都慢了半拍。

sentences.en: She had been right.
sentences.cn: 她没错。

animal:1.en: On the Trial Sword Stage, a carved stone *animal* crouched at each corner — four beasts, each facing a different wind. Master Qingwu told us they were not decoration. 'They listen,' she said, 'for disciples whose hearts are not yet clean.' I felt their hollow eyes turn toward me.
animal:1.cnHint: 试剑台四角各有一只石雕____，师尊说它们会聆听弟子的内心。
animal:1.hook: One stone eye had shifted since morning.
animal:1.line: 'Every *animal* here was once a failed disciple, so I am told.'

sentences.en: On the Trial Sword Stage, a carved stone *animal* crouched at each corner — four beasts, each facing a different wind.
Master Qingwu told us they were not decoration.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊告诉我们它们不是装饰。

sentences.en: 'They listen,' she said, 'for disciples whose hearts are not yet clean.'
sentences.cn: "它们在听，"她说，"听那些心还不干净的弟子。"

sentences.en: I felt their hollow eyes turn toward me.
sentences.cn: 我感觉到它们空洞的眼睛转向了我。

goal:1.en: Shen Wujiu drew his sword in a single breath and struck three targets before the incense burned down. 'What is your *goal* today?' he asked me, sheathing the blade without looking. I had no answer ready. The targets still swayed, and the crowd on the lower path had gone very quiet.
goal:1.cnHint: 师兄问我今日上台的____是什么，我却一时语塞。
goal:1.hook: The swaying targets cast shadows shaped like question marks.
goal:1.line: 'A disciple without a *goal* is a blade without an edge.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu drew his sword in a single breath and struck three targets before the incense burned down.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎一口气拔剑，在香烧完之前击中了三个靶子。

sentences.en: 'What is your *goal* today?' he asked me, sheathing the blade without looking.
I had no answer ready.
sentences.cn: 我没有现成的答案。

sentences.en: The targets still swayed, and the crowd on the lower path had gone very quiet.
sentences.cn: 靶子还在摇晃，下面小径上的人群已经安静得可怕。

adult:1.en: I had expected the Trial Sword Stage to be filled with older students, but even the youngest *adult* here moved with a stillness I had not yet learned. Master Qingwu watched from the pavilion above, her sleeves unmoving in the wind, as though she herself were part of the mountain.
adult:1.cnHint: 台上每一位____弟子都身姿沉稳，让初来的我自叹不如。
adult:1.hook: Master Qingwu's eyes had not blinked once.
adult:1.line: 'Even the newest *adult* disciple has chosen a path — have you?'

sentences.en: I had expected the Trial Sword Stage to be filled with older students, but even the youngest *adult* here moved with a stillness I had not yet learned.
Master Qingwu watched from the pavilion above, her sleeves unmoving in the wind, as though she herself were part of the mountain.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从上面的亭子里看着我们，她的袖子在风里一动不动，就像她自己就是山的一部分。

poor:1.en: Xiaoxing missed the third target and stepped back with a quiet sigh. 'My footwork is still *poor*,' she said, not to anyone in particular, pressing one hand flat against her chest as though steadying something inside. A single cloud passed beneath the stage, and for a moment the whole platform felt untethered.
poor:1.cnHint: 小星叹息自己的步法____，台下浮云恰好从脚边飘过。
poor:1.hook: The cloud beneath her feet had stopped moving entirely.
poor:1.line: 'My steps are *poor*, but I will walk this stage again tomorrow.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing missed the third target and stepped back with a quiet sigh.
sentences.cn: 小杏第三个靶子没中，无声地叹了口气退回去。

sentences.en: 'My footwork is still *poor*,' she said, not to anyone in particular, pressing one hand flat against her chest as though steadying something inside.
A single cloud passed beneath the stage, and for a moment the whole platform felt untethered.
sentences.cn: 一片云飘过台下，一瞬间整个平台都像要漂起来了。

price:1.en: Master Qingwu set a small jade token on the railing of the Trial Sword Stage. 'Every word of power has a *price*,' she said. 'Today you pay with effort. One day the price will be steeper.' No one laughed. The token cast no shadow at all, though the sun was strong.
price:1.cnHint: 师尊在台边放下玉牌，说每一道法诀都有其____。
price:1.hook: The shadowless token began to feel warm in the air.
price:1.line: 'Know the *price* before you speak a word of power.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set a small jade token on the railing of the Trial Sword Stage.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在试剑台的栏杆上放了一个小玉牌。

sentences.en: 'Every word of power has a *price*,' she said.
'Today you pay with effort.
sentences.cn: "今天你用努力来付代价。

sentences.en: One day the price will be steeper.'
sentences.cn: 总有一天代价会更重。"

sentences.en: No one laughed.
sentences.cn: 没有人笑。

sentences.en: The token cast no shadow at all, though the sun was strong.
sentences.cn: 尽管日头很烈，那块玉牌却没有影子。

type:1.en: Shen Wujiu studied me before the match began. 'I know your *type*,' he said, almost gently. 'You watch more than you move. That is not weakness — but today, watching will not be enough.' He stepped onto the stage first, and the wind changed direction the moment his boot touched stone.
type:1.cnHint: 师兄说他认得我这种____的人，话语轻柔却暗含提醒。
type:1.hook: The wind had changed, and it did not change back.
type:1.line: 'Your *type* learns fast — so learn this before the bell rings.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu studied me before the match began.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在比试开始前仔细打量了我。

sentences.en: 'I know your *type*,' he said, almost gently.
'You watch more than you move.
sentences.cn: 你看的比动的多。

sentences.en: That is not weakness — but today, watching will not be enough.'
sentences.cn: 这不是弱点——但今天，只看是不够的。

sentences.en: He stepped onto the stage first, and the wind changed direction the moment his boot touched stone.
sentences.cn: 他率先踏上舞台，靴子一接触石头，风向就改变了。

sense:1.en: Halfway through my trial, I lost my footing on the smooth stone and felt a sudden *sense* of falling — not downward, but inward, as though the mountain itself were testing my will. Xiaoxing called my name from the edge of the stage. Her voice pulled me back like a rope.
sense:1.cnHint: 我在台上突然有一种____，仿佛不是身体而是内心在坠落。
sense:1.hook: Xiaoxing's voice still echoed long after she stopped speaking.
sense:1.line: 'Trust that *sense* — the stage is trying to read you.'

sentences.en: Halfway through my trial, I lost my footing on the smooth stone and felt a sudden *sense* of falling — not downward, but inward, as though the mountain itself were testing my will.
Xiaoxing called my name from the edge of the stage.
sentences.cn: 小杏从舞台边缘喊出我的名字。

sentences.en: Her voice pulled me back like a rope.
sentences.cn: 她的声音像一条绳子把我拉了回来。

rate:1.en: 'Your sword *rate* is too slow,' Master Qingwu said, not unkindly, after I completed the form. 'Three strikes in the time a river stone falls — that is the standard.' She held up three fingers. Behind her, the lanterns along the stage rail flickered once, as if counting the same number.
rate:1.cnHint: 师尊指出我出剑的____太慢，并以落石为喻说明要求。
rate:1.hook: The lanterns flickered a second time, though there was no wind.
rate:1.line: 'At this *rate*, the stage will forget your name by winter.'

sentences.en: 'Your sword *rate* is too slow,' Master Qingwu said, not unkindly, after I completed the form.
'Three strikes in the time a river stone falls — that is the standard.'
sentences.cn: 河石坠落的时间里要三刀——这是标准。

sentences.en: She held up three fingers.
sentences.cn: 她竖起三根手指。

sentences.en: Behind her, the lanterns along the stage rail flickered once, as if counting the same number.
sentences.cn: 她身后，舞台栏杆上的灯笼闪烁了一次，好像在数同样的数字。

action:1.en: The trial platform floated above the sea of clouds, silent as held breath. Master Qingwu raised one hand. 'Every word you speak here carries weight,' she said. 'But a word without *action* is only wind.' I stepped forward, pressed my palm to the stone, and felt the platform tremble beneath me.
action:1.cnHint: 在试剑台上，师尊告诉我，光说不练只是空谈，我鼓起勇气迈出了第一步；台面的震动让人心生不安。
action:1.hook: Beneath my palm, a crack split the stone — shaped like an eye.
action:1.line: 'A word without *action* is only wind,' Master Qingwu said softly.

sentences.en: The trial platform floated above the sea of clouds, silent as held breath.
sentences.cn: 审判台浮在云海上方，寂静得像一口屏住的气息。

sentences.cn: 青梧师尊抬起一只手。

sentences.en: 'Every word you speak here carries weight,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说：你在这里说的每句话都有分量。

sentences.en: 'But a word without *action* is only wind.'
I stepped forward, pressed my palm to the stone, and felt the platform tremble beneath me.
sentences.cn: 我向前踏了一步，把掌心贴在石头上，感到台子在我脚下颤动。

program:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a worn scroll before I climbed the steps. 'Every disciple follows the same *program*,' he said, 'three words at dawn, three words at dusk, one challenge at the platform each week.' The paper felt heavier than it looked. Above us, a bell rang once, though no wind had touched it.
program:1.cnHint: 师兄递给我一份修炼____，说每位弟子都要遵守，可那纸卷握在手中却重得出奇。
program:1.hook: The bell rang again — but there was no bell tower on this mountain.
program:1.line: 'Every disciple follows the same *program*,' Shen Wujiu said, pressing the scroll into my hands.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a worn scroll before I climbed the steps.
sentences.cn: 我爬上台阶前，沈无咎递给我一卷磨旧了的纸。

sentences.en: 'Every disciple follows the same *program*,' he said, 'three words at dawn, three words at dusk, one challenge at the platform each week.'
The paper felt heavier than it looked.
sentences.cn: 纸摸起来比看起来沉。

sentences.en: Above us, a bell rang once, though no wind had touched it.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶，一口钟敲响了一次，但没有风触及它。

situation:1.en: I had spoken the wrong word on the trial platform, and the clouds below began to rise. Xiaoxing pulled me back by the sleeve. 'You must read the *situation* before you speak,' she said, her voice low and steady. 'The platform tests intent, not only sound.' The rising clouds swallowed the lowest step.
situation:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台上念错了字，师妹提醒我要先看清____，云雾已经悄悄吞没了最底层的台阶。
situation:1.hook: The second step vanished into white mist before either of us moved.
situation:1.line: 'You must read the *situation* before you speak,' Xiaoxing warned, watching the clouds rise.

sentences.en: I had spoken the wrong word on the trial platform, and the clouds below began to rise.
sentences.cn: 我在审判台上说了错的字，下面的云开始上升。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pulled me back by the sleeve.
sentences.cn: 小杏拉住我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'You must read the *situation* before you speak,' she said, her voice low and steady.
'The platform tests intent, not only sound.'

sentences.en: The rising clouds swallowed the lowest step.
sentences.cn: 上升的云吞没了最下面的一级台阶。

order:1.en: On the trial platform, the words could not be spoken in any *order* one pleased. Master Qingwu had been clear: root word first, then branch, then flower. I had reversed root and flower, and now the stone glowed a pale, warning red. Somewhere in the sea of clouds, something large shifted and turned toward the light.
order:1.cnHint: 师尊说词语必须按特定____吟唱，我念反了，石台泛出红光，云海深处有什么东西动了。
order:1.hook: The red glow pulsed once, like a slow and steady heartbeat.
order:1.line: 'Speak them in the correct *order* — root, branch, flower,' Master Qingwu instructed firmly.

sentences.en: On the trial platform, the words could not be spoken in any *order* one pleased.
Master Qingwu had been clear: root word first, then branch, then flower.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说得很清楚：根字在先，然后是枝字，最后是花字。

sentences.en: I had reversed root and flower, and now the stone glowed a pale, warning red.
sentences.cn: 我把根字和花字反了，现在石头发出淡淡的、警告般的红光。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the sea of clouds, something large shifted and turned toward the light.
sentences.cn: 在云海的某个地方，什么庞大的东西翻身转向了那道光。

event:1.en: The platform trial was the most important *event* of the new disciples' first month. Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, arms folded, watching each of us with calm eyes. When my turn came, I breathed in the cold mountain air and let the word rise from my chest rather than my throat. The clouds below stilled, listening.
event:1.cnHint: 试剑台考核是新弟子入门第一个月最重要的____，轮到我时，云海忽然平静下来，像在倾听。
event:1.hook: Then one white cloud, and only one, began to move upstream.
event:1.line: 'This *event* will mark you — step forward when you are called,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: The platform trial was the most important *event* of the new disciples' first month.
Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, arms folded, watching each of us with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在边缘，双臂交叉，用平静的眼神看着我们每一个人。

sentences.en: When my turn came, I breathed in the cold mountain air and let the word rise from my chest rather than my throat.
sentences.cn: 轮到我的时候，我吸进冷山风，让字从胸腔而不是喉咙里升起。

sentences.en: The clouds below stilled, listening.
sentences.cn: 下面的云停住了，在倾听。

account:1.en: After I descended the platform, Master Qingwu asked for a full *account* of what I had felt when the stone lit beneath my hand. I searched for the right words — warmth, then resistance, then something like grief. She listened without moving. When I finished, she looked past me, toward the horizon, and said nothing for a long time.
account:1.cnHint: 我从台上下来，师尊要我详细____自己触碰石台时的感受，听完后她望向远处，久久沉默。
account:1.hook: At the horizon, a second sun — faint and cold — blinked once and disappeared.
account:1.line: 'Give me a full *account* of what you felt the moment the stone responded,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: After I descended the platform, Master Qingwu asked for a full *account* of what I had felt when the stone lit beneath my hand.
I searched for the right words — warmth, then resistance, then something like grief.
sentences.cn: 我搜索着恰当的词——温暖，然后是阻力，然后是某种悲伤。

sentences.en: She listened without moving.
sentences.cn: 她一动不动地听着。

sentences.en: When I finished, she looked past me, toward the horizon, and said nothing for a long time.
sentences.cn: 当我说完，她越过我看向地平线，很久都没有说话。

degree:1.en: Each word spoken on the trial platform was judged by *degree* — how deeply it had taken root in the speaker's spirit. A shallow word produced a flicker; a rooted one produced steady light. My word that afternoon produced something between the two: a slow pulse, neither proud nor weak. Shen Wujiu marked his scroll and said simply, 'Again, tomorrow.'
degree:1.cnHint: 试剑台评判每个灵字扎根的____，我今天的表现不好不坏，师兄只是平静地说明天再来。
degree:1.hook: As I turned to leave, the pulse in the stone quickened — though I was no longer touching it.
degree:1.line: 'The platform measures *degree* of root, not volume of voice,' Shen Wujiu noted, writing something down.

sentences.en: Each word spoken on the trial platform was judged by *degree* — how deeply it had taken root in the speaker's spirit.
A shallow word produced a flicker; a rooted one produced steady light.
sentences.cn: 浅薄的字会产生闪烁；生根的字会产生稳定的光。

sentences.en: My word that afternoon produced something between the two: a slow pulse, neither proud nor weak.
sentences.cn: 我那个下午说的字产生了介于两者之间的东西：缓慢的脉动，既不骄傲也不微弱。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu marked his scroll and said simply, 'Again, tomorrow.'
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在他的纸上做了记号，简单地说：明天再来。

mind:1.en: The trial platform floated above a white sea of clouds, wide and silent. Master Qingwu set a single word-herb at its center and stepped back. 'Read it,' she said. I closed my eyes. I let my *mind* grow still, like water before dawn, and the word rose into me like warmth. The herb glowed gold.
mind:1.cnHint: 我在试剑台上让____平静下来，感受到了灵草中的力量。
mind:1.hook: But the herb's light flickered once — then turned cold blue.
mind:1.line: 'A quiet *mind* is the first sword you will ever need,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The trial platform floated above a white sea of clouds, wide and silent.
sentences.cn: 审判台浮在白色的云海上方，宽阔而寂静。

sentences.cn: 那株草发出了金光。

rise:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the trial platform and spoke a word-formula into the open air. Slowly, three stone discs began to *rise* from the clouds below, each one carrying a different herb. The sect elders watched in silence. I gripped my robe and counted the discs, wondering which one was meant for me.
rise:1.cnHint: 师兄念出咒文，三块石盘从云海中____，各承载着一株灵草。
rise:1.hook: The third disc carried no herb — only a shadow shaped like a hand.
rise:1.line: 'Watch the *rise* of the stones and choose before they stop,' Shen Wujiu said.

The sect elders watched in silence.

sentences.en: I gripped my robe and counted the discs, wondering which one was meant for me.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧攥住衣袍，数着石盘，想知道哪一个是给我的。

prove:1.en: Xiaoxing had been a disciple for only one season, yet she stepped onto the trial platform without fear. She held the word-herb to the light, whispered its name, and released it. It floated. 'Anyone can carry a word,' Master Qingwu said softly, 'but today you *prove* you can set one free.' The whole sect went quiet.

prove:1.hook: The herb drifted upward — then stopped, trembling, at the height of Master Qingwu's eyes.
prove:1.line: 'This is your chance to *prove* the word belongs to you,' Xiaoxing told me, eyes bright.

message:1.en: Before the trial, Shen Wujiu pressed a folded leaf into my hand. Inside, a single word-formula glowed faintly — a *message* written in herb-light that only I could read. It said: breathe first, speak second. I stepped onto the platform, unfolded the leaf one more time, and let the warmth of his words steady my feet.

development:1.en: Master Qingwu kept a record of every disciple's trial on thin cloud-paper. She called it a map of *development* — not of power, but of understanding. development:1.line: 'Your *development* is real, but it is not yet finished,' Master Qingwu said, brush in hand.

later:1.en: I failed the first word on the trial platform. The herb fell before I finished speaking. I stepped back, ashamed. Master Qingwu only said, '*Later*, you will understand why it fell.' later:1.hook: The fallen herb lay on the stone, still faintly glowing — pointing toward the east peak.
later:1.line: '*Later* is not failure — it is simply the word waiting for the right moment,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.cn: 我在试剑台上第一个字就失手了。

sentences.en: The herb fell before I finished speaking.
sentences.cn: 我还没说完，草就掉了下去。

sentences.en: I stepped back, ashamed.

maintain:1.en: The trial platform requires total stillness. Even a trembling hand can break the bond between disciple and herb. maintain:1.line: '*Maintain* the stillness and the word will come to you on its own,' Shen Wujiu said.

traditional:1.en: On the broad stone platform of the Trial Sword Stage, every new disciple stood in a long, silent row. Master Qingwu walked the line slowly, studying each face. 'The *traditional* opening rite demands that you draw your sword before the morning bell,' she said. 'Let the clouds below be your witness.'

traditional:1.hook: One sword, however, refused to leave its sheath.
traditional:1.line: 'The *traditional* rite does not forgive a hesitant hand.'

sentences.en: On the broad stone platform of the Trial Sword Stage, every new disciple stood in a long, silent row.
sentences.cn: 在宽阔的试剑台石台上，每个新弟子排成一条长长的沉默队列。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked the line slowly, studying each face.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊缓缓沿着队伍走过，打量每一张脸。

sentences.en: 'The *traditional* opening rite demands that you draw your sword before the morning bell,' she said.
'Let the clouds below be your witness.'
sentences.cn: '就让下方的云为你作证吧。'

expert:1.en: Shen Wujiu moved across the Trial Sword Stage with quiet ease, each step landing without a sound. Xiaoxing watched from the edge, eyes wide. 'He is already an *expert* in the Cloud Step form,' she whispered to me, 'though he only finished the first scroll last week.' Above us, the wind held its breath.
expert:1.cnHint: 小星悄声告诉叙述者，师兄在云步剑法上已是一位____。
expert:1.hook: Then Shen Wujiu paused, staring at something only he could see.
expert:1.line: 'An *expert* does not hurry — the blade arrives before the thought.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu moved across the Trial Sword Stage with quiet ease, each step landing without a sound.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎轻松自在地穿过试剑台，每一步都无声地落地。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watched from the edge, eyes wide.
sentences.cn: 小杏从边上看着，眼睛睁得很大。
