sentences.en: 'He is already an *expert* in the Cloud Step form,' she whispered to me, 'though he only finished the first scroll last week.'
Above us, the wind held its breath.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的风屏住了呼吸。

member:1.en: A carved stone pillar at the entrance of the Trial Sword Stage bore the names of every *member* of the Cloud Sea Sect who had ever passed the rite. I pressed my fingers against the cold surface, reading name after name climbing toward the clouds. My own name was not yet there. It would be, by sunset — or it would never be.
member:1.cnHint: 试剑台入口的石柱上，刻着所有曾通过考验的门派____之名。
member:1.hook: A single name near the top had been quietly erased.
member:1.line: 'Every *member* who stands here carries the weight of those names.'

sentences.en: A carved stone pillar at the entrance of the Trial Sword Stage bore the names of every *member* of the Cloud Sea Sect who had ever passed the rite.
I pressed my fingers against the cold surface, reading name after name climbing toward the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我把手指按在冷硬的石面上，一个一个名字往上读，它们攀向云层。

sentences.en: My own name was not yet there.
sentences.cn: 我的名字还不在上面。

sentences.en: It would be, by sunset — or it would never be.
sentences.cn: 日落前它会在，要么就永远不会在。

heart:1.en: Master Qingwu stopped at the exact centre of the Trial Sword Stage and pressed one hand flat against the stone. 'This point,' she said softly, 'is the *heart* of the platform — the place where the mountain's breath rises strongest.' I stepped closer and felt a faint pulse through my boots, steady as a drum deep underground.
heart:1.cnHint: 师尊指出，试剑台正中央是整座台子灵气最强的____所在。
heart:1.hook: The pulse skipped once, then went still.
heart:1.line: 'Stand at the *heart* and let it decide whether you belong here.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stopped at the exact centre of the Trial Sword Stage and pressed one hand flat against the stone.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊走到试剑台正中央，一只手贴在石头上。

sentences.en: 'This point,' she said softly, 'is the *heart* of the platform — the place where the mountain's breath rises strongest.'
I stepped closer and felt a faint pulse through my boots, steady as a drum deep underground.
sentences.cn: 我走得更近了，感到靴子里传来一阵微弱的脉搏，稳定如同地下深处的鼓声。

within:1.en: The trial platform floated above the sea of clouds, wide and still. Master Qingwu drew a circle of light around me. 'Speak the word of wind,' she said, 'and keep its meaning *within* your breath — do not let it scatter.' I breathed, and the word held. A single white feather rose from nowhere and hung in the air before me.
within:1.cnHint: 师尊要我把风之词的含义____一口气之中，不让它消散。
within:1.hook: The feather did not fall — it began to spin.
within:1.line: 'Keep the meaning *within* your breath, or the word will break the sky.'

sentences.en: The trial platform floated above the sea of clouds, wide and still.
sentences.cn: 试剑台浮在云海上方，宽阔而平静。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle of light around me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我周围画了一个光的圆圈。

sentences.en: 'Speak the word of wind,' she said, 'and keep its meaning *within* your breath — do not let it scatter.'
I breathed, and the word held.
sentences.cn: 我呼吸了一下，字就稳住了。

sentences.en: A single white feather rose from nowhere and hung in the air before me.
sentences.cn: 一根白色的羽毛从虚无中升起，悬浮在我眼前。

either:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood at one edge of the trial platform, Xiaoxing at the other. Both had spoken their words flawlessly. Master Qingwu turned to me and said, 'You may choose the word of stone or the word of water. I will not guide you; *either* path demands full courage.' My hand trembled over the two glowing scrolls. Below us, the clouds turned dark.
either:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，石之词或水之词____都需要完全的勇气，她不会给我指引。
either:1.hook: One scroll was warm; the other had no temperature at all.
either:1.line: '*Either* word will test you — but only one will answer you back.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at one edge of the trial platform, Xiaoxing at the other.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在试剑台的一边，小杏站在另一边。

sentences.en: Both had spoken their words flawlessly.
sentences.cn: 两人都完美无缺地说出了自己的字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu turned to me and said, 'You may choose the word of stone or the word of water.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊转向我说，'你可以选石之字或水之字。

sentences.en: I will not guide you; *either* path demands full courage.'
My hand trembled over the two glowing scrolls.
sentences.cn: 我的手在两卷发光的册子上方颤抖着。

sentences.en: Below us, the clouds turned dark.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云转成了黑色。

various:1.en: Before the trial began, Shen Wujiu led me across the platform and named *various* marks carved into its stone: a rising wave, a still flame, a closed eye, a broken root. 'Each mark is a lesson someone failed,' he said quietly. I counted twelve marks. The wind across the platform carried a faint, low hum, as though the stone itself were still remembering.
various:1.cnHint: 师兄带我看了试剑台上____种刻痕，说每一道都是某人失败的课。
various:1.hook: There was space for a thirteenth mark, freshly smoothed.
various:1.line: '*Various* disciples have stood here — few left without a scar.'

sentences.en: Before the trial began, Shen Wujiu led me across the platform and named *various* marks carved into its stone: a rising wave, a still flame, a closed eye, a broken root.
'Each mark is a lesson someone failed,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: '每一个刻痕都是某个人失败的功课，'他轻声说。

sentences.en: I counted twelve marks.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，一共十二个。

sentences.en: The wind across the platform carried a faint, low hum, as though the stone itself were still remembering.
sentences.cn: 平台上的风带着一阵微弱的低鸣，好像石头本身还在回忆着什么。

main:1.en: The trial platform had three rings: an outer ring for breath, a middle ring for form, and an inner ring for meaning. Master Qingwu pointed to the center. 'The *main* purpose of today is not to pass,' she said. 'It is to hear what the word says back to you.' I stepped into the inner ring. The clouds below went completely silent.
main:1.cnHint: 师尊说今天的____目的不是通过试验，而是听清词语对你说了什么。
main:1.hook: In the silence, something beneath the clouds answered first.
main:1.line: 'The *main* lesson of this platform is not power — it is listening.'

sentences.en: The trial platform had three rings: an outer ring for breath, a middle ring for form, and an inner ring for meaning.
sentences.cn: 试炼台有三重圆环：外圈是气，中圈是形，内圈是意。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pointed to the center.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊指向中心。

sentences.en: 'The *main* purpose of today is not to pass,' she said.
'It is to hear what the word says back to you.'
sentences.cn: '是去听那个字对你说什么。'

sentences.en: I stepped into the inner ring.
sentences.cn: 我踏入了内圈。

sentences.en: The clouds below went completely silent.
sentences.cn: 下面的云彻底沉默了。

employee:1.en: A supply boat docked at the edge of the platform, bearing fresh scrolls from the valley below. The man who carried them wore a plain grey robe and moved with careful steps. 'He is no disciple,' Xiaoxing whispered to me. 'He is an *employee* of the Scroll House — he cannot read the words he carries, yet he never drops a single one.' I watched him go. He did not look up at the sky once.
employee:1.cnHint: 小星悄声告诉我，送卷轴的人是书卷阁的____，他虽不识词语，却从不失手。
employee:1.hook: One scroll in his bundle glowed faintly through the cloth.
employee:1.line: 'An *employee* of the Scroll House knows more than he is allowed to say.'

sentences.en: A supply boat docked at the edge of the platform, bearing fresh scrolls from the valley below.
sentences.cn: 一艘补给船停靠在平台边缘，船上装着从下面山谷运来的新卷轴。

sentences.en: The man who carried them wore a plain grey robe and moved with careful steps.
sentences.cn: 抬卷轴的人穿着素灰色的袍子，步子迈得很谨慎。

sentences.en: 'He is no disciple,' Xiaoxing whispered to me.
sentences.cn: '他不是弟子，'小杏在我耳边低声说。

sentences.en: 'He is an *employee* of the Scroll House — he cannot read the words he carries, yet he never drops a single one.'
I watched him go.
sentences.cn: 我看着他离开。

sentences.en: He did not look up at the sky once.
sentences.cn: 他没有抬头看过一次天空。

class:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the center of the trial platform as the sun rose behind the far peaks. 'This is not a lesson in a hall,' she said. 'This *class* has no walls and no seats — the sky is your ceiling and the cloud is your floor.' Xiaoxing pressed her scroll to her chest. I felt the word inside mine begin to stir, warm and restless. Then the platform shuddered once, without wind.
class:1.cnHint: 师尊说这堂____没有四壁，以天为顶，以云为地。
class:1.hook: The shudder came again, deeper, from somewhere far below.
class:1.line: 'This *class* begins when the platform decides you are ready — not before.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the center of the trial platform as the sun rose behind the far peaks.
sentences.cn: 太阳从远处的山峰后升起时，青梧师尊把我们召集到试炼台的中心。

sentences.en: 'This is not a lesson in a hall,' she said.
sentences.cn: '这不是在殿堂里的课，'她说。

sentences.en: 'This *class* has no walls and no seats — the sky is your ceiling and the cloud is your floor.'
Xiaoxing pressed her scroll to her chest.
sentences.cn: 小杏把卷轴紧贴着胸口。

sentences.en: I felt the word inside mine begin to stir, warm and restless.
sentences.cn: 我感觉到自己卷轴里的字开始躁动，温热而不安。

sentences.en: Then the platform shuddered once, without wind.
sentences.cn: 然后试炼台震颤了一下，没有风。

behavior:1.en: After my first attempt at speaking the word of fire, the flame I made bent sideways and singed the stone. Shen Wujiu crouched beside the mark it left. 'The word did not fail you,' he said. 'Your *behavior* toward it did — you rushed it, like ordering a river instead of asking one.' He stood and offered me his own scroll to study. Above us, a cloud shaped like an open hand drifted slowly apart.
behavior:1.cnHint: 师兄说，是我对待词语的____出了问题——我在命令它，而不是请求它。
behavior:1.hook: The cloud's fingers dissolved one by one into the still air.
behavior:1.line: 'Your *behavior* toward a word tells the word whether to trust you.'

sentences.en: After my first attempt at speaking the word of fire, the flame I made bent sideways and singed the stone.
sentences.cn: 我第一次试着说出火的字后，我制造出来的火焰向一侧弯曲，烧焦了石头。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crouched beside the mark it left.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎蹲在烧痕旁边。

sentences.en: 'The word did not fail you,' he said.
sentences.cn: '那个字没有背弃你，'他说。

sentences.en: 'Your *behavior* toward it did — you rushed it, like ordering a river instead of asking one.'
He stood and offered me his own scroll to study.
sentences.cn: 他站起身，递给我他的卷轴让我研究。

sentences.en: Above us, a cloud shaped like an open hand drifted slowly apart.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶上，一朵像张开的手掌一样的云慢慢飘散了。

disease:1.en: Xiaoxing found a scroll near the edge of the platform with its ink faded to grey. She brought it to Master Qingwu, who held it to the light and said, 'This word has a *disease* — doubt has lived inside it too long, and it has forgotten its own meaning.' She set it down gently at the platform's rim. That evening, a thin red line appeared along the horizon where there had never been one before.
disease:1.cnHint: 师尊说那卷轴上的词语染了____——疑虑在其中住得太久，词语忘了自己的意思。
disease:1.hook: The red line on the horizon pulsed, once, like a held breath released.
disease:1.line: 'A word with this *disease* will cure itself — or consume the one who speaks it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found a scroll near the edge of the platform with its ink faded to grey.
sentences.cn: 小杏在平台边缘找到了一卷卷轴，墨迹已经褪成了灰色。

sentences.en: She brought it to Master Qingwu, who held it to the light and said, 'This word has a *disease* — doubt has lived inside it too long, and it has forgotten its own meaning.'
She set it down gently at the platform's rim.
sentences.cn: 她轻轻地把它放在了平台的边缘。

sentences.en: That evening, a thin red line appeared along the horizon where there had never been one before.
sentences.cn: 那天傍晚，地平线上出现了一条细细的红线，之前从来没有过。

key:1.en: The trial platform stretched wide under an open sky, its stones worn smooth by ten thousand footsteps. Master Qingwu placed a single carved stone in my palm. 'Every word you learn,' she said, 'is a *key* that opens one sealed gate of the mountain.' I closed my fingers around it and felt the cold hum of something waiting to be unlocked.
key:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，每一个掌握的词语都是打开山门的____。
key:1.hook: But one gate, she had never mentioned, stood already ajar.
key:1.line: 'A single *key* word, spoken with true breath, can open what iron cannot.'

sentences.en: The trial platform stretched wide under an open sky, its stones worn smooth by ten thousand footsteps.
sentences.cn: 试炼台在开阔的天空下伸展开来，石头被十万次的脚步磨得光滑。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a single carved stone in my palm.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一块刻了花纹的石头放在我的手心里。

sentences.en: 'Every word you learn,' she said, 'is a *key* that opens one sealed gate of the mountain.'
I closed my fingers around it and felt the cold hum of something waiting to be unlocked.
sentences.cn: 我合起手指，感受到了冷的嗡鸣，好像有什么东西在等待被打开。

issue:1.en: On the trial platform, Shen Wujiu spread three worn scrolls across the stone railing. 'The *issue* is not your voice,' he said, studying my failed attempt to lift a cloud-petal with a spoken word. 'The issue is that you say the word without meaning it.' Around us, wind moved through the scrolls like a quiet argument.
issue:1.cnHint: 师兄指出，我吟词失败的____不在于声音，而在于缺乏真心。
issue:1.hook: The third scroll had begun to glow at its edges, all on its own.
issue:1.line: 'The real *issue* is that you speak the word but do not believe it.'

sentences.en: On the trial platform, Shen Wujiu spread three worn scrolls across the stone railing.
sentences.cn: 在试炼台上，沈无咎在石头栏杆上铺开了三卷破旧的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'The *issue* is not your voice,' he said, studying my failed attempt to lift a cloud-petal with a spoken word.
'The issue is that you say the word without meaning it.'
sentences.cn: '问题是你说那个字的时候没有真正的意思在里面。'

sentences.en: Around us, wind moved through the scrolls like a quiet argument.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，风在卷轴间吹过，像一场无声的争论。

against:1.en: Xiaoxing stood at the far edge of the trial platform, her back *against* the low stone wall, watching clouds drift far below. 'You have to feel the mountain push back,' she told me without turning. 'Every true word meets resistance. If nothing pushes against you, the word has no power.' A distant rumble rose from the sea of clouds beneath us.
against:1.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，每个真正的词语都会遭到____，无阻力则无力量。
against:1.hook: The rumble below grew louder, and the wall behind her began to vibrate.
against:1.line: 'Stand *against* the wind when you speak — that resistance is what makes the word real.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood at the far edge of the trial platform, her back *against* the low stone wall, watching clouds drift far below.
'You have to feel the mountain push back,' she told me without turning.
sentences.cn: '你必须感受到山在推你回来，'她没有转身，这样对我说。

sentences.en: 'Every true word meets resistance.
sentences.cn: '每一个真实的字都会遇到阻力。

sentences.en: If nothing pushes against you, the word has no power.'
sentences.cn: 如果没有东西推你，那个字就没有力量。'

sentences.en: A distant rumble rose from the sea of clouds beneath us.
sentences.cn: 一声遥远的隆隆声从我们下面的云海里升起来。

matter:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle on the trial platform with white chalk. 'Step inside,' she said, 'and tell me: what is the *matter* with the air here?' I stepped in and felt it — a dense stillness, as if the air itself had forgotten how to move. Words could heal or harm in such a place, she explained. Nothing here was simple.
matter:1.cnHint: 师尊让我感受圆圈内的异样，问我这里的空气有什么____。
matter:1.hook: When I stepped back out, my shadow remained inside the circle.
matter:1.line: 'The *matter* here is simple: dead air cannot carry a living word.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle on the trial platform with white chalk.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用白粉笔在试炼台上画了一个圆。

sentences.en: 'Step inside,' she said, 'and tell me: what is the *matter* with the air here?'
I stepped in and felt it — a dense stillness, as if the air itself had forgotten how to move.
sentences.cn: 我踏了进去，感受到了——一种稠密的静止，好像空气本身都忘记了怎么流动。

sentences.en: Words could heal or harm in such a place, she explained.
sentences.cn: 她解释说，在这样的地方，字可以医治也可以伤害。

sentences.en: Nothing here was simple.
sentences.cn: 这里没有什么是简单的。

raise:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the centre of the trial platform and spoke a single syllable. Slowly, a flat stone *raised* itself from the ground and hovered at eye level. 'Now you try,' he said, stepping aside. I breathed, I spoke, and the stone shivered — but did not rise. He said nothing. The stone settled back, patient as the mountain itself.
raise:1.cnHint: 师兄念出一个音节，将石头____到空中，然后让我尝试。
raise:1.hook: A thin crack had appeared across the stone I had failed to lift.
raise:1.line: 'To *raise* even a pebble, your word must carry the weight of your whole breath.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the centre of the trial platform and spoke a single syllable.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在试炼台的中心，说了一个音节。

sentences.en: Slowly, a flat stone *raised* itself from the ground and hovered at eye level.
'Now you try,' he said, stepping aside.
sentences.cn: '现在轮到你了，'他说着，往旁边站开。

sentences.en: I breathed, I spoke, and the stone shivered — but did not rise.
sentences.cn: 我吸了口气，说出了字，石头颤动了——但没有升起来。

sentences.en: He said nothing.
sentences.cn: 他什么都没说。

sentences.en: The stone settled back, patient as the mountain itself.
sentences.cn: 石头沉了下去，像山一样耐心。

option:1.en: The trial platform offered three paths marked by coloured flags: red, white, and blue. Master Qingwu said I could walk only one. 'Each *option* leads to a different word-test,' she explained, her sleeves folding in the wind. 'Choose by what you lack, not by what you fear.' I looked at the red flag. It trembled as if it already knew my answer.
option:1.cnHint: 师尊说，台上有三条路，每条____通往不同的考验。
option:1.hook: As I reached for the red flag, the blue one snapped and fell.
option:1.line: 'Every *option* on this platform was placed here by a disciple who once stood exactly where you stand.'

sentences.en: The trial platform offered three paths marked by coloured flags: red, white, and blue.
sentences.cn: 试炼台上有三条路，用彩旗标着：红、白、蓝。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said I could walk only one.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊说我只能走一条。

sentences.en: 'Each *option* leads to a different word-test,' she explained, her sleeves folding in the wind.
'Choose by what you lack, not by what you fear.'
sentences.cn: '根据你缺少的东西来选，而不是根据你害怕的东西。'

sentences.en: I looked at the red flag.
sentences.cn: 我看着那面红旗。

sentences.en: It trembled as if it already knew my answer.
sentences.cn: 它颤动着，好像已经知道了我的答案。

society:1.en: Before the trial, Shen Wujiu explained that the Cloud Sea Sect was not merely a school. 'It is a *society* of word-keepers,' he said, sweeping one arm toward the ring of disciples gathering on the platform. 'When you master a word, you do not own it — you join all those who carry it.' I looked at the assembled faces and felt, for the first time, very small.
society:1.cnHint: 师兄解释说，云海宗是一个守护词语的____，掌握一个词意味着加入所有承载它的人。
society:1.hook: One face in the ring did not belong to anyone I had ever seen before.
society:1.line: 'A *society* of word-keepers grows only when each member adds one true word to the whole.'

sentences.en: Before the trial, Shen Wujiu explained that the Cloud Sea Sect was not merely a school.
sentences.cn: 在试炼之前，沈无咎解释说云海宗不仅仅是一所学派。

sentences.en: 'It is a *society* of word-keepers,' he said, sweeping one arm toward the ring of disciples gathering on the platform.
'When you master a word, you do not own it — you join all those who carry it.'
sentences.cn: 当你掌握一个词时，你并不拥有它——你加入了所有承载它的人。

sentences.en: I looked at the assembled faces and felt, for the first time, very small.
sentences.cn: 我看着聚集的众人，第一次感到自己非常渺小。

whole:1.en: At the end of the trial, Master Qingwu asked me to recite every word I had learned and let them join in a single breath. When I did, the platform hummed. 'Good,' she said. 'The *whole* is always stronger than the parts.' The sea of clouds below brightened as if something deep inside it had heard, and approved.
whole:1.cnHint: 师尊让我将所学的词全部融为一口气，说明____大于部分之和。
whole:1.hook: In the clouds below, a second mountain peak had silently risen into view.
whole:1.line: 'Only when every word joins the *whole* will the mountain finally answer you.'

sentences.en: At the end of the trial, Master Qingwu asked me to recite every word I had learned and let them join in a single breath.
sentences.cn: 试炼结束时，青梧师尊让我背诵我学过的每一个词，让它们在一口气中汇聚。

sentences.en: When I did, the platform hummed.
sentences.cn: 我这样做时，平台发出了嗡鸣声。

sentences.en: 'Good,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说："很好。"

sentences.en: 'The *whole* is always stronger than the parts.'
The sea of clouds below brightened as if something deep inside it had heard, and approved.
sentences.cn: 下方的云海亮了起来，仿佛它深处的什么东西听到了，并表示赞许。

worker:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, a *worker* carried a heavy basket of spirit-stones to the edge, then stepped back and bowed. Shen Wujiu watched the man leave and said the stones were already set in a circle. I looked at the glowing ring and felt a strange pull in my chest.
worker:1.cnHint: 试剑台边，一名____将灵石摆成圆阵，沈无咎低声说这是为今日试剑所备。
worker:1.hook: The stones began to hum before anyone drew a sword.
worker:1.line: 'That *worker* placed the last stone wrong — do not step inside the ring.'

sentences.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, a *worker* carried a heavy basket of spirit-stones to the edge, then stepped back and bowed.
Shen Wujiu watched the man leave and said the stones were already set in a circle.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看着那个人离开，说这些石头已经按圆形排列好了。

sentences.en: I looked at the glowing ring and felt a strange pull in my chest.
sentences.cn: 我看着发光的圆环，感到胸口有一种奇异的拉扯。

control:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the centre of the platform and told us to feel the wind, not fight it. 'A sword without *control* is only falling metal,' she said. Xiaoxing gripped her blade tighter. I let mine rest lightly in my palm and felt the air grow still around the edge.
control:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在台上教导我们，失去____的剑术只是莽撞的金属。
control:1.hook: Then a second wind rose from below the clouds, cold and uninvited.
control:1.line: '*Control* the breath first, and the blade will follow on its own.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the centre of the platform and told us to feel the wind, not fight it.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在平台中央，让我们去感受风，而不是与它对抗。

sentences.en: 'A sword without *control* is only falling metal,' she said.
Xiaoxing gripped her blade tighter.
sentences.cn: 小杏紧紧握住剑柄。

sentences.en: I let mine rest lightly in my palm and felt the air grow still around the edge.
sentences.cn: 我让剑轻轻搁在掌心，感到剑刃周围的空气渐渐静止了。

product:1.en: Shen Wujiu held up a small jar of silver paste and said it was the *product* of ten nights refining cloud-moss and river-sand. He spread a thin line along my sword's edge. The paste caught the morning light and glowed faintly, and I understood why the older disciples never showed this step to anyone.
product:1.cnHint: 沈无咎展示他炼制的银色剑膏，那是十夜苦工的____，涂上后剑刃微微发光。
product:1.hook: The glow deepened — far brighter than cloud-moss alone should allow.
product:1.line: 'This paste is the *product* of failure as much as skill — remember that.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu held up a small jar of silver paste and said it was the *product* of ten nights refining cloud-moss and river-sand.
He spread a thin line along my sword's edge.
sentences.cn: 他在我剑刃的边缘涂上了一条细线。

sentences.en: The paste caught the morning light and glowed faintly, and I understood why the older disciples never showed this step to anyone.
sentences.cn: 膏体在晨光下闪烁着微弱的光芒，我理解了为什么年长的弟子从不向任何人展示这一步。

practice:1.en: Every morning the disciples gathered on the platform before sunrise for sword *practice*. Today the mist lay so thick I could not see Xiaoxing's face two steps away. I swung the blade slowly, following the form by memory alone. Somewhere in the white air, steel rang against steel and then went silent.
practice:1.cnHint: 清晨的剑法____在迷雾中进行，我只能凭记忆挥剑，忽然听到迷雾深处传来兵器相撞的声音。
practice:1.hook: No one had been scheduled to spar at that hour.
practice:1.line: 'Daily *practice* on this platform is how the clouds learn to fear us.'

sentences.en: Every morning the disciples gathered on the platform before sunrise for sword *practice*.
Today the mist lay so thick I could not see Xiaoxing's face two steps away.
sentences.cn: 今天雾气太浓，我看不清两步外小杏的脸。

sentences.en: I swung the blade slowly, following the form by memory alone.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓挥舞着剑，仅凭记忆跟随着剑势。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the white air, steel rang against steel and then went silent.
sentences.cn: 在白色的空气中某处，钢铁碰撞，然后陷入了寂静。

environment:1.en: Master Qingwu said that a sword-user must read the *environment* before drawing a blade. I looked: wet stone underfoot, a sharp crosswind from the east, and a thin crack running through the platform's centre. Shen Wujiu nodded as if he had already noted all three. I had missed the crack entirely.
environment:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊要求我们在出剑前先读懂周围的____，而我竟没有注意到台面中央的裂缝。
environment:1.hook: The crack was longer than it had been yesterday.
environment:1.line: 'The *environment* speaks before every fight — learn to listen to it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said that a sword-user must read the *environment* before drawing a blade.
I looked: wet stone underfoot, a sharp crosswind from the east, and a thin crack running through the platform's centre.
sentences.cn: 我看了看：脚下湿润的石头、从东方吹来的尖锐侧风，还有穿过平台中央的一道细裂。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu nodded as if he had already noted all three.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎点了点头，仿佛他早已注意到这三处。

sentences.en: I had missed the crack entirely.
sentences.cn: 我完全没有看到那条裂纹。

system:1.en: Carved into the stone pillar at the platform's entrance was a *system* of symbols, each marking a different level of trial. Xiaoxing traced one with her finger and asked what the highest mark meant. No one answered. The pillar was older than the sect itself, and some marks had no names left in any book.
system:1.cnHint: 入口石柱上刻有一套试炼____，小星指着最高的符文问其含义，却无人能答。
system:1.hook: One symbol near the top still faintly pulsed with old light.
system:1.line: 'The *system* of trials was set by those whose names we no longer speak.'

sentences.en: Carved into the stone pillar at the platform's entrance was a *system* of symbols, each marking a different level of trial.
Xiaoxing traced one with her finger and asked what the highest mark meant.
sentences.cn: 小杏用手指描过其中一个符号，问最高的符号是什么意思。

sentences.en: No one answered.
sentences.cn: 没有人回答。

sentences.en: The pillar was older than the sect itself, and some marks had no names left in any book.
sentences.cn: 这根柱子比宗派本身还要古老，有些符号在任何书籍里都没有名字了。

natural:1.en: Xiaoxing moved through the sword form with *natural* ease, as if the blade were simply an extension of her arm. I had drilled the same form for a month and still felt the hilt resist me. Shen Wujiu watched us both and said nothing, which felt worse than any correction he could have given.
natural:1.cnHint: 小星挥剑时有一种____的流畅，而我苦练一个月仍觉剑柄不从，沈无咎沉默地看着我们。
natural:1.hook: Her shadow on the stone moved half a step ahead of her body.
natural:1.line: 'It looks *natural* now, but she bled on this platform for two full seasons.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing moved through the sword form with *natural* ease, as if the blade were simply an extension of her arm.
I had drilled the same form for a month and still felt the hilt resist me.
sentences.cn: 我已经练习同样的剑势一个月了，剑柄对我的抵触仍然存在。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched us both and said nothing, which felt worse than any correction he could have given.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看着我们两人，什么都没说，这比他能给出的任何指正都要让人难受。

free:1.en: After the morning trials, Master Qingwu gave us one hour of *free* time on the platform. Most disciples sat and recovered their breath. I walked to the edge and looked down into the sea of clouds far below. A single white bird crossed the open sky beneath my feet, and I understood, briefly, what we were all studying toward.
free:1.cnHint: 试炼结束后，青雾师尊给了我们一段____的时光，我走到台边俯望云海，心中忽有所悟。
free:1.hook: The bird did not reappear, and the clouds closed over where it had been.
free:1.line: 'One *free* hour on this platform teaches more than a week in the hall.'

sentences.en: After the morning trials, Master Qingwu gave us one hour of *free* time on the platform.
Most disciples sat and recovered their breath.
sentences.cn: 大多数弟子坐下来恢复呼吸。

sentences.en: I walked to the edge and looked down into the sea of clouds far below.
sentences.cn: 我走向边缘，向下望进远处的云海。

sentences.en: A single white bird crossed the open sky beneath my feet, and I understood, briefly, what we were all studying toward.
sentences.cn: 一只白色的鸟儿掠过我脚下的开阔天空，我短暂地明白了我们所有人在研习什么。

contribute:2.en: A sealed scroll lay at the base of the trial platform, left by a disciple who had passed this test long ago. The note inside read: 'I *contribute* this record of my failure so the next seeker may walk further.' Three herbs were pressed beside the words — each one a lesson learned in pain.
contribute:2.cnHint: 一位前辈将记录失败经历的卷轴留在试剑台，希望以此____给后来的弟子。
contribute:2.hook: But the final herb was still warm, as if placed only moments before.
contribute:2.line: 'I *contribute* this record so you need not fall where I did.'

sentences.en: A sealed scroll lay at the base of the trial platform, left by a disciple who had passed this test long ago.
sentences.cn: 一份封好的卷轴放在试炼平台的底部，是一位很久以前通过这个试炼的弟子留下的。

sentences.en: The note inside read: 'I *contribute* this record of my failure so the next seeker may walk further.'
Three herbs were pressed beside the words — each one a lesson learned in pain.
sentences.cn: 三种草药被压在字迹旁——每一种都是在痛苦中学到的功课。

share:2.en: Beneath the trial platform, carved into the stone, were marks left by every disciple who had stood here. Shen Wujiu pointed to one faint line: 'That is my first attempt.' He offered me the chisel. Each *share* of the wall belonged to someone who had once trembled as I did now.
share:2.cnHint: 试剑台石壁上，每位弟子都留下了属于自己的那一____刻痕。
share:2.hook: At the edge of the carvings, one mark was still bleeding soft blue light.
share:2.line: 'Take the chisel — your *share* of this wall is waiting for you.'

sentences.en: Beneath the trial platform, carved into the stone, were marks left by every disciple who had stood here.
sentences.cn: 在试炼平台下方，刻在石头上的是每一位曾在这里站过的弟子留下的符号。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pointed to one faint line: 'That is my first attempt.'
sentences.cn: 沈无咎指向一条淡淡的线："那是我第一次尝试。"

sentences.en: He offered me the chisel.
sentences.cn: 他把凿子递给了我。

sentences.en: Each *share* of the wall belonged to someone who had once trembled as I did now.

decade:2.en: Inside the hollow pillar of the trial platform lay a jade tablet, untouched for what the dust suggested was a very long time. Master Qingwu brushed it clean and said quietly: 'A *decade* of silence. The word sealed here has not been spoken since my own teacher walked these stones.'
decade:2.cnHint: 试剑台空心石柱中藏有一块玉简，已沉寂了整整一____。
decade:2.hook: As the dust fell away, the tablet began to hum with a sound like distant thunder.
decade:2.line: 'A *decade* has passed since any disciple dared unseal this tablet.'

sentences.en: Inside the hollow pillar of the trial platform lay a jade tablet, untouched for what the dust suggested was a very long time.
sentences.cn: 试炼台的空心石柱里躺着一块玉牌，根据积尘的厚度来看，已经很久没人碰过它了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu brushed it clean and said quietly: 'A *decade* of silence.
The word sealed here has not been spoken since my own teacher walked these stones.'
sentences.cn: 这块玉牌上封印的字迹从我师尊踏上这些石板之后就再也没被人念诵过。

kind:2.en: Xiaoxing spread three leaves on the platform floor and asked me to choose. 'Each *kind* calls a different power,' she said softly. 'One steadies the breath, one sharpens the eye, one opens a door you may not be ready to enter.' I held my hand above each leaf and waited for a sign.
kind:2.cnHint: 小星将三种不同____的灵叶摆在试剑台上，让我从中选择。
kind:2.hook: The third leaf curled away from my fingers, almost as if it chose me instead.
kind:2.line: 'Each *kind* of leaf carries a different fate — choose with care.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread three leaves on the platform floor and asked me to choose.
sentences.cn: 小杏在台面上铺开三片叶子，让我选一片。

sentences.en: 'Each *kind* calls a different power,' she said softly.
'One steadies the breath, one sharpens the eye, one opens a door you may not be ready to enter.'
sentences.cn: 一片能稳住呼吸，一片能磨锐眼睛，一片会打开一扇你可能还没准备好进去的门。

sentences.en: I held my hand above each leaf and waited for a sign.
sentences.cn: 我把手悬在每片叶子上方，等待着什么信号。

across:2.en: A message had been scratched *across* the flat face of the trial stone — thin, urgent letters that crossed the entire surface from edge to edge. It named no sender. It named only a warning: the word sealed at this platform would not stay sealed past the next new moon.
across:2.cnHint: 一行警示文字被刻____整块试剑台石面，却没有留下任何落款。
across:2.hook: The last letter of the warning was still being carved, moving on its own.
across:2.line: 'Someone has written *across* the whole stone — read every word carefully.'

sentences.en: A message had been scratched *across* the flat face of the trial stone — thin, urgent letters that crossed the entire surface from edge to edge.
It named no sender.
sentences.cn: 它没有署名。

sentences.en: It named only a warning: the word sealed at this platform would not stay sealed past the next new moon.
sentences.cn: 它只写了一个警告：这座台子上封印的字不会在下一个新月之前还保持封印。

factor:2.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the base of the platform, studying the cracks. 'Soil, wind, the age of the stone — each is a *factor*,' he murmured. 'But only one of them caused this fracture today, and whatever is sealed inside is pressing outward.' He pressed his ear to the surface and went very still.
factor:2.cnHint: 师兄研究试剑台裂缝时，判断有一个关键____正在从内部施压。
factor:2.hook: The crack widened by a single breath-width as he lifted his hand away.
factor:2.line: 'Pressure from within is the true *factor* — something inside wants out.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the base of the platform, studying the cracks.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎跪在台子的底部，仔细研究着裂纹。

sentences.en: 'Soil, wind, the age of the stone — each is a *factor*,' he murmured.
'But only one of them caused this fracture today, and whatever is sealed inside is pressing outward.'
sentences.cn: 但只有其中一个原因导致了今天的裂纹，而被封在里面的东西在向外挤压。

sentences.en: He pressed his ear to the surface and went very still.
sentences.cn: 他把耳朵贴在石面上，整个人僵住了。

condition:2.en: The discovery note tucked under the platform edge was brief. It listed the *condition* of the sealed word: unstable, reactive to strong emotion, last assessed three seasons ago. Master Qingwu read it twice without speaking, then folded it with the care one gives a wound.
condition:2.cnHint: 平台边缘发现的记录纸条，描述了封印文字目前的____。
condition:2.hook: The paper crumbled to ash the moment Master Qingwu set it down.
condition:2.line: 'The *condition* of this seal has changed — do not let your feelings rise here.'

sentences.en: The discovery note tucked under the platform edge was brief.
sentences.cn: 塞在台子边缘下面的发现记录很简洁。

sentences.en: It listed the *condition* of the sealed word: unstable, reactive to strong emotion, last assessed three seasons ago.
Master Qingwu read it twice without speaking, then folded it with the care one gives a wound.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊读了两遍，没有说话，然后像对待一个伤口一样小心地把它折好。

effort:2.en: Half-buried beneath the platform step was a practice slate, worn smooth by long use. Every surface was filled with the same word, written hundreds of times in a hand that grew steadier line by line. At the bottom, in firmer strokes: 'The word yielded on the last day of the third year. *Effort* does not lie.' I read it once and set the slate back where it had rested.
effort:2.cnHint: 台阶下的练习石板记录了一位前辈多年的____，直到文字终于向他臣服。
effort:2.hook: The moment the slate touched the ground again, a single word lit up among all the rest.
effort:2.line: '*Effort* does not lie — the word will open for you too, in time.'

sentences.en: Half-buried beneath the platform step was a practice slate, worn smooth by long use.
sentences.cn: 埋在台阶下面的是一块练习用的石板，被长期使用磨得光滑。

sentences.en: Every surface was filled with the same word, written hundreds of times in a hand that grew steadier line by line.
sentences.cn: 每个表面都被同一个字填满了，几百次，笔迹随着一行行的练习变得越来越稳定。

sentences.en: At the bottom, in firmer strokes: 'The word yielded on the last day of the third year.
sentences.cn: 在最下面，笔画更加有力：这个字在第三年的最后一天被领悟了。

sentences.en: *Effort* does not lie.'
I read it once and set the slate back where it had rested.
sentences.cn: 我读了一遍，把石板放回了它原来的地方。

education:2.en: Inside the stone archive at the base of the Trial Sword Platform, I found a scroll sealed with green wax. It described how a disciple's *education* began not with sword forms but with learning to read the living herbs growing through the platform's cracks. Each plant was a lesson waiting to open.
education:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台档案室发现一卷古籍，记载着弟子____从辨认灵草开始。
education:2.hook: But the final page had been deliberately torn away.
education:2.line: 'Your *education* starts here, not at the blade,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Inside the stone archive at the base of the Trial Sword Platform, I found a scroll sealed with green wax.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台底部的石头档案库里找到了一卷用绿蜡封着的卷轴。

sentences.en: It described how a disciple's *education* began not with sword forms but with learning to read the living herbs growing through the platform's cracks.
Each plant was a lesson waiting to open.
sentences.cn: 每一株植物都是等待开启的一堂课。

scientist:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread his notes across the stone railing of the Trial Sword Platform. He studied each spiritual herb with the patience of a *scientist*, measuring the angle of every leaf and recording how the cloud mist changed their colour at dawn. I had never seen such careful attention given to a simple plant.
scientist:2.cnHint: 师兄像____一样在试剑台上仔细测量灵草的叶片角度和晨雾变化。
scientist:2.hook: Then one measured herb began to glow without being touched.
scientist:2.line: 'A true *scientist* of the Dao trusts only what can be measured,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread his notes across the stone railing of the Trial Sword Platform.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把他的笔记铺在试剑台的石栏杆上。

sentences.en: He studied each spiritual herb with the patience of a *scientist*, measuring the angle of every leaf and recording how the cloud mist changed their colour at dawn.
I had never seen such careful attention given to a simple plant.
sentences.cn: 我从没见过有人对一株简单的植物投入过这样的专注。

physical:2.en: Beneath the Trial Sword Platform, a narrow passage led to a chamber where the sect stored its oldest formula stones. The inscriptions there were not mere words — they carried *physical* weight, pressing against my chest like a hand when I stepped too close. I backed away, breathing hard.
physical:2.cnHint: 试剑台下密室中的古老法刻对靠近的人施加____压力，令我喘不过气。
physical:2.hook: One stone had shifted since the last disciple's visit.
physical:2.line: 'The *physical* force of old words is not a warning — it is a test,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Beneath the Trial Sword Platform, a narrow passage led to a chamber where the sect stored its oldest formula stones.
sentences.cn: 试剑台下面，一条狭窄的通道通向一个房间，宗派在那里存放最古老的刻石方子。

sentences.en: The inscriptions there were not mere words — they carried *physical* weight, pressing against my chest like a hand when I stepped too close.
I backed away, breathing hard.
sentences.cn: 我退了回来，喘着气。

quality:2.en: On the ledge beside the Trial Sword Platform, Xiaoxing held a pale herb to the morning light. She explained that its healing *quality* depended entirely on which side of the floating mountain it had grown on — shadow-side herbs could calm, but light-side herbs could burn if misread. I listened and said nothing.
quality:2.cnHint: 小星向我解释灵草的____取决于它生长在浮山的阴面还是阳面。
quality:2.hook: The herb in her hand had roots from both sides.
quality:2.line: 'Never judge a herb's *quality* by its colour alone,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: On the ledge beside the Trial Sword Platform, Xiaoxing held a pale herb to the morning light.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台旁边的石架上，小杏把一株淡色的草药对着晨光。

sentences.en: She explained that its healing *quality* depended entirely on which side of the floating mountain it had grown on — shadow-side herbs could calm, but light-side herbs could burn if misread.
I listened and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 我听着，什么也没说。

habit:2.en: Tucked under a loose stone near the Trial Sword Platform steps, I found a small journal. Its owner had a *habit* of pressing dried herb petals between the pages as markers. Each petal matched a formula written on the same page, as if the plant itself were signing its own name. The last page held no petal.
habit:2.cnHint: 我在台阶下发现一本日记，主人有将灵草花瓣夹在对应法式旁的____。
habit:2.hook: The journal's owner had not been seen in three seasons.
habit:2.line: 'It was his *habit* to leave a petal — never a blank page,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Tucked under a loose stone near the Trial Sword Platform steps, I found a small journal.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台台阶附近的一块松动的石头下，我找到了一本小日记。

sentences.en: Its owner had a *habit* of pressing dried herb petals between the pages as markers.
Each petal matched a formula written on the same page, as if the plant itself were signing its own name.
sentences.cn: 每片花瓣都对应了同一页上写下的一个方子，好像这株植物本身在签署自己的名字。

sentences.en: The last page held no petal.
sentences.cn: 最后一页没有花瓣。

sound:2.en: Standing alone on the Trial Sword Platform at midday, I heard a low, steady *sound* rising from the cracks in the stone — not wind, not water, but something between a hum and a breath. It grew louder when I placed my hand on the central pillar. The platform, it seemed, was still alive.
sound:2.cnHint: 我独自站在试剑台上时，从石缝中听到一种稳定的____，随我触碰石柱而增强。
sound:2.hook: The sound shaped itself, faintly, into a single word.
sound:2.line: 'That *sound* has not been heard since the last great trial,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Standing alone on the Trial Sword Platform at midday, I heard a low, steady *sound* rising from the cracks in the stone — not wind, not water, but something between a hum and a breath.
It grew louder when I placed my hand on the central pillar.
sentences.cn: 当我把手放在中心柱子上时，声音变得更大了。

sentences.en: The platform, it seemed, was still alive.
sentences.cn: 这座台子，看起来还活着。

average:2.en: Master Qingwu studied the row of formula stones I had memorised and set down the tally with a calm expression. She said my results were above *average* for a first-season disciple, but her tone held no warmth. On the Trial Sword Platform, she pointed to the highest tier of stones and asked if I understood what that meant.
average:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我我的成绩高于____水平，却指向了试剑台最高层法石。
average:2.hook: Above average, she said, was where the real danger began.
average:2.line: 'Above *average* is not safety — it is a higher target,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu studied the row of formula stones I had memorised and set down the tally with a calm expression.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊看着我背诵的那排公式石，放下计数板，神情平静。

sentences.en: She said my results were above *average* for a first-season disciple, but her tone held no warmth.
On the Trial Sword Platform, she pointed to the highest tier of stones and asked if I understood what that meant.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台上，她指向最高层的石头，问我是否明白那意味着什么。

body:2.en: At the foot of the Trial Sword Platform, a carved figure stood in the rock — a disciple frozen mid-step, arms raised. The sect elders called it a lesson: the *body* must be still before the word can move. I touched the stone hand and felt a faint pulse, as if the carving remembered motion.
body:2.cnHint: 试剑台脚下有一尊石像，长老们说____静止才能让法语运转，我触碰后感到微弱脉动。
body:2.hook: The pulse quickened once, then stopped completely.
body:2.line: 'Calm the *body* first — the word follows only stillness,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: At the foot of the Trial Sword Platform, a carved figure stood in the rock — a disciple frozen mid-step, arms raised.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台脚下，一个雕刻的身影立在岩石中——一名弟子冻结在半步中，双臂举起。

sentences.en: The sect elders called it a lesson: the *body* must be still before the word can move.
I touched the stone hand and felt a faint pulse, as if the carving remembered motion.
sentences.cn: 我摸了摸那石手，感到一阵微弱的脉搏，仿佛雕刻还记得运动。

compare:2.en: A stone tablet stood at the edge of the training ground, covered in faded script. Shen Wujiu ran his fingers along each carved word. 'You should *compare* the marks left by senior disciples with your own,' he said quietly. I pressed my palm beside his — the difference was clear, and humbling. At the bottom, one line had been scratched out.
compare:2.cnHint: 师兄让我把自己刻下的字迹与前辈的____，我发现石碑最下方有一行被划去的痕迹。
compare:2.hook: The erased line still faintly glowed beneath the stone.
compare:2.line: '*Compare* your marks with theirs — the gap will teach you.'

sentences.en: A stone tablet stood at the edge of the training ground, covered in faded script.
sentences.cn: 训练场边缘矗立着一块石碑，上面覆盖着褪色的笔迹。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu ran his fingers along each carved word.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎的手指沿着每一个刻下的字滑过。

sentences.en: 'You should *compare* the marks left by senior disciples with your own,' he said quietly.
I pressed my palm beside his — the difference was clear, and humbling.
sentences.cn: 我在他旁边贴上我的手心——差距是显而易见的，令人谦卑。

sentences.en: At the bottom, one line had been scratched out.
sentences.cn: 在最下面，有一行被划掉了。

past:2.en: Behind the sword platform stood a narrow room no one had entered in years. Dust covered a single scroll on the shelf. I unrolled it slowly: it held the names of disciples who had failed their first trial. Reading the *past* written in their own hands made the cold air feel heavier. My own name was not yet there — but the ink pot sat ready.
past:2.cnHint: 我在剑台后的小室里找到了一卷记载____的名册，上面全是曾经失败的弟子亲笔留下的名字。
past:2.hook: The last name on the list had been written that very morning.
past:2.line: 'The *past* of this sect is not glory alone — read it all.'

sentences.en: Behind the sword platform stood a narrow room no one had entered in years.
sentences.cn: 在剑台后面站着一间狭窄的房间，多年来没人进去过。

sentences.en: Dust covered a single scroll on the shelf.
sentences.cn: 灰尘覆盖了架子上的一卷经文。

sentences.en: I unrolled it slowly: it held the names of disciples who had failed their first trial.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢展开它：里面是那些在第一次试炼中失败的弟子们的名字。

sentences.en: Reading the *past* written in their own hands made the cold air feel heavier.
My own name was not yet there — but the ink pot sat ready.
sentences.cn: 我自己的名字还不在那里——但墨水罐已经准备好了。

suffer:2.en: Xiaoxing found me in the rest alcove, pressing a bruised hand against cool stone. She placed a small leaf on my wrist — a word-herb for pain. 'You do not have to *suffer* in silence,' she said, her voice steady. The leaf dissolved into pale light, and the ache faded. Outside, thunder rolled through the cloud sea far below.
suffer:2.cnHint: 小星发现我独自忍着手伤，她用一片字草帮我止痛，说我不必____着不吭声。
suffer:2.hook: Beyond the window, a second roll of thunder answered the first.
suffer:2.line: 'You should not *suffer* alone — take the herb and heal.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me in the rest alcove, pressing a bruised hand against cool stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏在休息处找到我，把淤伤的手压在冰凉的石头上。

sentences.en: She placed a small leaf on my wrist — a word-herb for pain.
sentences.cn: 她在我的手腕上放了一片小叶子——一种止痛的言语草。

sentences.en: 'You do not have to *suffer* in silence,' she said, her voice steady.
The leaf dissolved into pale light, and the ache faded.
sentences.cn: 叶子溶解成苍白的光，疼痛消退了。

sentences.en: Outside, thunder rolled through the cloud sea far below.
sentences.cn: 外面，雷声在远下方的云海中滚动。

almost:2.en: The messenger bird landed on the trial platform rail just before dawn. It carried a thin strip of paper with only five words in Master Qingwu's hand. I read them three times. The meaning was *almost* clear to me — but one character sat at the centre like a locked door. I folded the strip carefully and placed it against my chest.
almost:2.cnHint: 黎明前一只信鸟带来了师尊亲笔的纸条，上面的意思我____能读懂，却有一个字像一扇锁住的门。
almost:2.hook: A second bird circled the peak but did not land.
almost:2.line: 'I *almost* understand the message — one word still escapes me.'

sentences.en: The messenger bird landed on the trial platform rail just before dawn.
sentences.cn: 信使鸟在天亮前着陆在试剑台的栏杆上。

sentences.en: It carried a thin strip of paper with only five words in Master Qingwu's hand.
sentences.cn: 它带着一条薄纸，上面只有青梧师尊笔迹的五个字。

sentences.en: I read them three times.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍。

sentences.en: The meaning was *almost* clear to me — but one character sat at the centre like a locked door.
I folded the strip carefully and placed it against my chest.
sentences.cn: 我小心地折叠那张纸条，紧贴胸口。

especially:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid out seven word-stones in a row and named each one. All of them could be used in trial combat, he explained, but some were far more useful in fog. '*Especially* the third stone,' he said, tapping it twice. 'It calls wind, and the testing ground fills with mist at the second bell.' I memorized its shape before the light changed.
especially:2.cnHint: 师兄介绍了七块字石的用法，说在雾中____第三块最为关键，因为考场在二鼓时会起浓雾。
especially:2.hook: The mist arrived an hour early that night.
especially:2.line: 'Study all seven, but *especially* the third — mist hides much.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu laid out seven word-stones in a row and named each one.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎排列了七块言语石，逐一念出名字。

sentences.en: All of them could be used in trial combat, he explained, but some were far more useful in fog. '*Especially* the third stone,' he said, tapping it twice.
'It calls wind, and the testing ground fills with mist at the second bell.'
sentences.cn: "它召唤风，测试场地会在第二声钟时充满迷雾。"

sentences.en: I memorized its shape before the light changed.
sentences.cn: 在光线改变之前，我记住了它的形状。

publish:2.en: In the record hall beside the sword platform, a clerk pressed a wooden seal onto fresh paper and pinned it to the board. Each month the sect would *publish* the names of disciples who had advanced. I stood before the board longer than I should have. My name was not there. Beside me, a candle flame bent without any wind.
publish:2.cnHint: 每月宗门都会在布告栏____晋级弟子的名单，我在榜前站了很久，却没有找到自己的名字。
publish:2.hook: The candle beside the board bent again, toward the door.
publish:2.line: 'They *publish* the list at noon — go read it before it crowds.'

sentences.en: In the record hall beside the sword platform, a clerk pressed a wooden seal onto fresh paper and pinned it to the board.
sentences.cn: 在剑台旁的记录厅里，一名书记员按下木印章在新鲜纸张上，然后把它钉在公告板上。

sentences.en: Each month the sect would *publish* the names of disciples who had advanced.
I stood before the board longer than I should have.
sentences.cn: 我在公告板前站得比我应该站的时间更长。

sentences.en: My name was not there.
sentences.cn: 我的名字不在那里。

sentences.en: Beside me, a candle flame bent without any wind.
sentences.cn: 我身边，一根蜡烛火焰弯曲，没有任何风。

activity:2.en: Master Qingwu walked the length of the platform without speaking, watching our practice. Then she stopped. 'Every word-formula has an *activity* of its own,' she said. 'Like a herb that keeps working after you swallow it.' She pointed at the air above my open hand, where a faint hum still lingered long after I had stopped the recitation. I had not noticed it until now.
activity:2.cnHint: 师尊说每一道字诀都有其自身的____，就像草药入腹后仍在持续发挥作用，她指出我手心上方那道未散的微鸣。
activity:2.hook: The hum in my palm grew slightly louder at dusk.
activity:2.line: 'A word does not stop when you stop — its *activity* lingers.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu walked the length of the platform without speaking, watching our practice.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊沿着台子的长度走过，不说话，看着我们练习。

sentences.en: Then she stopped.
sentences.cn: 然后她停下来。

sentences.en: 'Every word-formula has an *activity* of its own,' she said.
'Like a herb that keeps working after you swallow it.'
sentences.cn: "就像一种草药，吞下去后还在继续起作用。"

sentences.en: She pointed at the air above my open hand, where a faint hum still lingered long after I had stopped the recitation.
sentences.cn: 她指向我张开的手上方的空气，那里一阵微弱的嗡嗡声还在久久萦绕，久久不散。

sentences.en: I had not noticed it until now.
sentences.cn: 直到现在我才注意到。

science:2.en: Xiaoxing spread a hand-copied chart across the stone bench: columns of word-herbs, their effects, and the conditions that changed them. 'The old masters called this the *science* of living words,' she said softly. 'Each formula follows rules, the way water follows the shape of its vessel.' I copied two rows before the afternoon light failed. The chart's last column was blank — waiting, it seemed, for discoveries not yet made.
science:2.cnHint: 小星展示了一张手抄图表，说老一辈将此称为活字的____，每道字诀都遵循规律，就像水依容器成形，图表最后一列仍是空白。
science:2.hook: The blank column seemed to darken as the clouds below rose higher.
science:2.line: 'This is the *science* of words — learn the rules before you break them.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread a hand-copied chart across the stone bench: columns of word-herbs, their effects, and the conditions that changed them.
sentences.cn: 小杏在石凳上铺开一张手抄的表格：言语草的列表、它们的效果，以及改变它们的条件。

sentences.en: 'The old masters called this the *science* of living words,' she said softly.
'Each formula follows rules, the way water follows the shape of its vessel.'
sentences.cn: "每一个公式都遵循规则，就像水遵循其容器的形状一样。"

sentences.en: I copied two rows before the afternoon light failed.
sentences.cn: 午后的光线消失之前，我抄写了两行。

sentences.en: The chart's last column was blank — waiting, it seemed, for discoveries not yet made.
sentences.cn: 表格的最后一列是空白的——等待着，似乎，尚未发现的发现。

receive:2.en: At the foot of the Trial Sword Platform, a folded paper crane landed in my open palm. I had done nothing to call it. To *receive* such a message uninvited meant someone above the clouds had been watching me long before I ever climbed these steps. The crane's wings trembled once, then went still.
receive:2.cnHint: 在试剑台下，我____到了一只无人投递的纸鹤，它悄然落入我的掌心。
receive:2.hook: The seal on the crane bore a name I had never been told.
receive:2.line: 'To *receive* a message from the peak unasked — that is either great honour or great warning.'

sentences.en: At the foot of the Trial Sword Platform, a folded paper crane landed in my open palm.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台脚下，一只折叠的纸鹤落在我张开的手心。

sentences.en: I had done nothing to call it.
sentences.cn: 我什么都没做来召唤它。

sentences.en: To *receive* such a message uninvited meant someone above the clouds had been watching me long before I ever climbed these steps.
The crane's wings trembled once, then went still.
sentences.cn: 纸鹤的翅膀颤抖了一次，然后静止不动。

encourage:2.en: Xiaoxing stood beside me at the base of the Trial Sword Platform, her voice low and steady. 'The word carved on the first stone will *encourage* you — it fed my own courage when I first climbed.' I looked up. The platform stretched into low cloud, and the carved word glowed faintly, like an ember refusing to die.
encourage:2.cnHint: 小星在试剑台旁轻声告诉我，第一块石头上刻着的词会____我继续向上攀登。
encourage:2.hook: But the glow shifted colour as my shadow fell across it.
encourage:2.line: 'Let it *encourage* you — the stone only glows for those the sect has chosen.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood beside me at the base of the Trial Sword Platform, her voice low and steady.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在我身边，在试剑台的底部，她的声音低沉而坚定。

sentences.en: 'The word carved on the first stone will *encourage* you — it fed my own courage when I first climbed.'
I looked up.
sentences.cn: 我往上看。

sentences.en: The platform stretched into low cloud, and the carved word glowed faintly, like an ember refusing to die.
sentences.cn: 台子延伸到低云中，刻下的字闪闪发光，像一块拒绝熄灭的余烬。

travel:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long map across the altar stone. Thin silver lines showed every path a word-formula could *travel* through the body — from the throat down to the feet, then up like rising smoke to the mind. 'Follow the silver road,' she said, 'and the sword will move before you decide to move it.'
travel:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊展开一幅图，标注了灵语在体内____的完整路径。
travel:2.hook: One silver line on the map led off the edge of the paper entirely.
travel:2.line: 'Watch how the power must *travel* — rush it, and the blade turns against you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long map across the altar stone.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在祭坛石上铺开了一幅长长的地图。

sentences.en: Thin silver lines showed every path a word-formula could *travel* through the body — from the throat down to the feet, then up like rising smoke to the mind.
'Follow the silver road,' she said, 'and the sword will move before you decide to move it.'
sentences.cn: 她说，「顺着银色的路走，剑会在你决定动作之前就动了。」

strong:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed his palm flat against the Trial Sword Platform's lowest stone. A low hum answered him at once. 'The stone is *strong* because ten thousand words have been spoken into it over the years,' he told me. 'It holds every voice that ever passed the trial.' I placed my own hand beside his and felt them all.
strong:2.cnHint: 沈无咎告诉我，试剑台的基石因无数灵语的注入而变得无比____。
strong:2.hook: Among the voices inside the stone, one was still speaking.
strong:2.line: 'The foundation must be *strong* before any word-formula can stand on it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed his palm flat against the Trial Sword Platform's lowest stone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把手掌平贴在试剑台最低的那块石头上。

sentences.en: A low hum answered him at once.
sentences.cn: 一阵低沉的嗡鸣立刻回应了他。

sentences.en: 'The stone is *strong* because ten thousand words have been spoken into it over the years,' he told me.
'It holds every voice that ever passed the trial.'
sentences.cn: 「它容纳了所有通过试炼的人的声音。」

sentences.en: I placed my own hand beside his and felt them all.
sentences.cn: 我把自己的手放在他的手边，感受到了它们全部。

chance:2.en: 'You have one *chance* to speak the sealing word correctly,' Master Qingwu said, setting a small jade disc on the platform edge. 'The disc shatters on the second failure — not as punishment, but as proof that hesitation costs more than error.' I looked at the disc. It was already cracked along one old line.
chance:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊告诉我，我只有一次____来正确说出封印灵语，机不可失。
chance:2.hook: The old crack in the jade was shaped exactly like my family mark.
chance:2.line: 'One *chance* is all the trial gives — but one chance is enough, if you are ready.'

sentences.en: 'You have one *chance* to speak the sealing word correctly,' Master Qingwu said, setting a small jade disc on the platform edge.
'The disc shatters on the second failure — not as punishment, but as proof that hesitation costs more than error.'
sentences.cn: 「圆盘在第二次失败时会碎——不是惩罚，而是证明犹豫的代价比出错更大。」

sentences.en: I looked at the disc.
sentences.cn: 我看着这枚圆盘。

sentences.en: It was already cracked along one old line.
sentences.cn: 它沿着一条老裂纹已经裂开了。

solve:2.en: The inscription on the platform's centre stone was written in an old form no one had taught me. Xiaoxing watched quietly as I knelt to study it. I worked each symbol against the ones I knew until the pattern gave way, the way a knot releases when you find the right thread. To *solve* it felt less like thinking and more like listening.
solve:2.cnHint: 试剑台中央石碑上的古文刻字让我苦苦思索，我终于____了这道字谜。
solve:2.hook: The moment the meaning opened, the stone beneath my knees turned warm.
solve:2.line: '*Solve* the inscription first — the sword will not rise for someone who skips the root.'

sentences.en: The inscription on the platform's centre stone was written in an old form no one had taught me.
sentences.cn: 试剑台中心石头上的铭文是用一种没人教过我的古体写的。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing watched quietly as I knelt to study it.
sentences.cn: 小杏静静地看着我跪下去研究它。

sentences.en: I worked each symbol against the ones I knew until the pattern gave way, the way a knot releases when you find the right thread.
sentences.cn: 我把每个符号和我认识的符号对比，直到这个图案松动了，就像你找到正确的线头时绳结就会松开一样。

sentences.en: To *solve* it felt less like thinking and more like listening.

quite:2.en: I had expected the Trial Sword Platform to be *quite* silent at dawn, the way sacred places in old stories always are. Instead, the wind carried a low, continuous tone — as if the platform itself were breathing between words. Shen Wujiu said nothing when I looked at him. He only nodded, slowly, like a man who had been waiting for me to finally hear it.
quite:2.cnHint: 我以为试剑台在黎明时会____安静，却听到了一种持续低鸣的风声。
quite:2.hook: The tone rose by one clear note the instant I stepped onto the stone.
quite:2.line: 'It is never *quite* silent here — the platform remembers every word ever spoken on it.'

sentences.en: I had expected the Trial Sword Platform to be *quite* silent at dawn, the way sacred places in old stories always are.
Instead, the wind carried a low, continuous tone — as if the platform itself were breathing between words.
sentences.cn: 风吹来的却是一种低沉、连续的声调——就像试剑台本身在字与字之间呼吸。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said nothing when I looked at him.
sentences.cn: 我看向沈无咎时，他什么都没说。

sentences.en: He only nodded, slowly, like a man who had been waiting for me to finally hear it.
sentences.cn: 他只是缓缓点头，就像一个一直在等我终于听见它的人。

technology:2.en: Master Qingwu called the old system of word-formulas a *technology* — a craft built over centuries, refined like metal in fire, passed from hand to hand. 'People mistake it for magic,' she said, tracing a formula in the air until it hung there, softly lit. 'But magic cannot be taught. This can.' The formula drifted toward me like it already knew my name.
technology:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊将灵语体系称为一门可以传授的____，而非单纯的天赋或魔法。
technology:2.hook: The floating formula rearranged itself into a shape no master had written before.
technology:2.line: 'Call it what it is: a *technology* — built by those before us so you do not have to start from nothing.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu called the old system of word-formulas a *technology* — a craft built over centuries, refined like metal in fire, passed from hand to hand.
'People mistake it for magic,' she said, tracing a formula in the air until it hung there, softly lit.
sentences.cn: 她说，「人们把它当成魔法，」她在空中画出一个公式，直到它悬浮在那儿，柔和地发着光。

sentences.en: 'But magic cannot be taught.
sentences.cn: 「但魔法是教不了的。」

sentences.en: This can.'
sentences.cn: 「这个可以。」

sentences.en: The formula drifted toward me like it already knew my name.
sentences.cn: 公式朝我飘来，就像它早就知道我的名字。

personal:2.en: On the trial-sword platform, each disciple left a *personal* mark — a single word carved into the stone rail. I found mine already waiting: a character I had never taught myself, yet shaped exactly like my own fear. Shen Wujiu said nothing when I showed him. He only looked away at the clouds below.
personal:2.cnHint: 在试剑台上，我发现石栏上有一个____的印记，那个字仿佛映照出我内心的恐惧。
personal:2.hook: The carving was still warm to the touch.
personal:2.line: 'That is a *personal* mark — no two disciples ever receive the same one.'

sentences.en: On the trial-sword platform, each disciple left a *personal* mark — a single word carved into the stone rail.
I found mine already waiting: a character I had never taught myself, yet shaped exactly like my own fear.
sentences.cn: 我找到了我的记号已经在等着我：一个我从没教过自己的字，却长得和我的恐惧一模一样。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said nothing when I showed him.
sentences.cn: 我把它指给沈无咎看时，他什么都没说。

sentences.en: He only looked away at the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 他只是把目光移向下面的云。

rather:2.en: The sealed box arrived at the trial-sword platform before dawn, addressed to no one. Inside lay a single dried leaf — *rather* like the herb called Stillwater, yet darker, almost the colour of an old bruise. Xiaoxing pressed it gently and whispered that she had seen its like only once before, in Master Qingwu's private garden.
rather:2.cnHint: 一个无名盒子里装着一片叶子，____像静水草，但颜色更深，令人不安。
rather:2.hook: A thin crack split the platform stone beneath the box.
rather:2.line: 'It is *rather* strange that no name was written on the box.'

sentences.en: The sealed box arrived at the trial-sword platform before dawn, addressed to no one.
sentences.cn: 那只密封的盒子在天亮前送到了试剑台，上面没有收件人的名字。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single dried leaf — *rather* like the herb called Stillwater, yet darker, almost the colour of an old bruise.
Xiaoxing pressed it gently and whispered that she had seen its like only once before, in Master Qingwu's private garden.
sentences.cn: 小杏轻轻按了按它，低声说她只在青梧师尊的私人花园里见过一次这样的东西。

instead:2.en: I reached for the bright formula stone on the rack, the one that promised speed. Shen Wujiu caught my wrist and shook his head. He handed me a dull grey tablet *instead* — rough, almost ugly. When I pressed my palm to it, the whole trial-sword platform hummed and the clouds below swirled upward like smoke.
instead:2.cnHint: 师兄阻止我取那块明亮的法石，____给了我一块暗灰色的石板，台下云海随之涌动。
instead:2.hook: The grey tablet left a faint burning ring on my palm.
instead:2.line: 'Take this one *instead* — it will show you what you are truly ready for.'

sentences.en: I reached for the bright formula stone on the rack, the one that promised speed.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿架子上那块明亮的公式石，那块承诺速度的。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu caught my wrist and shook his head.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎抓住了我的手腕，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: He handed me a dull grey tablet *instead* — rough, almost ugly.
When I pressed my palm to it, the whole trial-sword platform hummed and the clouds below swirled upward like smoke.
sentences.cn: 我的手掌按到它上面时，整个试剑台都开始嗡鸣，下面的云旋转着像烟雾一样向上卷起。

performance:2.en: Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple's *performance* on the trial-sword platform by reading the color left in the stone after our step. Mine burned a quiet silver — neither the gold of promise nor the red of danger. She folded her hands and said nothing for a long moment. Behind her, a single cloud drifted upward against the wind.
performance:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊通过石台上留下的颜色评判每位弟子的____，我的印记是沉静的银色。
performance:2.hook: Silver had not appeared on that platform in forty years.
performance:2.line: 'Your *performance* today has left a mark this platform has not seen before.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu reviewed each disciple's *performance* on the trial-sword platform by reading the color left in the stone after our step.
Mine burned a quiet silver — neither the gold of promise nor the red of danger.
sentences.cn: 我的留下了一种安静的银色——既不是希望的金色，也不是危险的红色。

sentences.en: She folded her hands and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 她交叠起双手，沉默了很长一段时间。

sentences.en: Behind her, a single cloud drifted upward against the wind.
sentences.cn: 她身后，一朵单独的云向上飘起，逆风而行。

percent:2.en: Shen Wujiu showed me the old record tablet near the edge of the trial-sword platform. Only thirty *percent* of first-year disciples could hold a word-formula long enough to lift both feet off the stone. I had managed it for three full breaths. The number should have felt like praise, yet the wind that rose after felt colder than it should have.
percent:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，只有三十____的新弟子能悬浮成功，而我做到了，但随后的风却格外寒冷。
percent:2.hook: The record tablet cracked cleanly down the middle.
percent:2.line: 'Less than thirty *percent* ever reach that mark in their first season.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu showed me the old record tablet near the edge of the trial-sword platform.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎带我去看试剑台边缘附近的那块古老的记录石碑。

sentences.en: Only thirty *percent* of first-year disciples could hold a word-formula long enough to lift both feet off the stone.
I had managed it for three full breaths.
sentences.cn: 我坚持了整整三个呼吸。

sentences.en: The number should have felt like praise, yet the wind that rose after felt colder than it should have.
sentences.cn: 这个数字本该像是褒奖,可之后吹起的风比它应有的样子冷得多。

achieve:2.en: I stood at the far end of the trial-sword platform and tried once more to *achieve* stillness — mind empty, breath slow, the word for 'cloud' held like water in cupped hands. For one heartbeat it worked. The mist below rose and wrapped my ankles like a living thing. Then a bell rang somewhere deep in the mountain, and the mist fell away.
achieve:2.cnHint: 我努力在试剑台上____内心的平静，成功片刻后，山中深处突然传来一声钟响。
achieve:2.hook: No bell had been scheduled to ring that day.
achieve:2.line: 'To *achieve* even one breath of true stillness is more than most manage in a year.'

sentences.en: I stood at the far end of the trial-sword platform and tried once more to *achieve* stillness — mind empty, breath slow, the word for 'cloud' held like water in cupped hands.
For one heartbeat it worked.
sentences.cn: 那一瞬间成功了。

sentences.en: The mist below rose and wrapped my ankles like a living thing.
sentences.cn: 下面的雾升起来，像活物一样缠绕着我的脚踝。

sentences.en: Then a bell rang somewhere deep in the mountain, and the mist fell away.
sentences.cn: 然后山深处响起一声钟鸣，雾又落了下去。

challenge:2.en: A folded note lay on the trial-sword platform when I arrived at dawn. It was a formal *challenge* — written in the old word-script, sealed with ash — asking me to hold the word 'sky' aloft until sunset. No name signed it. Xiaoxing read it over my shoulder and drew a sharp breath, her eyes wide and still.
challenge:2.cnHint: 清晨，试剑台上出现一封挑战书，用古老字法写成，要求我将'天'字悬空至日落，无人署名。
challenge:2.hook: Xiaoxing's hand trembled as she handed the note back.
challenge:2.line: 'A *challenge* written in ash-seal is not a thing anyone sends lightly.'

sentences.en: A folded note lay on the trial-sword platform when I arrived at dawn.
sentences.cn: 我天亮时赶到试剑台，发现平台上放着一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: It was a formal *challenge* — written in the old word-script, sealed with ash — asking me to hold the word 'sky' aloft until sunset.
No name signed it.
sentences.cn: 没有署名。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing read it over my shoulder and drew a sharp breath, her eyes wide and still.
sentences.cn: 小杏从我肩头读过去，倒吸一口冷气，眼睛瞪得又圆又直。

power:2.en: The trial-sword platform had a crack along its centre that older disciples said marked the place where a great word had once shattered a disciple's grip. I placed my hand over it and felt a faint pulse — the *power* of that old word still alive in the stone, slow as a winter heartbeat. Above me, two clouds collided without a sound.
power:2.cnHint: 试剑台中央的裂缝里，我感受到一股古老字诀的____仍在石头中缓缓搏动。
power:2.hook: The pulse beat once more — and then went still.
power:2.line: 'The *power* stored in old stone does not belong to the one who finds it.'

sentences.en: The trial-sword platform had a crack along its centre that older disciples said marked the place where a great word had once shattered a disciple's grip.
sentences.cn: 试剑台的中心有一道裂纹,年长的弟子们说那是标记——一个强大的字诀曾经把某个弟子的掌力击碎在那个地方。

sentences.en: I placed my hand over it and felt a faint pulse — the *power* of that old word still alive in the stone, slow as a winter heartbeat.
Above me, two clouds collided without a sound.
sentences.cn: 我上方,两朵云无声地碰撞在一起。

key:2.en: Below the Trial Sword Stage, I found a narrow stone door covered in old moss. A small iron *key* hung from a crack in the wall — shaped like a sword, cold to the touch. Without it, the door would never open, and whatever secret lay beyond would remain sealed forever.
key:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台下发现一扇石门，门缝里挂着一把形如剑的____。
key:2.hook: Behind the door, something breathed in the dark.
key:2.line: 'This *key* was left here long before any of us arrived.'

sentences.en: Below the Trial Sword Stage, I found a narrow stone door covered in old moss.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台下方，我找到了一扇被厚重苔藓覆盖的狭窄石门。

sentences.en: A small iron *key* hung from a crack in the wall — shaped like a sword, cold to the touch.
Without it, the door would never open, and whatever secret lay beyond would remain sealed forever.
sentences.cn: 没有它，那道门永远打不开，而藏在后面的任何秘密都会永远被封住。

issue:2.en: Master Qingwu gathered us beside the Trial Sword Stage at dawn. She held an old scroll — the latest *issue* of the Sect's inner teachings, printed on silver paper thin as a cloud. 'Read carefully,' she said. 'Every word in here is a step on your path.' I unrolled it with trembling hands.
issue:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊在试剑台旁向我们分发门派内功心法的最新____。
issue:2.hook: The final page of the scroll was completely blank.
issue:2.line: 'This *issue* carries a warning that the last three did not.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered us beside the Trial Sword Stage at dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在天亮时把我们聚集在试剑台旁。

sentences.en: She held an old scroll — the latest *issue* of the Sect's inner teachings, printed on silver paper thin as a cloud.
'Read carefully,' she said.
sentences.cn: "仔细读,"她说。

sentences.en: 'Every word in here is a step on your path.'
sentences.cn: "这里的每一个字都是你们道路上的一步。"

sentences.en: I unrolled it with trembling hands.
sentences.cn: 我颤抖着展开它。

against:2.en: Shen Wujiu leaned *against* the carved stone pillar at the edge of the Trial Sword Stage, arms folded, eyes half shut. Yet I felt his attention fixed on every move I made. The pillar behind him was etched with the names of disciples who had failed here. His name was not among them.
against:2.cnHint: 沈无咎____着试剑台边的石柱站立，目光却暗暗注视着我的每一个动作。
against:2.hook: My own name seemed to glow faintly on the stone.
against:2.line: 'Standing *against* the wind is the only way to test your roots.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu leaned *against* the carved stone pillar at the edge of the Trial Sword Stage, arms folded, eyes half shut.
Yet I felt his attention fixed on every move I made.
sentences.cn: 可我感觉到他的注意力固定在我的每一个动作上。

sentences.en: The pillar behind him was etched with the names of disciples who had failed here.
sentences.cn: 他身后的柱子上刻满了在这里失败过的弟子们的名字。

sentences.en: His name was not among them.
sentences.cn: 他的名字不在其中。

matter:2.en: I swept dust from a flat stone near the Trial Sword Stage and found a carved message beneath. 'It does not *matter* how many swords you have faced,' it read, 'only how clearly you saw yourself in their edge.' The words were cut deep, as though the one who wrote them needed to believe them.
matter:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台附近的石板上发现了一行刻字，说明胜负并非____所在。
matter:2.hook: The carving was still warm, as if just finished.
matter:2.line: 'The only *matter* worth solving is the fear inside your chest.'

sentences.en: I swept dust from a flat stone near the Trial Sword Stage and found a carved message beneath.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台附近的一块平石上扫去灰尘,发现了下面刻着的信息。

sentences.en: 'It does not *matter* how many swords you have faced,' it read, 'only how clearly you saw yourself in their edge.'
The words were cut deep, as though the one who wrote them needed to believe them.
sentences.cn: 那些字刻得很深,仿佛写下它们的人需要相信它们。

raise:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me a small clay pot she kept hidden beneath the Trial Sword Stage steps. Inside grew a pale herb she had managed to *raise* from a single seed over three months of careful watering. 'It blooms only when someone nearby is ready to advance,' she whispered, her voice quiet with wonder.
raise:2.cnHint: 小星在试剑台石阶下偷偷____着一株灵草，据说它会在有人即将突破时开花。
raise:2.hook: That evening, the herb opened its first white flower.
raise:2.line: 'I *raise* it not for glory, but to know when the moment comes.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me a small clay pot she kept hidden beneath the Trial Sword Stage steps.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了她藏在试剑台阶下的一个小陶罐。

sentences.en: Inside grew a pale herb she had managed to *raise* from a single seed over three months of careful watering.
'It blooms only when someone nearby is ready to advance,' she whispered, her voice quiet with wonder.
sentences.cn: "它只在附近有人准备进阶时才会开花,"她轻声说,嗓音里满是惊奇。

option:2.en: Master Qingwu placed two sealed jars before me on the Trial Sword Stage platform. One held a red mist, the other held blue. 'Each *option* will shape your path differently,' she said, offering no further guidance. The other disciples watched in silence. I stared at both jars until my reflection stared back.
option:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊在试剑台上摆出两个密封瓶，要我从中选择一个____。
option:2.hook: Neither jar cast any shadow on the stone.
option:2.line: 'Choose your *option* before the mist inside begins to move.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed two sealed jars before me on the Trial Sword Stage platform.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在试剑台平台上放了两个密封的罐子。

sentences.en: One held a red mist, the other held blue.
sentences.cn: 一个装着红雾,另一个装着蓝雾。

sentences.en: 'Each *option* will shape your path differently,' she said, offering no further guidance.
The other disciples watched in silence.
sentences.cn: 其他弟子在寂静中看着。

sentences.en: I stared at both jars until my reflection stared back.
sentences.cn: 我盯着两个罐子,直到我的倒影也盯着我。

society:2.en: Tucked inside a hollow post of the Trial Sword Stage, I found a thin booklet stamped with a circle of clouds. It was a record of the Cloud-Reader *Society* — a quiet group of disciples who had, for generations, left notes and signs for those who came after. I had never heard their name spoken aloud.
society:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台的柱子空洞里发现了一个秘密门人____留下的小册子。
society:2.hook: My own family name appeared on the last page.
society:2.line: 'Every member of our *society* leaves one truth behind before they leave.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside a hollow post of the Trial Sword Stage, I found a thin booklet stamped with a circle of clouds.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台的一个空心柱子里发现了一本薄薄的小册子,封面印着一圈云。

sentences.en: It was a record of the Cloud-Reader *Society* — a quiet group of disciples who had, for generations, left notes and signs for those who came after.
I had never heard their name spoken aloud.
sentences.cn: 我从来没听过有人说起他们的名字。

whole:2.en: I stood at the centre of the Trial Sword Stage and looked up. For one still moment, the *whole* sky above the floating mountain seemed to press down gently, as though the clouds themselves were watching. Shen Wujiu had told me this feeling meant something. I finally understood what he meant.
whole:2.cnHint: 我站在试剑台中央，感受到____天空似乎都在注视着我，终于明白师兄的那句话。
whole:2.hook: A single feather, black as ink, drifted down from nowhere.
whole:2.line: 'The *whole* stage changes when you stop performing and start listening.'

sentences.en: I stood at the centre of the Trial Sword Stage and looked up.
sentences.cn: 我站在试剑台的中心抬起头。

sentences.en: For one still moment, the *whole* sky above the floating mountain seemed to press down gently, as though the clouds themselves were watching.
Shen Wujiu had told me this feeling meant something.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎跟我说过这种感觉意味着什么。

sentences.en: I finally understood what he meant.
sentences.cn: 我终于明白他的意思了。

action:2.en: Below the Trial Sword Stage, I found a folded note tucked beneath a loose stone. It read: 'When the bell rings three times, every *action* you take on that platform will be observed by the inner elders.' My hand grew cold. I had planned to practise alone, unseen.
action:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台石缝中发现一张纸条，提醒我台上的每个____都会被长老看见。
action:2.hook: The bell had already rung twice.
action:2.line: 'Every *action* on that stage is recorded in the sect ledger,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: Below the Trial Sword Stage, I found a folded note tucked beneath a loose stone.
sentences.cn: 试剑台下方,我发现了一张折叠的纸条压在一块松动的石头下。

sentences.en: It read: 'When the bell rings three times, every *action* you take on that platform will be observed by the inner elders.'
My hand grew cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冰冷了。

sentences.en: I had planned to practise alone, unseen.
sentences.cn: 我本打算一个人练习,无人看见。

program:2.en: Pinned to the wooden post at the base of Trial Sword Stage was a long paper scroll. It listed the *program* for tomorrow's examination: each disciple would face three challenges in strict order — stance, breath, and blade. I read my name near the very end.
program:2.cnHint: 试剑台旁张贴了明日考核的____，我发现自己排在最后。
program:2.hook: The last position was said to carry the heaviest scrutiny.
program:2.line: 'Study the *program* tonight,' said Xiaoxing, 'or you will be caught off guard.'

sentences.en: Pinned to the wooden post at the base of Trial Sword Stage was a long paper scroll.
sentences.cn: 试剑台底部的木柱上钉着一张长纸卷。

sentences.en: It listed the *program* for tomorrow's examination: each disciple would face three challenges in strict order — stance, breath, and blade.
I read my name near the very end.
sentences.cn: 我在名单的最后附近看到了自己的名字。

situation:2.en: Halfway up the stone steps to Trial Sword Stage, I found an old message carved into the railing: 'Know your *situation* before you draw.' The words were worn but clear. Around me, mist thickened and the other disciples had vanished into the white cloud.
situation:2.cnHint: 我在台阶扶栏上发现一句古语，警示人要先认清自己的____，再出剑。
situation:2.hook: From somewhere above, a single sword rang out in the silence.
situation:2.line: 'Your *situation* is more dangerous than you think,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

sentences.en: Halfway up the stone steps to Trial Sword Stage, I found an old message carved into the railing: 'Know your *situation* before you draw.'
The words were worn but clear.
sentences.cn: 字迹磨损但清晰可辨。

sentences.en: Around me, mist thickened and the other disciples had vanished into the white cloud.
sentences.cn: 我周围的雾气越来越浓，其他弟子都消失在白云里了。

order:2.en: Inside a small bronze box hidden beneath the Trial Sword Stage altar stone, I discovered a list of names written in fading ink. My own name appeared at the top, first in *order*. Below it, in red, someone had added three words I could not yet read.
order:2.cnHint: 我在祭台下的铜匣里发现一份名单，自己的名字排在____第一位，下面还有三个红字。
order:2.hook: Red ink on a name list meant only one thing: a summons.
order:2.line: Master Qingwu spoke calmly: 'The *order* of names was not chosen by chance.'

sentences.en: Inside a small bronze box hidden beneath the Trial Sword Stage altar stone, I discovered a list of names written in fading ink.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台祭坛下的石头底下发现了一个青铜小盒，里面装着用褪色墨水写下的一份名单。
