sentences.en: My own name appeared at the top, first in *order*.
Below it, in red, someone had added three words I could not yet read.
sentences.cn: 下面用红笔加了三个字，我还看不清楚。

event:2.en: A notice board near the base of Trial Sword Stage announced a rare *event*: once every twelve years, the stage itself would resonate with the mountain's spiritual pulse at dawn. That dawn was tomorrow. Disciples who stood on the stage at that moment would have their true aptitude revealed.
event:2.cnHint: 布告栏上写着试剑台十二年一遇的____，明日黎明台上会显露弟子的真实资质。
event:2.hook: I was not sure I wanted the truth revealed.
event:2.line: 'This *event* only comes once in twelve years,' Xiaoxing whispered, her voice full of awe.

sentences.en: A notice board near the base of Trial Sword Stage announced a rare *event*: once every twelve years, the stage itself would resonate with the mountain's spiritual pulse at dawn.
That dawn was tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 那个黎明就在明天。

sentences.en: Disciples who stood on the stage at that moment would have their true aptitude revealed.
sentences.cn: 站在台上的弟子会在那一刻看清自己真正的资质。

account:2.en: Tucked inside my practice robe was a folded letter I did not remember receiving. It gave a careful *account* of the last disciple to fail the Trial Sword Stage — every mistake, every moment of hesitation, every breath taken at the wrong time. The final line read: 'Do not repeat this.'
account:2.cnHint: 我在衣袍中发现一封信，详细____了上一位在试剑台失败的弟子所犯的每个错误。
account:2.hook: The handwriting looked unsettlingly like my own.
account:2.line: 'Give a full *account* of what you saw on that stage,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Tucked inside my practice robe was a folded letter I did not remember receiving.
sentences.cn: 我的练功服里夹着一封折好的信，我不记得自己什么时候收到它。

sentences.en: It gave a careful *account* of the last disciple to fail the Trial Sword Stage — every mistake, every moment of hesitation, every breath taken at the wrong time.
The final line read: 'Do not repeat this.'
sentences.cn: 最后一行写的是："不要重蹈覆辙。"

deal:2.en: Beneath a cracked paving stone near Trial Sword Stage, I uncovered a small pouch and a note. The note described a *deal* struck long ago between two senior disciples: one would forfeit their turn on the stage, and in return receive a rare healing herb. The pouch held only dust now.
deal:2.cnHint: 我在石板下发现一张字条，记载着昔日两位师兄之间的一桩____，以弃权换珍草。
deal:2.hook: Whoever had taken the herb had left something else behind — a warning seal.
deal:2.line: 'A *deal* made in secret always finds its way into the light,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Beneath a cracked paving stone near Trial Sword Stage, I uncovered a small pouch and a note.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台附近的一块裂开的石板下挖到了一个小布袋和一张纸条。

sentences.en: The note described a *deal* struck long ago between two senior disciples: one would forfeit their turn on the stage, and in return receive a rare healing herb.
The pouch held only dust now.
sentences.cn: 布袋里现在只有尘埃。

degree:2.en: Mounted on the pillar of Trial Sword Stage was a narrow jade instrument I had never noticed before. It measured the *degree* of spiritual force a disciple released with each strike — a faint glow for little, a deep blue fire for great. Today it glowed a colour I had no name for.
degree:2.cnHint: 试剑台柱上的玉器能测量弟子出剑时灵力的____，而今天它发出了一种我叫不出名字的颜色。
degree:2.hook: Master Qingwu arrived, looked at the colour, and said nothing.
degree:2.line: 'The *degree* of your force today was beyond what the instrument expects,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Mounted on the pillar of Trial Sword Stage was a narrow jade instrument I had never noticed before.
sentences.cn: 试剑台的柱子上装着一件细长的玉器，我以前从没注意过。

sentences.en: It measured the *degree* of spiritual force a disciple released with each strike — a faint glow for little, a deep blue fire for great.
Today it glowed a colour I had no name for.
sentences.cn: 今天它闪着一种我叫不出名字的颜色。

mind:2.en: On the Testing Sword Platform, a hollow stone pillar held a single scroll. I unrolled it and found no diagram, only a question carved in fine strokes: what is the *mind* but a blade that cuts itself? I stood still, the cloud sea far below, until the answer rose quietly inside me.
mind:2.cnHint: 石柱上的卷轴里藏着一个问题，让我对自己的____产生了新的认识。
mind:2.hook: The carved words began to glow, then went dark.
mind:2.line: 'Your *mind* is the first sword you must learn to hold,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the Testing Sword Platform, a hollow stone pillar held a single scroll.
sentences.cn: 在测剑台上，一根空心的石柱里放着一卷书简。

sentences.en: I unrolled it and found no diagram, only a question carved in fine strokes: what is the *mind* but a blade that cuts itself?
I stood still, the cloud sea far below, until the answer rose quietly inside me.
sentences.cn: 我站在那里，云海在脚下，直到答案在我心里慢慢浮起。

rise:2.en: Shen Wujiu placed an old iron compass on the stone altar of the Testing Sword Platform. Its needle spun once, then pointed straight up. 'Watch,' he said. A thin column of spiritual mist began its slow *rise* from the base of the altar, wrapping around the compass like a living vine.
rise:2.cnHint: 祭台上的罗盘触发了灵雾的____，师兄在一旁静静观察。
rise:2.hook: Where the mist touched the compass, the iron turned gold.
rise:2.line: 'A steady *rise* of mist means the ground below us is no longer solid,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu placed an old iron compass on the stone altar of the Testing Sword Platform.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在测剑台的石祭坛上放了一个老铁罗盘。

sentences.en: Its needle spun once, then pointed straight up.
sentences.cn: 指针转了一圈，然后笔直地指向上方。

sentences.en: 'Watch,' he said.
sentences.cn: "看着，"他说。

sentences.en: A thin column of spiritual mist began its slow *rise* from the base of the altar, wrapping around the compass like a living vine.

prove:2.en: I found a jade slip wedged beneath a loose stone on the Testing Sword Platform. The sect record said the slip was lost decades ago. Holding it up before Xiaoxing, I felt the need to *prove* I had not taken it from the archive. My hands were shaking as I spoke.
prove:2.cnHint: 我在台上发现了失传已久的玉简，急于向师妹____自己是清白的。
prove:2.hook: Xiaoxing's eyes moved from the slip to something behind me.
prove:2.line: 'Then let the slip itself *prove* what you cannot say in words,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: I found a jade slip wedged beneath a loose stone on the Testing Sword Platform.
sentences.cn: 我在测剑台的一块松动的石头底下找到了一片玉简。

sentences.en: The sect record said the slip was lost decades ago.
sentences.cn: 宗门的记录说这片玉简几十年前就丢了。

sentences.en: Holding it up before Xiaoxing, I felt the need to *prove* I had not taken it from the archive.
My hands were shaking as I spoke.
sentences.cn: 我讲话的时候两手在发抖。

associate:2.en: A sealed letter on the Testing Sword Platform bore two names: mine and a senior disciple I barely knew. Master Qingwu explained that the sect would *associate* us for the trial ahead, pairing our strengths against each weakness. I glanced at the stranger beside me and gave a careful nod.
associate:2.cnHint: 掌门宣布将我与一位陌生师兄____在一起，共同参加考验。
associate:2.hook: The stranger's sleeve slipped, revealing a scar shaped like a broken sword.
associate:2.line: 'I do not choose whom I *associate* with — the sect chooses for me,' the senior disciple said quietly.

sentences.en: A sealed letter on the Testing Sword Platform bore two names: mine and a senior disciple I barely knew.
sentences.cn: 测剑台上有一封封好的信，上面写着两个名字：我的，还有一个我几乎不认识的师兄的。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu explained that the sect would *associate* us for the trial ahead, pairing our strengths against each weakness.
I glanced at the stranger beside me and gave a careful nod.
sentences.cn: 我瞥了一眼身边这个陌生人，谨慎地点了点头。

message:2.en: Tucked inside a cracked roof tile on the Testing Sword Platform, I found a folded paper. The *message* was short — three words in brushed ink: 'leave before dusk.' I did not recognise the handwriting. The afternoon light was already turning the cloud sea the colour of old bronze.
message:2.cnHint: 我在瓦缝中发现了一张纸条，____只有短短三个字。
message:2.hook: Dusk was less than one hour away.
message:2.line: 'A *message* with no name is still a message worth hearing,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Tucked inside a cracked roof tile on the Testing Sword Platform, I found a folded paper.
sentences.cn: 我在测剑台的屋顶上一块裂开的瓦片里找到了一张折好的纸。

sentences.en: The *message* was short — three words in brushed ink: 'leave before dusk.'
I did not recognise the handwriting.
sentences.cn: 我不认识这个笔迹。

sentences.en: The afternoon light was already turning the cloud sea the colour of old bronze.
sentences.cn: 下午的光线已经把云海染成了古铜色。

development:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread a long chart across the floor of the Platform's inner chamber. It traced the *development* of each disciple's spiritual force over three years, recorded in careful columns of ink. My line was the shortest. He said nothing, only tapped the blank space where next month should have been.
development:2.cnHint: 师兄展示了记录每位弟子灵力____的图表，我的那条线最短。
development:2.hook: The blank space at the end of my column felt like a warning.
development:2.line: '*Development* that stops here,' Shen Wujiu said, 'is not development — it is retreat.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a long chart across the floor of the Platform's inner chamber.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在台上内室的地板上铺开了一张长长的图表。

sentences.en: It traced the *development* of each disciple's spiritual force over three years, recorded in careful columns of ink.
My line was the shortest.
sentences.cn: 我的那条线是最短的。

sentences.en: He said nothing, only tapped the blank space where next month should have been.
sentences.cn: 他什么都没说，只是轻轻敲了敲下个月应该出现的空白地方。

later:2.en: The stone doors of the Testing Sword Platform closed behind us without a sound. Master Qingwu said we would review what each of us had found, but *later*, after the evening bell. I held the jade slip against my chest the whole walk back. The bell, I knew, would come too soon.
later:2.cnHint: 掌门说评审将在____进行，但我心中隐隐不安。
later:2.hook: The evening bell rang three hours early.
later:2.line: 'We will speak of what you carry *later* — if the night allows it,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The stone doors of the Testing Sword Platform closed behind us without a sound.
sentences.cn: 石门无声地在我们身后关上了。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu said we would review what each of us had found, but *later*, after the evening bell.
I held the jade slip against my chest the whole walk back.
sentences.cn: 我一路紧紧抱着那块玉简。

sentences.en: The bell, I knew, would come too soon.
sentences.cn: 我知道，钟声会来得太快。

maintain:2.en: Xiaoxing knelt at the edge of the Testing Sword Platform, both palms pressed flat on the stone. She was trying to *maintain* the thin shield of spirit-force she had raised, but the mountain wind kept tearing at its edges. I watched her face, calm and set, and did not dare look away.
maintain:2.cnHint: 师妹竭力____住自己在试剑台边缘召唤的灵力护盾。
maintain:2.hook: A single crack appeared in the stone beneath her hands.
maintain:2.line: 'To *maintain* stillness when the wind pulls hardest — that is the whole lesson,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing knelt at the edge of the Testing Sword Platform, both palms pressed flat on the stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在试剑台的边缘，两掌贴平在石头上。

sentences.en: She was trying to *maintain* the thin shield of spirit-force she had raised, but the mountain wind kept tearing at its edges.
I watched her face, calm and set, and did not dare look away.
sentences.cn: 我盯着她平静而坚定的脸，不敢移开目光。

nearly:2.en: Beneath the Trial Sword Platform, a stone tablet stood half-buried in pale moss. I brushed the surface clean and read the old inscription. The names of past disciples filled every line — I *nearly* missed the smallest name carved at the very bottom, faint as a whisper cut into the rock.
nearly:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台下的石碑上____错过了一个刻得极浅的名字。
nearly:2.hook: That faint name matched the one Master Qingwu never spoke aloud.
nearly:2.line: 'I *nearly* walked past it — look at the name cut here.'

sentences.en: Beneath the Trial Sword Platform, a stone tablet stood half-buried in pale moss.
sentences.cn: 试剑台下，一块石碑半埋在淡青苔里。

sentences.en: I brushed the surface clean and read the old inscription.
sentences.cn: 我拂去表面的尘埃，读了这段古老的铭文。

sentences.en: The names of past disciples filled every line — I *nearly* missed the smallest name carved at the very bottom, faint as a whisper cut into the rock.

wrong:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a worn scroll found wedged beneath the platform steps. The formula inside looked familiar, yet something felt *wrong* — two herb signs were reversed, enough to turn a healing word into a harmful one. A deliberate mistake, or a warning left by an old hand?
wrong:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一卷藏在台阶下的旧卷轴，其中有一处____的符文令人不安。
wrong:2.hook: Whoever reversed those signs had done it with care, not carelessness.
wrong:2.line: 'Something is *wrong* with this formula — do not speak it aloud.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a worn scroll found wedged beneath the platform steps.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一卷从台阶下角落里找到的旧卷轴。

sentences.en: The formula inside looked familiar, yet something felt *wrong* — two herb signs were reversed, enough to turn a healing word into a harmful one.
A deliberate mistake, or a warning left by an old hand?
sentences.cn: 是故意留下的错误，还是老人留下的警告？

variety:2.en: Inside a hollow beneath the Trial Sword Platform I found a small clay jar sealed with wax. When I opened it, a *variety* of dried spirit-herbs spilled onto my palm — five kinds I could name and two I had never seen in the sect's herb garden. Someone had gathered widely and hidden them here long ago.
variety:2.cnHint: 台下的暗格里藏着一只小陶罐，里面装有多种____的灵草。
variety:2.hook: One of the unknown herbs carried a faint scent of high-cloud frost.
variety:2.line: 'This *variety* of herbs could only come from beyond our mountain.'

sentences.en: Inside a hollow beneath the Trial Sword Platform I found a small clay jar sealed with wax.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台下的一个凹陷处找到了一个用蜡封住的小陶罐。

sentences.en: When I opened it, a *variety* of dried spirit-herbs spilled onto my palm — five kinds I could name and two I had never seen in the sect's herb garden.
Someone had gathered widely and hidden them here long ago.
sentences.cn: 不知多久前，有人在这里收集并藏匿了它们。

clear:2.en: A thin sheet of spirit-glass had been pressed flat against the underside of the platform's central stone. Held up to the morning light, the etchings on it became *clear* — a map of the Cloud Sea Sect's inner peaks, with one path marked that appeared on no teaching scroll I had ever read.
clear:2.cnHint: 一片灵玻璃在晨光下让那幅地图变得____，其中标有一条从未记载的小路。
clear:2.hook: The marked path led straight toward the peak no disciple was allowed to climb.
clear:2.line: 'Now it is *clear* — this path was hidden on purpose.'

sentences.en: A thin sheet of spirit-glass had been pressed flat against the underside of the platform's central stone.
sentences.cn: 一片薄薄的灵玻被压在了台阶中央石块的底面。

sentences.en: Held up to the morning light, the etchings on it became *clear* — a map of the Cloud Sea Sect's inner peaks, with one path marked that appeared on no teaching scroll I had ever read.

gain:2.en: Xiaoxing found a locked iron box beneath a loose floor tile near the platform's edge. Inside lay a single note in Master Qingwu's hand: whoever masters the three wind-words written here will *gain* the power to read the clouds as a living text. The words were short, but the promise they carried felt vast.
gain:2.cnHint: 师妹在台边发现了一个铁盒，其中一张纸条写着掌握三个风字所能____的力量。
gain:2.hook: Three words — yet each one hummed against the air when I read them.
gain:2.line: 'With this, we *gain* something the outer disciples will never know.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found a locked iron box beneath a loose floor tile near the platform's edge.
sentences.cn: 小杏在台阶边松动的地砖下找到了一个上了锁的铁箱。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single note in Master Qingwu's hand: whoever masters the three wind-words written here will *gain* the power to read the clouds as a living text.
The words were short, but the promise they carried felt vast.
sentences.cn: 这些字很短，但它们承载的诺言却显得辽阔。

maybe:2.en: Tucked into a crack in the Trial Sword Platform's east pillar was a folded paper crane, its wings marked with ink symbols I could not fully read. *Maybe* it was a message sent years ago by a disciple who never returned; the symbols were cold and patient, as if still waiting for the right pair of eyes.
maybe:2.cnHint: 东柱石缝里藏着一只纸鹤，上面的符文____是某位再未归来的弟子留下的。
maybe:2.hook: One symbol on the wing glowed faintly when my fingers drew near.
maybe:2.line: '*Maybe* whoever folded this is still somewhere on the cloud sea.'

sentences.en: Tucked into a crack in the Trial Sword Platform's east pillar was a folded paper crane, its wings marked with ink symbols I could not fully read.
sentences.cn: 一只折纸鹤塞在试剑台东柱的裂缝里，翅膀上用墨水标了些我看不太懂的符号。

sentences.en: *Maybe* it was a message sent years ago by a disciple who never returned; the symbols were cold and patient, as if still waiting for the right pair of eyes.

huge:2.en: When Shen Wujiu pressed the worn spirit-seal onto the platform's central altar stone, the response was not what any of us expected. A *huge* character rose from the stone in pale light — a word so old that none of our teaching scrolls carried its full meaning, yet its weight pressed down on the chest like a held breath.
huge:2.cnHint: 师兄将灵印按在祭台上，一个____的古老字符随即从石中升起。
huge:2.hook: Master Qingwu, watching from the path above, went very still.
huge:2.line: 'That *huge* character — it has not appeared in three hundred years.'

sentences.en: When Shen Wujiu pressed the worn spirit-seal onto the platform's central altar stone, the response was not what any of us expected.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把那枚磨损的灵印按在台阶中央的祭坛石上时，结果出乎我们所有人的意料。

sentences.en: A *huge* character rose from the stone in pale light — a word so old that none of our teaching scrolls carried its full meaning, yet its weight pressed down on the chest like a held breath.

diet:2.en: Folded inside the platform's offering box was a yellowed instruction sheet meant for inner disciples long past. It described a strict *diet* of five spirit-herbs to be eaten before any sword-word trial, each herb chosen to quiet the mind and steady the breath. The final line read: skip one herb and the word may turn against you.
diet:2.cnHint: 供奉箱里的旧纸上记载着试剑前弟子须遵守的____，缺少一味灵草则凶多吉少。
diet:2.hook: I counted the herbs in my pouch — I had brought only four.
diet:2.line: 'Follow this *diet* before the trial, or the words will not obey you.'

sentences.en: Folded inside the platform's offering box was a yellowed instruction sheet meant for inner disciples long past.
sentences.cn: 祭坛供奉箱里折着一张泛黄的指示纸，是给早已过去的内门弟子写的。

sentences.en: It described a strict *diet* of five spirit-herbs to be eaten before any sword-word trial, each herb chosen to quiet the mind and steady the breath.
The final line read: skip one herb and the word may turn against you.
sentences.cn: 最后一行写着：少一味草药，剑言可能反噬。

animal:2.en: Deep inside the Sword-Trial Terrace, I found a hollow stone altar. Carved into its face was a small *animal* — a fox with nine tails, each tail coiling around a different sword glyph. Master Qingwu had never spoken of this symbol. Dust lay thick upon it, undisturbed for what felt like a thousand years.
animal:2.cnHint: 石台深处刻着一只神秘的____图腾，师尊从未提及它的存在。
animal:2.hook: The ninth tail glowed faint red as I reached out my hand.
animal:2.line: 'That *animal* is no mere carving — step back, junior sister,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Deep inside the Sword-Trial Terrace, I found a hollow stone altar.
sentences.cn: 在剑试台的深处，我找到了一座空心石坛。

sentences.en: Carved into its face was a small *animal* — a fox with nine tails, each tail coiling around a different sword glyph.
Master Qingwu had never spoken of this symbol.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从未提起过这个符号。

sentences.en: Dust lay thick upon it, undisturbed for what felt like a thousand years.
sentences.cn: 厚厚的尘埃覆盖其上，仿佛已经千年未曾有人触碰。

goal:2.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the far end of the Sword-Trial Terrace, his eyes fixed on a pillar of light rising from the stone floor. 'Our *goal* is to reach that light before the cloud-tide turns,' he said quietly. A folded message lay at the pillar's base, sealed with Master Qingwu's mark.
goal:2.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台上说明了此行的____，那里有师尊留下的封印信件。
goal:2.hook: The sealed message trembled, as if it had been waiting only for us.
goal:2.line: 'The *goal* was never the sword — read what she left us,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the far end of the Sword-Trial Terrace, his eyes fixed on a pillar of light rising from the stone floor.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在剑试台的远端，眼睛盯着从石地升起的一根光柱。

sentences.en: 'Our *goal* is to reach that light before the cloud-tide turns,' he said quietly.
A folded message lay at the pillar's base, sealed with Master Qingwu's mark.
sentences.cn: 一封折起的讯息放在光柱的底部，用青梧师尊的印章封着。

adult:2.en: The message Master Qingwu had pressed into the stone read: 'Only an *adult* who has shed one fear may lift the trial blade.' I read it twice, standing alone on the cold terrace. Xiaoxing had not yet arrived. The wind rose sharply, carrying the scent of burnt herbs from somewhere below.
adult:2.cnHint: 师尊留在试剑台上的字迹写道，只有____才能取走那把试剑。
adult:2.hook: I was not sure I had shed any fear at all.
adult:2.line: 'An *adult* chooses to stay when a child would run,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: The message Master Qingwu had pressed into the stone read: 'Only an *adult* who has shed one fear may lift the trial blade.'
I read it twice, standing alone on the cold terrace.
sentences.cn: 我独自站在冰冷的露台上,把这条信息读了两遍。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had not yet arrived.
sentences.cn: 小杏还没到。

sentences.en: The wind rose sharply, carrying the scent of burnt herbs from somewhere below.
sentences.cn: 风势陡起,吹来了下方某处燃烧草药的气味。

poor:2.en: I discovered a cracked spirit-tablet near the edge of the Sword-Trial Terrace. Etched on it was a disciple's name I did not know, and below the name, three words: *poor* in will. The wind carried a low hum across the stones. Shen Wujiu stood behind me, silent, his hand resting on his sword.
poor:2.cnHint: 试剑台边缘的破碎灵牌上刻着一位弟子的名字，以及对他____的评价。
poor:2.hook: Someone had pressed a fresh fingerprint into the dust beside the tablet.
poor:2.line: 'A *poor* foundation can still be mended — do not pity the name,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I discovered a cracked spirit-tablet near the edge of the Sword-Trial Terrace.
sentences.cn: 我在剑试露台的边缘发现了一块裂开的灵牌。

sentences.en: Etched on it was a disciple's name I did not know, and below the name, three words: *poor* in will.
The wind carried a low hum across the stones.
sentences.cn: 风在石板间吹过,发出低沉的嗡鸣声。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood behind me, silent, his hand resting on his sword.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身后,无声地站着,手放在剑上。

price:2.en: Tucked beneath the trial stone, I found a thin scroll. It listed every disciple who had passed this terrace, and beside each name, a *price* — years of life offered, memories given, senses dulled. Master Qingwu's name appeared near the top. The number beside it was larger than all the rest.
price:2.cnHint: 试剑台石板下的卷轴记载了每位弟子通过时所付出的____。
price:2.hook: Master Qingwu's number had been crossed out and written again, twice as large.
price:2.line: 'Every path has its *price*; she paid more than we will ever know,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Tucked beneath the trial stone, I found a thin scroll.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑石下掏出一卷薄薄的纸轴。

sentences.en: It listed every disciple who had passed this terrace, and beside each name, a *price* — years of life offered, memories given, senses dulled.
Master Qingwu's name appeared near the top.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊的名字出现在靠近顶端的地方。

sentences.en: The number beside it was larger than all the rest.
sentences.cn: 旁边的数字比其他所有的都要大。

type:2.en: Near the inner ring of the Sword-Trial Terrace stood seven stone posts, each carved with a different *type* of cloud formation. Shen Wujiu pointed to the fifth post, where a small hollow had been cut into the stone. Inside lay a folded note in Xiaoxing's handwriting: 'It opens at dusk. Wait here.'
type:2.cnHint: 试剑台内圈的石柱上刻有不同____的云纹，第五根柱子里藏着小星的纸条。
type:2.hook: Dusk was no more than one hour away, and the clouds below were already turning gold.
type:2.line: 'This *type* of seal only responds to someone who has no fear left,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Near the inner ring of the Sword-Trial Terrace stood seven stone posts, each carved with a different *type* of cloud formation.
Shen Wujiu pointed to the fifth post, where a small hollow had been cut into the stone.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎指向第五根柱子,那里的石头上挖出了一个小空心。

sentences.en: Inside lay a folded note in Xiaoxing's handwriting: 'It opens at dusk.
sentences.cn: 里面放着一张用小杏笔迹写的折叠纸条:"天黑时会打开。

sentences.en: Wait here.'
sentences.cn: 在这里等着。"

sense:2.en: The moment I stepped onto the central stone of the Sword-Trial Terrace, a strange *sense* of being watched settled over me — not fear, but a deep, still pressure, like standing inside a held breath. I looked up. High above, carved into the cliff face, two empty eyes stared down without blinking.
sense:2.cnHint: 踏上试剑台中央石板的那一刻，我产生了一种被注视的____。
sense:2.hook: When I blinked, the carved eyes had shifted, just slightly, to the left.
sense:2.line: 'Trust that *sense* — this terrace remembers every disciple who doubted it,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The moment I stepped onto the central stone of the Sword-Trial Terrace, a strange *sense* of being watched settled over me — not fear, but a deep, still pressure, like standing inside a held breath.
I looked up.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头。

sentences.en: High above, carved into the cliff face, two empty eyes stared down without blinking.
sentences.cn: 高高的崖面上,雕刻着两只空洞的眼睛,目不转睛地盯着下方。

rate:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed her hand to the trial stone and pulled it back with wide eyes. 'The *rate* at which it draws spirit-force is far beyond what the records say,' she whispered, showing me her reddened palm. On the stone's surface, a new line of text was forming, character by character, as if being written from underneath.
rate:2.cnHint: 小星发现试剑台吸取灵力的____远超典籍所载，石面上正浮现出新的文字。
rate:2.hook: The last character to appear was none of our names — it was Master Qingwu's.
rate:2.line: 'At this *rate*, the terrace will seal itself before nightfall,' Xiaoxing said, voice tight.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed her hand to the trial stone and pulled it back with wide eyes.
sentences.cn: 小杏把手按在试剑石上,又快速缩回来,睁大了眼睛。

sentences.en: 'The *rate* at which it draws spirit-force is far beyond what the records say,' she whispered, showing me her reddened palm.
On the stone's surface, a new line of text was forming, character by character, as if being written from underneath.
sentences.cn: 在石头表面,新的一行文字在形成,一个字接一个字,就像是从下面被写上来的。

within:2.en: A folded note lay on the stone table of the trial platform. I opened it slowly. *Within* the narrow space of three lines, Master Qingwu had written every word I would need to survive the coming test. Each word glowed faintly, like a seed waiting for soil. I read them once, and the clouds below the mountain trembled.
within:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台的石桌上发现了师尊留下的字条，____三行文字之内藏着通过考验的关键。
within:2.hook: But the fourth line had been torn away.
within:2.line: 'Everything you need is *within* these three lines — do not seek more.'

sentences.en: A folded note lay on the stone table of the trial platform.
sentences.cn: 试验平台的石桌上放着一张折叠纸条。

sentences.en: I opened it slowly.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢打开它。

sentences.en: *Within* the narrow space of three lines, Master Qingwu had written every word I would need to survive the coming test.
Each word glowed faintly, like a seed waiting for soil.
sentences.cn: 每个字都微微发光,像是等待入土的种子。

sentences.en: I read them once, and the clouds below the mountain trembled.
sentences.cn: 我读了一遍,山下的云层颤动了。

either:2.en: Two jade scrolls rested side by side on the trial platform's altar. Shen Wujiu warned me before dawn: *either* scroll, opened alone, would release only half its power. I stood between them, hands trembling. The clouds below had gone perfectly still, and somewhere in that stillness, a choice was already being made for me.
either:2.cnHint: 试剑台的祭坛上放着两卷玉简，师兄告诫我____一卷单独打开都只有半数之力。
either:2.hook: Then one scroll began to glow without being touched.
either:2.line: '*Either* path leads forward — but only one leads back.'

sentences.en: Two jade scrolls rested side by side on the trial platform's altar.
sentences.cn: 两卷玉简并排放在试验平台的祭坛上。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu warned me before dawn: *either* scroll, opened alone, would release only half its power.
I stood between them, hands trembling.
sentences.cn: 我站在它们之间,双手颤抖。

sentences.en: The clouds below had gone perfectly still, and somewhere in that stillness, a choice was already being made for me.
sentences.cn: 下方的云已经完全静止,在那片静寂里,一个选择已经为我做好了。

various:2.en: Carved into the stone floor of the trial platform were *various* symbols, each drawn from a different age of the sect. Xiaoxing knelt beside me, tracing them with one careful finger. Some meant healing, some meant speed, one ancient mark no one could read any more. A cold wind rose, and that unread mark began to shine.
various:2.cnHint: 试剑台石地上刻着____种来自不同年代的符文，师妹和我一起仔细辨认它们的含义。
various:2.hook: The unread mark pulsed once, then spelled a name.
various:2.line: '*Various* signs are carved here, but only one is still alive.'

sentences.en: Carved into the stone floor of the trial platform were *various* symbols, each drawn from a different age of the sect.
Xiaoxing knelt beside me, tracing them with one careful finger.
sentences.cn: 小杏跪在我身旁,用一根谨慎的手指追踪着它们。

sentences.en: Some meant healing, some meant speed, one ancient mark no one could read any more.
sentences.cn: 有些意味着治愈,有些意味着速度,有一个古老的符号已经没人能读懂了。

sentences.en: A cold wind rose, and that unread mark began to shine.
sentences.cn: 冷风吹起,那个无法辨认的符号开始闪闪发光。

main:2.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the great arch at the edge of the trial platform. 'That is the *main* gate of the upper peak,' she said softly. 'Pass through it and your rank changes forever.' I looked up. A single feather, white as cloud, drifted down from the arch and landed at my feet. No bird flew above.
main:2.cnHint: 师妹指着试剑台边缘的大拱门说，那是通往上峰的____要入口，通过之后身份便会改变。
main:2.line: 'The *main* gate only opens for those the mountain has already chosen.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the great arch at the edge of the trial platform.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向试验平台边缘的大拱门。

sentences.en: 'That is the *main* gate of the upper peak,' she said softly.
'Pass through it and your rank changes forever.'
sentences.cn: "通过它,你的身份就永远改变了。"

sentences.en: I looked up.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头。

sentences.en: A single feather, white as cloud, drifted down from the arch and landed at my feet.
sentences.cn: 一根洁白如云的羽毛从拱门飘落下来,落在我的脚边。

sentences.en: No bird flew above.
sentences.cn: 上方没有鸟在飞。

traditional:2.en: At the far end of the testing platform, a stone tablet listed every disciple who had ever passed the trial. Shen Wujiu pointed to a line near the top. 'This is the *traditional* way we begin,' he said quietly. 'You read the oldest name aloud, and the tablet listens.' I read the name. The stone grew warm beneath my fingers.
traditional:2.cnHint: 在试剑台的石碑前，师兄告诉我，念出最古老的名字是入门前的____仪式。
traditional:2.hook: A hairline crack spread upward through the tablet, glowing faint gold.
traditional:2.line: 'This is the *traditional* way we begin — read the oldest name aloud.'

sentences.en: At the far end of the testing platform, a stone tablet listed every disciple who had ever passed the trial.
sentences.cn: 在测试平台的远端,一块石碑列出了所有曾经通过试炼的弟子的名字。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pointed to a line near the top.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎指向靠近顶端的一行。

sentences.en: 'This is the *traditional* way we begin,' he said quietly.
'You read the oldest name aloud, and the tablet listens.'
sentences.cn: "你大声读出最古老的名字,石碑会听。"

sentences.en: I read the name.
sentences.cn: 我读出了那个名字。

sentences.en: The stone grew warm beneath my fingers.
sentences.cn: 石头在我的指尖下变得温暖。

expert:2.en: A folded note lay at the center of the testing platform, held flat by a small stone. It read: 'An *expert* in the word for wind once stood here and shook the clouds apart. You are not there yet — but the platform remembers everyone who tries.' I looked up. The clouds below were spinning slowly, as if stirred by an old breath.
expert:2.cnHint: 试剑台上的纸条提醒我，只有____才能震荡云海，而我尚未到达那一步。
expert:2.hook: The small stone lifted an inch off the ground, then held perfectly still.
expert:2.line: 'An *expert* in the word for wind once shook these clouds apart.'

sentences.en: A folded note lay at the center of the testing platform, held flat by a small stone.
sentences.cn: 一张折叠纸条放在测试平台的中心,用一块小石头压平。

sentences.en: It read: 'An *expert* in the word for wind once stood here and shook the clouds apart.
You are not there yet — but the platform remembers everyone who tries.'
sentences.cn: "你还没到那一步——但平台记得每一个尝试过的人。"

sentences.en: I looked up.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头。

sentences.en: The clouds below were spinning slowly, as if stirred by an old breath.
sentences.cn: 下方的云缓缓旋转,仿佛被一阵古老的呼吸搅动。

member:2.en: On the railing of the testing platform, each *member* of the Cloud Sea Sect had carved a single word — their first word, the one that had opened their path. I found Xiaoxing's carving near the east corner: the word for 'light,' cut small and neat. Below it, a blank space waited, the wood still pale and unweathered.
member:2.cnHint: 试剑台的栏杆上，每位____都刻下了自己最初掌握的词，小星的那个字旁边留着空白。
member:2.hook: The blank space shimmered faintly, as though it already knew my word.
member:2.line: 'Every *member* of our sect carves their first word here — yours is next.'

sentences.en: On the railing of the testing platform, each *member* of the Cloud Sea Sect had carved a single word — their first word, the one that had opened their path.
I found Xiaoxing's carving near the east corner: the word for 'light,' cut small and neat.
sentences.cn: 我在东角附近发现了小杏的刻痕：一个"光"字，刻得小巧精致。

sentences.en: Below it, a blank space waited, the wood still pale and unweathered.
sentences.cn: 它下面空着一块地方，木头还是新鲜的淡色。

heart:2.en: Master Qingwu had left a scroll on the stone altar at the center of the testing platform. I unrolled it carefully. One line filled the page: 'The word you choose at trial is the *heart* of every formula you will ever speak — choose it the way you would choose a direction to walk forever.' I rolled the scroll closed. Somewhere below, a bell rang once inside the clouds.
heart:2.cnHint: 师尊留下的卷轴上写着，在试剑台选择的词，是此后所有法诀的____。
heart:2.hook: The bell rang a second time, though no one had touched it.
heart:2.line: 'The word you choose at trial is the *heart* of every formula you will ever speak.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had left a scroll on the stone altar at the center of the testing platform.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在测试台中央的石坛上留了一卷书。

sentences.en: I unrolled it carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地展开它。

sentences.en: One line filled the page: 'The word you choose at trial is the *heart* of every formula you will ever speak — choose it the way you would choose a direction to walk forever.'
I rolled the scroll closed.
sentences.cn: 我卷起书卷。

sentences.en: Somewhere below, a bell rang once inside the clouds.
sentences.cn: 下方某处，一口钟在云里敲响了一下。

worker:2.en: Deep in the Trial Sword Hall, I found a forgotten scroll pinned beneath a cracked stone. It read: 'Every great *worker* of words begins here, shaping one syllable at a time.' The ink still glowed faintly, as though the writer had only just set it down. Outside, the wind through the sword racks began to hum a single low note.
worker:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台深处发现一卷古旧书简，上面写着每一位勤勉的____都从此处起步。
worker:2.hook: The humming grew louder, and the scroll began to fold itself.
worker:2.line: 'A true *worker* of words does not rush — the herb reveals itself when you are ready.'

sentences.en: Deep in the Trial Sword Hall, I found a forgotten scroll pinned beneath a cracked stone.
sentences.cn: 在试剑殿深处，我发现了一卷被压在裂开的石头下的遗忘书卷。

sentences.en: It read: 'Every great *worker* of words begins here, shaping one syllable at a time.'
The ink still glowed faintly, as though the writer had only just set it down.
sentences.cn: 墨迹仍在微微发光，仿佛书写者才刚刚放下笔。

sentences.en: Outside, the wind through the sword racks began to hum a single low note.
sentences.cn: 外面，剑架间的风开始哼出一个低音符。

control:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin jade slip carved with the word 'still.' 'Hold it,' he said, 'and *control* your breath until the carving warms.' I pressed the slip between my palms. For one perfect moment, the wind stopped, the clouds below parted, and I could see all the way down to nothing. Then a crack ran across the jade.
control:2.cnHint: 师兄交给我一枚玉简，要我____呼吸，直到玉简发热，但它却突然碎裂了。
control:2.hook: The crack hissed with cold mist, and the clouds below rushed back up fast.
control:2.line: 'You must *control* the breath before the word will listen to you.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin jade slip carved with the word 'still.'
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一片薄玉片，上面刻着"静"字。

sentences.en: 'Hold it,' he said, 'and *control* your breath until the carving warms.'
I pressed the slip between my palms.
sentences.cn: 我把玉片夹在两只手掌之间。

sentences.en: For one perfect moment, the wind stopped, the clouds below parted, and I could see all the way down to nothing.
sentences.cn: 那一刻完美无瑕，风停住了，下方的云散开了，我能看到一直向下延伸到虚无。

sentences.en: Then a crack ran across the jade.
sentences.cn: 然后玉片上出现了一条裂纹。

product:2.en: On the stone shelf of the Trial Sword Hall rested three sealed jars, each the *product* of a senior disciple's year-long study. Xiaoxing read the labels aloud in a quiet voice, her finger hovering but never touching. The third jar held a word none of us recognized. Its seal pulsed with a dull amber light.
product:2.cnHint: 试剑台石架上摆着三只封坛，每一只都是师兄姐一年苦修的____，第三只坛子的封印却在微微跳动。
product:2.hook: The amber light blinked once, then went dark without warning.
product:2.line: 'This jar is the *product* of three hundred days — do not open it carelessly.'

sentences.en: On the stone shelf of the Trial Sword Hall rested three sealed jars, each the *product* of a senior disciple's year-long study.
Xiaoxing read the labels aloud in a quiet voice, her finger hovering but never touching.
sentences.cn: 小杏用细小的嗓音读出标签，手指悬在上方但没有接触。

sentences.en: The third jar held a word none of us recognized.
sentences.cn: 第三个罐子里装着我们都不认识的字。

sentences.en: Its seal pulsed with a dull amber light.
sentences.cn: 它的封印闪烁着暗沉的琥珀色光。

practice:2.en: I discovered a worn patch of floor in the far corner of the Trial Sword Hall — stone smoothed by years of standing feet. A note tucked in the wall read: 'Daily *practice* leaves its mark on stone as surely as on the self.' I placed my own feet in the worn hollow and spoke the first formula I knew. The air tasted briefly of pine.
practice:2.cnHint: 我在试剑台角落发现地板被磨得光滑，一张字条提醒我日常____会在石头与心灵上同样留下印记。
practice:2.hook: The pine taste faded and was replaced by something sharper, like lightning before it falls.
practice:2.line: 'Without daily *practice*, the word fades from the tongue like morning frost.'

sentences.en: I discovered a worn patch of floor in the far corner of the Trial Sword Hall — stone smoothed by years of standing feet.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑殿远角发现了一块磨损的地板——被多年的站立脚步打磨得光滑的石头。

sentences.en: A note tucked in the wall read: 'Daily *practice* leaves its mark on stone as surely as on the self.'
I placed my own feet in the worn hollow and spoke the first formula I knew.
sentences.cn: 我把脚放在磨损的凹陷里，说出我知道的第一个法术。

sentences.en: The air tasted briefly of pine.
sentences.cn: 空气里短暂地带着松树的味道。

environment:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to the outer edge of the Trial Sword Hall, where the platform jutted over open sky. 'Notice the *environment*,' she said. 'Cloud, wind, altitude — a word spoken here carries three times the weight of one spoken indoors.' I repeated the simplest greeting I knew. It rang out like a small bell and kept ringing long after my mouth was closed.
environment:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我到试剑台边缘，让我留意周围的____，说在此处开口，字句的分量会加倍。
environment:2.hook: The echo of that small word drifted down into the clouds and did not return.
environment:2.line: 'Read the *environment* first — the same word can heal or unsettle depending on where it lands.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to the outer edge of the Trial Sword Hall, where the platform jutted over open sky.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把我带到试剑殿的外缘，平台在那里悬伸在开阔的天空上。

sentences.en: 'Notice the *environment*,' she said.
'Cloud, wind, altitude — a word spoken here carries three times the weight of one spoken indoors.'
sentences.cn: "云、风、高度——在这里说出的字的分量是室内说出的字的三倍。"

sentences.en: I repeated the simplest greeting I knew.
sentences.cn: 我重复了我知道的最简单的问候。

sentences.en: It rang out like a small bell and kept ringing long after my mouth was closed.
sentences.cn: 它像一个小钟一样响起，在我嘴巴闭上之后还继续响着。

system:2.en: Behind the weapon racks I found a diagram etched into the wall: circles, lines, and small characters flowing from one ring to the next. Shen Wujiu appeared at my shoulder. 'That is the sect's word *system*,' he said softly, tracing an outer ring with one finger. 'Every formula connects. Pull one thread and the rest will feel it.' A low vibration moved through the stone under my hand.
system:2.cnHint: 我在兵架后发现一幅图刻于石壁，师兄说那是门派的词语____，牵一发而动全身。
system:2.hook: The vibration reached the weapon racks, and one sword turned slowly on its peg.
system:2.line: 'Learn the *system* before you try to change any single part of it.'

sentences.en: Behind the weapon racks I found a diagram etched into the wall: circles, lines, and small characters flowing from one ring to the next.
sentences.cn: 在武器架后面，我发现了一个蚀刻在墙上的图案：圆圈、线条和小字符从一个环流向下一个环。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu appeared at my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎出现在我的肩膀处。

sentences.en: 'That is the sect's word *system*,' he said softly, tracing an outer ring with one finger.
'Every formula connects.
sentences.cn: "每一个法术都相互连接。

sentences.en: Pull one thread and the rest will feel it.'
sentences.cn: 拉动一根线，其他的都会感受到。"

sentences.en: A low vibration moved through the stone under my hand.
sentences.cn: 一种低的震动穿过我手下的石头。

natural:2.en: Xiaoxing found me struggling to recall a healing word and sat beside me on the cold stone steps. 'Let it be *natural*,' she said, placing a small dried herb — shaped exactly like the character for 'ease' — into my palm. I looked at the herb, and the word rose without effort, clear and whole. A white moth landed on my wrist and stayed perfectly still.
natural:2.cnHint: 小星发现我记不住一个疗愈词，她递给我一株草药，让我顺其____，字句竟不费力地浮现出来。
natural:2.hook: The white moth lifted away, and the herb in my palm turned faintly gold.
natural:2.line: 'A *natural* gift is only a beginning — what you build on it is the real work.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me struggling to recall a healing word and sat beside me on the cold stone steps.
sentences.cn: 小杏发现我在努力回忆一个疗愈用的字，就坐在我身边冷冰冰的石阶上。

sentences.en: 'Let it be *natural*,' she said, placing a small dried herb — shaped exactly like the character for 'ease' — into my palm.
I looked at the herb, and the word rose without effort, clear and whole.
sentences.cn: 我看着这株草药，字就毫不费力地浮现出来了，清晰而完整。

sentences.en: A white moth landed on my wrist and stayed perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 一只白蛾停在我的手腕上，完全不动。

free:2.en: At the end of my first week, Master Qingwu placed her hand briefly on the top of the door frame as I stepped out of the Trial Sword Hall. 'You are *free* to return to your room,' she said, 'but the words you have held today will not let you rest so easily.' She was already gone before I could answer. Above the hall, one lone cloud had separated from the sea below and was rising.
free:2.cnHint: 第一周结束，青雾师尊告诉我可以____离开了，但她的话让我知道今日所习的字句不会轻易放过我。
free:2.hook: The rising cloud took the shape of a character I had not yet been taught.
free:2.line: 'You are *free* to leave — but some words, once heard, will follow you home.'

sentences.en: At the end of my first week, Master Qingwu placed her hand briefly on the top of the door frame as I stepped out of the Trial Sword Hall.
sentences.cn: 在我的第一周结束时，青梧师尊把手短暂地放在门框顶部，我走出试剑殿时。

sentences.en: 'You are *free* to return to your room,' she said, 'but the words you have held today will not let you rest so easily.'
She was already gone before I could answer.
sentences.cn: 她在我能回答之前就已经走了。

sentences.en: Above the hall, one lone cloud had separated from the sea below and was rising.
sentences.cn: 在大殿上方，一朵孤独的云从下方的云海中分离出来，正在升起。

deal:1.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, Shen Wujiu watched the younger disciples receive their first assignments. Some were given simple herb-gathering tasks; others faced far harder tests. 'Master Qingwu gives each of us what we can carry,' he said. 'But Xiaoxing got a *deal* far heavier than her years deserve.'
deal:1.cnHint: 在试剑台上，师兄注意到小星所受的____远超她的资历。
deal:1.hook: Xiaoxing's hands trembled as she read the scroll.
deal:1.line: 'She received a *deal* no first-year disciple should face alone.'

sentences.en: On the Trial Sword Platform, Shen Wujiu watched the younger disciples receive their first assignments.
sentences.cn: 在试剑台上，沈无咎看着年轻的弟子们接到他们的第一批任务。

sentences.en: Some were given simple herb-gathering tasks; others faced far harder tests.
sentences.cn: 有些人被分配了简单的采药任务，有些人面临更艰难的考验。

sentences.en: 'Master Qingwu gives each of us what we can carry,' he said.
sentences.cn: "青梧师尊给我们每个人的都是我们能承载的东西，"他说。

sentences.en: 'But Xiaoxing got a *deal* far heavier than her years deserve.'

employee:2.en: A folded note fell from a crack in the Trial Sword Stage. I picked it up and read: someone had hired a worker to leave a false medicine pouch near the steps. That *employee* had no name, only a small mark — a cloud with three cuts through it. Master Qingwu's eyes narrowed when I showed her.
employee:2.cnHint: 试剑台的石缝里藏着一张字条，揭示有人雇了一名____在台阶旁放置假药囊。
employee:2.hook: The mark on the note matched Shen Wujiu's practice seal.
employee:2.line: 'An *employee* leaves a mark — find the mark, find the hand behind it,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: A folded note fell from a crack in the Trial Sword Stage.
sentences.cn: 一张折叠的纸条从试剑台的裂缝里掉了出来。

sentences.en: I picked it up and read: someone had hired a worker to leave a false medicine pouch near the steps.
sentences.cn: 我捡起来读了读：有人雇了个工人把一个假的药囊放在了台阶边。

sentences.en: That *employee* had no name, only a small mark — a cloud with three cuts through it.
Master Qingwu's eyes narrowed when I showed her.
sentences.cn: 我把纸条拿给青梧师尊看时，她的眼睛眯了起来。

class:2.en: Near the Trial Sword Stage stood a stone board listing every *class* of spiritual herb by rank and effect. I had memorised the first rank. But the note I found pointed to a herb of the fifth rank — one our lessons had never reached. Xiaoxing pressed close beside me, her breath quiet, her eyes wide.
class:2.cnHint: 试剑台旁的石板上列出了灵草的各个____，而纸条指向的是第五阶——我们从未学到过的一种。
class:2.hook: A fifth-rank herb in a disciple's hand could only mean one thing.
class:2.line: 'That *class* of herb is forbidden to new disciples,' Xiaoxing whispered softly.

sentences.en: Near the Trial Sword Stage stood a stone board listing every *class* of spiritual herb by rank and effect.
I had memorised the first rank.
sentences.cn: 我已经背下了第一等级的。

sentences.en: But the note I found pointed to a herb of the fifth rank — one our lessons had never reached.
sentences.cn: 但那张纸条指向的是第五等级的草药——我们的课程根本没涉及到。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed close beside me, her breath quiet, her eyes wide.
sentences.cn: 小杏紧贴着我站，呼吸很轻，眼睛睁得很大。

behavior:2.en: Shen Wujiu had been circling the Trial Sword Stage since dawn. His *behavior* was strange — he touched each stone pillar in turn, lips moving without sound, as if reciting a formula no one had taught us. I watched from behind the cedar tree, the folded note still warm in my sleeve.
behavior:2.cnHint: 师兄在试剑台上奇怪的____引起了我的注意，他默默触碰每根石柱，像是在诵念某种秘法。
behavior:2.hook: On the final pillar his hand left a faint and glowing print.
behavior:2.line: 'His *behavior* near the stage has changed since the last full moon,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had been circling the Trial Sword Stage since dawn.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从天亮就在试剑台周围转悠。

sentences.en: His *behavior* was strange — he touched each stone pillar in turn, lips moving without sound, as if reciting a formula no one had taught us.
I watched from behind the cedar tree, the folded note still warm in my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 我从香柏树后面看着，那张折叠的纸条在我袖子里还是热的。

disease:2.en: Hidden beneath the Trial Sword Stage's base stone I found a small jar sealed with wax. Inside was a grey powder — a record slip tucked beside it named it a cure for a *disease* that rots the spiritual root from within. Xiaoxing read the slip twice and went very still.
disease:2.cnHint: 试剑台基石下藏着一只蜡封小罐，罐中的药粉据称能治一种侵蚀灵根的____。
disease:2.hook: The jar was still faintly warm, as if someone had just placed it there.
disease:2.line: 'A *disease* of the spiritual root leaves no outward sign at first,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Hidden beneath the Trial Sword Stage's base stone I found a small jar sealed with wax.
sentences.cn: 我在试剑台底座石下面发现了一个蜡封的小罐子。

sentences.en: Inside was a grey powder — a record slip tucked beside it named it a cure for a *disease* that rots the spiritual root from within.
Xiaoxing read the slip twice and went very still.
sentences.cn: 小杏读了两遍纸条，然后一动不动。
